In this work, we for the first time identify that memorization induces internal numerical instability, often manifesting as visually ``broken'' artifacts. Inspired by stability analysis in numerical methods, we introduce empirical stability regions based on latent update norms to quantitatively characterize stable behavior during generation. Leveraging this, we propose a principled, on-the-fly framework for step-wise detection and adaptive mitigation. Our approach suppresses memorization without altering prompts or guidance, thereby preserving semantic fidelity and image quality. Extensive experiments on Stable Diffusion 1.4 demonstrate that our method achieves an AUC $>0.999$ detection performance and a $0.0\%$ memorization rate after mitigation with negligible overhead ($\approx0.01$s per image).

</details>


### [211] [The Neglected Baseline in Model Interpretation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22417)
*Yongjin Cui,Xiaohui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文指出现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线（baseline）导致解释不准确，通过重新定义模型解释任务和原则，统一了梯度法、积分梯度法和泰勒展开，明确了各方法的基线。在此基础上分析了IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法的缺陷，提出用归因误差替代边际效应等有缺陷的评估方法，并修订IG提出了一种具有明确合理基线、支持任意层特征解释的新方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型解释方法普遍忽略基线(baseline)，导致解释结果不精确甚至错误，因此需要重新审视基线在模型解释中的核心作用。

Method: 重新定义模型解释任务和解释原则以凸显基线重要性；统一梯度法、积分梯度法(IG)和泰勒展开，厘清各方法间的联系并明确各自的基线；基于此分析IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法的缺陷；提出通过归因误差（attribution error）来评估解释质量；修订IG方法，提出具有明确合理基线、支持任意层特征解释的新方法。

Result: 修订后的IG方法取得了更好的解释结果，且支持基于任意层特征进行模型解释，不同层的解释结果都能反映对应特征提取阶段的信息。

Conclusion: 基线在模型解释中至关重要，忽略基线会导致解释不准确；提出的归因误差评估方式优于传统评估方法；不同层的解释结果均有合理性，反映了不同特征提取阶段的信息。

Abstract: We observe that existing model interpretation methods generally ignore the baseline, and such neglect often results in imprecise or even incorrect interpretation. In this paper, we reformulate the task of model interpretation and the interpretation principles for model interpretation results to demonstrate the importance of the baseline. We further unify gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) methods, and Taylor expansion, clarifying the connections among them and explicitly identifying the baseline for each method. On this basis, we analyze the flaws and errors in related model interpretation methods (IG, LayerCAM, ODAM, Difference Map). We advocate evaluating the quality of model interpretation results precisely through the attribution error between the attribution result and the attribution target, rather than adopting flawed evaluation methods, such as those based on marginal-effect or the assumption of perfect model performance. We revise IG and develope a model interpretation method with a clear and reasonable baseline, achieving better results. Our method supports model interpretation based on features from any layer. Interpretation based on features from different layers are all reasonable, and the differences among these results reflect varying degrees of feature extraction at different feature extraction stages.

</details>


### [212] [Suicide Risk Assessment from AI-powered Video Surveillance: An Interpretable Framework for Prevention in Metro Stations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22904)
*Safwen Naimi,Wassim Bouachir,Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau,Brian Mishara*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次形式化定义了地铁站自杀风险评估（SRA）任务，并提出一个可解释的框架，通过整合行人追踪、活动识别、站台语义分割和轨迹驱动的风险热图建模，在真实监控数据上实现了83.2%的ROC-AUC，为可解释人工智能用于社会公益开辟了新方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地铁站中理解和监控人类行为对于支持自杀预防工作至关重要，早期识别高风险情境能够实现及时干预。现有方法要么聚焦于孤立子任务，要么试图直接推断意图，缺乏从累积证据中系统评估自杀风险的完整框架。

Method: 提出一个可解释的框架，通过整合四个关键模块来实现SRA：行人追踪（感知人体运动）、活动识别（理解行为语义）、站台语义分割（理解空间几何结构）以及轨迹驱动的风险热图建模（聚合异质行为线索的时序动态）。

Result: 在真实监控数据上实现了83.2%的ROC-AUC，验证了该操作管线的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将SRA形式化为一个独立任务并建立基准管线，本文凸显了自杀风险评估的复杂性，并为可解释人工智能系统在社会公益领域的研究开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Understanding and monitoring human behavior in metro stations play an important role in supporting suicide prevention efforts, where early identification of high-risk situations can enable timely intervention. This requires assessing suicide risk from a surveillance video by jointly reasoning about the behavior of each passenger, his/her spatial context, and temporal dynamics. However, this assessment using videos captured by surveillance cameras is challenging, as it demands accurate perception of human motion, understanding of platform geometry, and aggregation of heterogeneous behavioral cues over time. In this work, we formalize the task of Suicide Risk Assessment (SRA) in metro stations and introduce the first interpretable framework that addresses this challenge. Unlike approaches that focus on isolated subtasks or attempt to infer intent directly, our formulation assesses suicide risk from accumulated evidence by incorporating person tracking, activity recognition, semantic segmentation of the platform, and trajectory-driven risk heatmap modeling. By formalizing SRA as a distinct task and benchmarking a complete operational pipeline achieving 83.2% ROC-AUC on real surveillance data, this work highlights the complexity of suicide risk assessment and opens new directions for research on interpretable AI systems for social good.

</details>


### [213] [GFSR: Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement for Reliable Lane Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23327)
*Tiancheng Wang,Zhaolu Ding,Richeng Xu,Tianhui Zheng,Hui Liu,Hanyu Xuan,Zhiliang Wu,Guanghui Yue*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出GFSR框架，通过LaneIoU引导的置信度校准（LCC）和自适应门控位置细化（AGLR）模块，解决车道检测中分类置信度与几何质量脱节以及采样点间相关性弱的问题，在CULane和CurveLanes数据集上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有车道检测方法存在两个主要局限：1) 分类置信度仅表征车道先验的类别存在性，与几何质量强相关弱，导致基于置信度的阈值过滤和NMS会保留高置信度但几何质量差的先验，而丢弃低置信度但几何表示更优的先验；2) 回归模块削弱了采样点间的相关性，阻碍了对远处、高曲率及复杂拓扑车道的细粒度优化，导致欠拟合。

Method: 提出GFSR框架，包含两个核心模块：1) LaneIoU引导的置信度校准（LCC）：采用LaneIoU作为软监督显式估计车道先验的几何保真度，并将其与分类置信度融合构建协同可靠性指数（CRI），用于引导先验过滤；2) 自适应门控位置细化（AGLR）：与各细化阶段的回归头协作，预测采样点横向偏移量并采用门控机制自适应调节修正幅度，增强点间相关性及模型对复杂车道场景的适应性和鲁棒性。

Result: 在CULane上F1_50和F1_75分别达到81.46%和65.01%，在CurveLanes上F1_50达到87.35%，均达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的GFSR框架有效解决了现有车道检测方法中分类置信度与几何质量不匹配以及采样点间相关性弱的问题，通过LCC和AGLR两个模块协同工作，显著提升了复杂场景下车道检测的性能。

Abstract: Lane detection stands as a crucial perception task in autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. However, existing methods still degrade in complex real scenarios due to two major limitations. First, classification confidence only characterizes the categorical existence of lane priors and has no strong correlation with geometric quality. If threshold filtering and NMS are conducted merely based on this confidence, the model tends to retain lane priors with high confidence while eliminating those with lower confidence but superior geometric representation. Secondly, the regression modules in existing methods weaken correlations among sampling points, hindering fine-grained optimization of distant, high-curvature and complex-topology lanes and causing underfitting. To address these issues, we propose Geometric Fidelity and Spatial Refinement (GFSR), a framework consisting of LaneIoU-guided Confidence Calibration (LCC) and Adaptive Gated Location Refinement (AGLR). Specifically, LCC adopts LaneIoU as soft supervision to explicitly estimate the geometric fidelity of lane priors, which is further fused with classification confidence to construct the Collaborative Reliability Index (CRI). This index guides lane prior filtering, effectively retaining those with high classification confidence and favorable geometric quality. Meanwhile, cooperating with regression heads in each refinement stage, AGLR predicts sampling point lateral offsets and adopts a gating mechanism to adaptively regulate correction magnitude, strengthen inter-point correlations and boost model adaptability as well as robustness toward complex lane scenarios. Extensive experiments on CULane and CurveLanes demonstrate that our GFSR achieves state-of-the-art performance on CULane, with F1_50 and F1_75 scores of 81.46% and 65.01%, and reaches 87.35% F1_50 on CurveLanes.

</details>


### [214] [Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward: Towards Principled One-step Generator RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24001)
*Junyi Wu,Weijian Luo,Haoyang Zheng,Ruizhe Zhang,Guang Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DIDR框架，通过扩散奖励传播和积分KL最小化实现单步文本到图像生成的高效对齐，在保持单步生成速度的同时超越多步教师模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法用于单步生成器时存在终端奖励优化与生成动力学不匹配的问题，导致优化过程利用随机自由度提升奖励但牺牲图像保真度。

Method: 提出DIDR（Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward）框架：基于积分KL最小化的无数据轨迹级对齐方法，将RLHF最优的奖励倾斜干净图像分布沿扩散轨迹传播到所有噪声水平，并引入扩散奖励分数（DRS）作为奖励驱动的分数函数校正，以及扩散奖励代理（DRP）作为基于可微短步去噪的高效估计器。

Result: 在单步SDXL基线上实现一致帕累托主导；在6B DiT骨干（Z-Image）上，单步生成超越50步教师模型的偏好对齐效果。

Conclusion: DIDR有效解决了单步生成器中奖励优化与生成动力学的失配问题，实现了单步生成速度与高质量偏好对齐的统一。

Abstract: Recent advances in one-step text-to-image generation have enabled real-time synthesis with remarkable efficiency and quality. Previous reinforcement learning methods for one-step generators combine image-space reward optimization with diffusion noisy-space distribution matching. This paradigm brings challenges due to a mismatch between terminal reward optimization and the underlying generative dynamics. As a result, optimization tends to exploit stochastic degrees of freedom, often improving reward at the expense of image fidelity. To address this issue, we propose Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR), a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework derived from Integral KL minimization. DIDR propagates the RLHF-optimal reward-tilted clean-image distribution across all noise levels along the diffusion trajectory. We show that this objective admits the same minimizer as clean-image RLHF, while naturally inducing the Diffused Reward Score (DRS), which acts as a reward-driven correction to the reference score function. To make this practical, we further introduce the Diffused Reward Proxy (DRP), an efficient estimator of DRS based on differentiable short-step denoising. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DIDR consistently Pareto-dominates existing one-step SDXL baselines. Moreover, when transferred to a 6B DiT backbone (Z-Image), DIDR surpasses its 50-step teacher in preference alignment while requiring only a single generation step.

</details>


### [215] [EgoProx: Evaluating MLLMs on Egocentric 3D Proximity Reasoning Across a Cognitive Hierarchy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24456)
*Jinzhao Li,Yinuo Chen,Dongxu Piao,Panwang Pan,Yifan Yu,Dong Wang,Honglei Yan,Liang Yue,Shaofei Wang,Yixin Chen,Siyuan Huang,Miao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EgoProx基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在自我中心3D邻近关系推理上的能力，实验表明现有MLLMs具备一定空间知识但难以有效利用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类在日常中不断进行3D邻近关系推理（身体与周围物体的空间关系），但多模态大语言模型是否具备这种具身3D推理能力尚不清楚，因此需要构建专门的基准进行评估。

Method: 构建EgoProx基准，沿认知链组织任务（意图、探索、利用、行动链推理）；设计基于智能体的数据引擎以大规模生成多样化且一致的QA对；对主流MLLMs进行基准测试，并利用数据集特定和任务特定的指令微调进行额外分析。

Result: 观察到跨领域的大幅增益，表明当前MLLMs包含一些空间知识；然而它们仍难以有效利用这些知识进行空间推理VQA。

Conclusion: 现有MLLMs具备一定的空间知识，但在自我中心3D邻近推理任务上表现不足，无法有效调用其空间知识完成视觉问答任务。

Abstract: Humans constantly reason about 3D proximity, the relations between their body and surrounding objects, to guide perception and action in daily life. Whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can perform such embodied 3D reasoning remains unclear. To this end, we introduce EgoProx, a benchmark for egocentric 3D proximity reasoning. We organize our tasks along a cognitive chain, covering intention, exploration, exploitation, and chain-of-actions reasoning. We also design an agent based data engine that produces diverse and consistent QA pairs at scale. We benchmark prevailing MLLMs on EgoProx and conduct additional analyses with dataset specific and task specific instruction tuning. We observe large cross-domain gains, indicating that current MLLMs contain some spatial knowledge; however, they still struggle to effectively leverage it for spatial reasoning VQA.

</details>


### [216] [Resolving Ambiguity in Composed Image Retrieval via Calibrated Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24634)
*Amsisan Tran,Baogh Le,Tuan Kiet Pham,Sui Yang Guang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将组合图像检索（CIR）重新定义为不确定性下的校准意图解析，通过共形预测层提供覆盖保证，并在模糊时通过信息增益策略提出最有效的澄清问题。实验表明该方法在精确查询上无损SOTA性能，同时显著减少交互成本，首次报告了有效覆盖和校准指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CIR方法假设一个查询映射到单个目标，但实际中如"make it more formal"等查询本质上是欠定的（underdetermined），导致假阴性问题和模型无法区分精确查询与模糊查询。

Method: (1) 将检索器包装在共形预测层中，返回具有覆盖保证的候选集；(2) 候选集大小作为模糊度的原则性度量；(3) 当集合较大时，通过期望信息增益策略选择最有效的澄清问题（从可解释的模糊轴中选取），从而缩小候选集；(4) 构建AmbiCIR基准和经过人工验证的用户模拟器。

Result: 在开放域和时尚基准上，该方法在精确查询上匹配单轮SOTA性能；在模糊查询上以更少的交互轮次达到目标；首次为CIR任务报告了有效的覆盖和校准指标。

Conclusion: CIR应被重新理解为不确定下的意图解析而非单目标匹配；共形预测+主动澄清的框架在保持精度的同时能处理查询模糊性，且交互效率优于朴素对话基线。

Abstract: Composed image retrieval (CIR) searches a corpus with a reference image and a text describing how to modify it. Despite rapid progress from triplet-trained compositors to zero-shot and generative methods, essentially all systems share one assumption: that a query maps to a single target, scored by Recall@K against one annotation. We argue this is fundamentally at odds with the task. A query such as make it more formal does not name an image but a region of the corpus, and which member the user intends is genuinely underdetermined. This underspecification is the root of the well-known false-negative problem and leaves current models unable to tell a precise query from an ambiguous one. We reframe CIR as calibrated intent resolution under uncertainty: a retriever is wrapped in a conformal prediction layer that returns a candidate set with a coverage guarantee and whose size is a principled measure of ambiguity; when the set is large, an expected-information-gain policy asks the single most useful clarifying question, drawn from interpretable ambiguity axes, and the set contracts. We introduce AmbiCIR, a benchmark and human-validated user simulator that revive the dormant auxiliary and dialogue annotations of CIRR and extend the multiple-positive setting of CIRCO. Across open-domain and fashion benchmarks our method matches single-turn state of the art, confirming calibrated resolution is cost-free on precise queries, while reaching the intended target in a fraction of the interaction budget required by naive conversational baselines, and it is the first to report valid coverage and calibration for the task.

</details>


### [217] [Where Detectors Fail: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24906)
*Zijie Cao,Weijie Tu,Yao Xiao,Weijian Deng,Liang Lin,Pengxu Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PROBE框架，通过主动探索生成过程中的困难区域（利用检测器作为评判者引导生成器产生难以分类的样本），从而提升AI生成图像检测器对未见生成器的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器在生成设置改变时性能显著下降，仅靠扩大训练数据规模不足以解决泛化问题，关键在于训练过程中对生成变体的覆盖不足。

Method: 提出PROBE框架：将检测器作为评判者（critic），通过流形级别的修改引导生成器产生难以分类的样本，暴露标准采样策略下罕见的失败案例，并利用这些样本来优化检测器。

Result: 在多个基准测试上的实验结果表明，PROBE能够显著提升检测器对未见生成器的泛化性能，实现更通用的AIGI检测。

Conclusion: 主动探索生成过程中的困难区域是提升AIGI检测器泛化能力的有效策略，代码和模型已开源。

Abstract: Detecting AI-generated images (AIGI) remains challenging because detectors often fail to generalize to unseen generators. Although existing methods are trained on large datasets, their performance still degrades when generation settings change, indicating that data scale alone is insufficient and that limited coverage of generative variations during training is a key factor. Studies on generative model editing show that small changes in internal representations can produce diverse and meaningful image variations, many of which are not explored under standard sampling. Leveraging this insight, we propose PROBE (Probing Robustness via Boundary Exploration), a framework that improves detector generalization by actively exploring challenging regions of the generative process. Instead of treating the generator as a fixed data source, PROBE uses the detector as a critic to steer the generator through manifold-level modifications, producing realistic samples that are difficult to classify. These samples expose failure cases that are uncommon under standard data sampling strategies and are used to refine the detector. Experimental results across multiple benchmarks indicate that PROBE enhances generalization to unseen generators, resulting in more generalizable AIGI detection performance. Code and models are available at https://github.com/Amamiya-C/PROBE-AIGI-Detection

</details>


### [218] [Tetris: Tile-level Sampling for Efficient and High-Fidelity Video Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25538)
*Chanwut Kittivorawong,Alena Chao,Charlie Si,Alvin Cheung*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Tetris是一种面向静态视频的轨道提取系统，通过基于瓦片的polyomino数据模型实现细粒度时空剪枝，在保证5%跟踪精度损失的前提下，相比先前系统实现最高17.4倍吞吐量提升，相比全帧参考管线实现最高68.8倍提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有轨道物化系统通过时间帧采样降低成本，但会丢失细粒度跟踪所需的帧间运动信息。静态视频中大部分帧区域不包含感兴趣对象，且不同区域可容忍不同采样率，现有方法未能充分利用这一特性进行细粒度剪枝。

Method: Tetris将视频分解为基于瓦片的polyomino数据模型，运行三个上游算子：1) 分类器识别相关瓦片并分组为polyomino；2) 整数线性规划(ILP)在用户指定精度约束下剪枝冗余polyomino；3) 打包器将剩余polyomino组装为画布以最小化检测器调用次数。

Result: 在7个静态视频数据集上，Tetris在5%跟踪精度损失边界内保持性能，而先前系统在3/7的数据集上超出该边界。在此边界下，Tetris吞吐量比先前系统最高提升17.4倍，比参考管线最高提升68.8倍。

Conclusion: Tetris通过细粒度时空剪枝，在静态视频场景下实现了高效的轨道提取，显著降低了检测器调用次数，同时保持了与全帧参考管线相当的高保真度跟踪精度。

Abstract: Track materialization converts raw video into reusable object tracks that downstream queries can run against without rerunning tracking, but extracting those tracks efficiently and with high fidelity remains expensive. Prior systems reduce cost through temporal frame sampling, erasing the inter-frame motion that fine-grained tracking requires. In stationary video, however, large portions of each frame contain no objects of interest, and the remaining regions tolerate different sampling rates. We present Tetris, a track-extraction system that decomposes videos into a tile-based polyomino data model, enabling fine-grained spatiotemporal pruning that reduces detector calls with minimal fidelity loss. Tetris runs three operators upstream of the user-provided detector: a classifier identifies relevant tiles and groups them into polyominoes, an integer linear program (ILP) prunes redundant polyominoes under a user-specified accuracy constraint, and a packer assembles the survivors into canvases that minimize detector calls. Across 7 stationary-video datasets, Tetris stays within a 5% tracking accuracy loss of a full-frame, every-frame reference pipeline, whereas prior systems exceed this bound on 3 of the 7 datasets. At this 5% bound, Tetris achieves up to 17.4x higher throughput than prior systems and up to 68.8x higher than the reference pipeline. The project page is at https://tetris-db.github.io .

</details>


### [219] [ControlLight: Towards Controllable, Consistent, and Generalizable Low-Light Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25569)
*Yufeng Yang,Jianzhuang Liu,Jisheng Chu,Yuqi Peng,Xianfang Zeng,Jiancheng Huang,Shifeng Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了ControlLight框架，通过构建大规模连续光照强度监督数据集和错位感知加权流匹配损失，实现了低光图像增强的可控性、一致性和泛化性，在多项指标上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法受限于小规模数据集和单一增强目标，导致模型泛化能力差且缺乏可控性，无法满足真实场景中用户对增强程度的灵活调节需求。

Method: 1) 构建了包含连续光照强度监督的大规模真实退化图像数据集；2) 提出错位感知加权流匹配损失，在不同控制强度下保持图像结构一致性；3) ControlLight框架允许用户灵活控制增强强度，实现连续可调的增强效果。

Result: 在多个基准测试上达到SOTA性能，展现出强大的连续可控性和对真实场景的泛化能力，同时保持视觉一致性和真实感。

Conclusion: ControlLight通过大规模数据构建和错位感知损失设计，有效解决了低光增强中可控性、一致性和泛化性三大挑战，为实际应用提供了灵活的增强方案。

Abstract: Existing deep learning-based low-light enhancement methods are typically trained on limited datasets with single enhancement targets, which restricts their generalization ability and controllability in real-world applications. To overcome these limitations, we propose ControlLight, a controllable, consistent, and generalizable framework for low-light enhancement. We first construct a large-scale dataset of real-world degraded images with continuous illumination-strength supervision. To further ensure consistent outputs under different control strengths, we introduce a misalignment-aware weighted flow matching loss that preserves image structure across continuous enhancement strengths. ControlLight allows users to edit real-world degraded low-light images toward satisfactory enhancement results by flexibly controlling the strength while preserving visual consistency and realism. Extensive experiments show that ControlLight achieves state-of-the-art performance against existing low-light enhancement approaches while demonstrating strong continuous controllability and generalization to real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [220] [From Contrast to Consistency: Rethinking Event-based Continuous-Time Optical Flow Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25570)
*Rui Hu,Song Wu,Wen Yang,Jinjian Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于时空结构一致性（STSC）的混合监督连续时光流估计框架，通过双向互补多尺度架构和课程引导的混合训练策略，在多个基准上实现了连续时间和标准光流估计的最先进性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机具有微秒级延迟和高动态范围，能异步捕捉亮度变化，为精细时间精度的运动建模提供了独特机会。然而，时间密集的真值标注稀缺限制了监督学习的有效性，而对比度最大化框架往往忽略时间连续性和结构一致性，导致复杂运动下的轨迹扭曲。

Method: 1) 提出时空结构一致性（STSC）原则，联合强化局部结构稳定性和轨迹连续性；2) 设计双向互补多尺度架构；3) 采用课程引导的混合训练策略，从监督点约束平滑过渡到自监督流形正则化。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，该方法在连续时间和标准光流估计任务中均取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 该混合监督学习范式有效解决了事件相机光流估计中时间密集标注稀缺和复杂运动下轨迹扭曲的问题，验证了时空结构一致性的有效性。

Abstract: Estimating continuous optical flow is a fundamental yet challenging problem in dynamic visual perception. Event-based cameras, with microsecond latency and high dynamic range, capture brightness changes asynchronously, offering a unique opportunity to model motion with fine temporal precision. However, the scarcity of temporally dense ground-truth annotations limits the effectiveness of supervised learning, while contrast maximization (CM) frameworks, focused on sharpening the Image of Warped Events (IWE), often neglect temporal continuity and structural coherence, leading to distorted trajectories under complex motion. To overcome these challenges, we propose a hybrid-supervised framework for continuous-time optical flow estimation, grounded in the principle of Spatio-temporal Structural Consistency (STSC). This paradigm jointly enforces local structural stability and trajectory continuity, ensuring physically coherent motion across time. To further enhance representation and robustness, we design a bidirectionally complementary multi-scale architecture and employ a curriculum-guided hybrid training strategy, enabling a smooth transition from supervised point constraints to self-supervised manifold regularization. Comprehensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both continuous-time and standard optical flow estimation, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed learning paradigm.

</details>


### [221] [AI-T2I: Aggregating-and-Isolating Cross-Attention to Diffusion Models for Text-to-Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25763)
*Shipeng Cao,Biao Qian,Haipeng Liu,Yang Wang,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出AI-T2I方法，通过聚合-隔离交叉注意力机制解决扩散模型文本到图像生成中同一主题内token激活分散和不同主题间token激活重叠的问题，显著提升文本-图像对齐性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在文本到图像合成中，交叉注意力图存在两类对齐问题：一是不同主题token间的激活重叠（inter-subject），二是同一主题token内的激活分散（intra-subject）。现有工作仅关注前者，忽略了后者。

Method: 提出AI-T2I方法：1）聚合损失（aggregation loss）：识别并整合同一主题内分散的token激活，同时隐式缓解重叠问题；2）隔离损失（isolation loss）：进一步推远不同主题token间的激活，实现精确对齐。

Result: 在多个基准测试上超越现有最先进方法，并在可控布局生成和个性化生成等下游任务中展现良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过同时解决intra-subject激活分散和inter-subject激活重叠问题，AI-T2I实现了更精确的文本-图像对齐，且具有良好的通用性。

Abstract: Text-to-image synthesis has made significant progress, benefiting from the strong generative capabilities of diffusion models. However, these models struggle to achieve precise text-to-image alignment within cross-attention maps during the denoising process. Existing works primarily focus on inter-subject-token activations (i.e., cross-attention scores) overlap for different subjects, overlooking the intra-subject-token activations scattering issue for identical subjects. In this paper, we propose an Aggregating-and-Isolating cross-attention approach to diffusion models for Text-to-Image synthesis, dubbed AI-T2I. Technically, to address the scattering issue, we devise an aggregation loss to identify and consolidate the scattered intra-token activations, which implicitly helps mitigate the potential overlap issue. Upon that, an isolation loss is further introduced to push the inter-token activations apart, thus fulfilling precise text-to-image alignment. Extensive experiments on various benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of AI-T2I over the state-of-the-art works for text-to-image synthesis. Furthermore, our AI-T2I exhibits excellent generalization across other tasks, e.g., controllable layout generation and personalized generation.

</details>


### [222] [MuNet: A Mutualistic Network for Joint 3D Human Mesh Recovery and 3D Clothed Human Reconstruction from Single Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25861)
*Yunqi Gao,Leyuan Liu,Yuhan Li,Changxin Gao,Jingying Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MuNet是一个统一的互惠网络，通过图卷积网络和互惠机制，联合优化3D人体网格恢复和3D clothed人体重建任务，在六个基准数据集上均达到最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D人体网格恢复和3D clothed人体重建虽然本质相关，但长期被孤立研究，忽略了联合优化可能带来的相互增益。

Method: 首先采用2-流形图作为统一表示；然后设计端到端图卷积网络，逐步将初始图变形为3D人体网格并细化为带衣物细节的3D人体模型；最后引入互惠机制，在训练中实现两个任务的相互指导与反馈。

Result: 在Human3.6M、3DPW、MPI-INF-3DHP、THuman2.0、CAPE和RenderPeople六个基准数据集上，MuNet在两项任务中均达到最先进性能。

Conclusion: 联合优化两个相关任务能有效提升各自性能，统一框架和互惠机制是关键设计。

Abstract: 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction are inherently related, yet they have long been studied in isolation, thereby overlooking the potential gains of joint optimization. To overcome this limitation, we propose to address these two tasks within a unified framework, which allows their mutual dependencies to be effectively exploited. Building on this idea, we propose MuNet, a mutualistic network for joint 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction from single images. First, we adopt 2-manifold graphs as a unified representation for all 3D models, enabling consistent modeling across 3D human mesh recovery and clothed human reconstruction. Second, we design an end-to-end graph convolutional network that progressively deforms an initial graph into a 3D human mesh and refines it into a detailed 3D clothed human model. Third, we introduce a mutualistic mechanism that allows reciprocal interaction between the two tasks {during training}, where 3D human mesh recovery provides guidance for 3D clothed human reconstruction, and reconstruction feedback refines the 3D human mesh recovery. We extensively evaluate MuNet on six benchmark datasets for 3D human mesh recovery and 3D clothed human reconstruction, including Human3.6M, 3DPW, MPI-INF-3DHP, THuman2.0, CAPE, and RenderPeople. Experimental results demonstrate that MuNet achieves state-of-the-art performance on both tasks across all datasets. The code of MuNet is released for research purposes at https://github.com/starVisionTeam/MuNet.

</details>


### [223] [Global Structure-from-Motion Meets Feedforward Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26103)
*Linfei Pan,Johannes Schönberger,Marc Pollefeys*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合经典SfM方法与前馈3D重建优势的新型SfM管线，在多种场景下实现了最先进的重建效果，并提供了开源实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典SfM方法在低纹理、有限重叠和对称场景等困难情况下存在持续失败案例，而前馈3D重建方法虽在这些挑战性条件下表现优异，但在可扩展性、精度或鲁棒性方面存在局限，且在标准重建设置中通常不如经典方法。因此，需要结合两者优势来解决各自短板。

Method: 系统分析了经典SfM与前馈方法的各自局限性，提出了一种新型SfM管线，将经典方法的可扩展性和精度与前馈方法在困难场景下的鲁棒性相结合。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在广泛场景中取得了最先进的重建结果。

Conclusion: 混合经典与前馈方法的SfM管线能够有效结合两者优势，在多种重建场景中实现最佳性能，并且该工作已开源供社区使用。

Abstract: Structure-from-Motion -- the process of simultaneously estimating camera poses and 3D scene structure from a collection of images -- remains a central challenge in computer vision, with many open problems yet to be solved. Recent advances in feedforward 3D reconstruction have made significant strides in overcoming persistent failure cases of classical SfM methods, particularly in scenarios characterized by low texture, limited overlap, and symmetries. However, while feedforward approaches excel in these challenging conditions, they often face limitations regarding scalability, accuracy, or robustness, and typically fall short of classical methods in standard reconstruction settings. In this work, we systematically analyze these limitations and propose a new Structure-from-Motion pipeline by combining the respective strengths of classical and feedforward methods. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets show the benefits of our approach, achieving state-of-the-art results across a wide range of scenarios. We share our system as an open-source implementation at https://github.com/colmap/gluemap.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [224] [GEM: Geometric Entropy Mixing for Optimal LLM Data Curation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26121)
*Yue Min,Ziyun Qiao,Ruining Chen,Yujun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GEM框架，将数据配比重新定义为超球面上的变分问题，通过解耦生成先验和MM算法优化，有效对抗聚类坍塌以发现平衡的语义结构，在1.1B参数模型上集成DoReMi/RegMix等混合策略时提升平均下游准确率最高1.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM预训练效果日益依赖数据组成而非单纯规模，但现有混合策略受困于分类缺陷：人为分类存在本体论错位，欧几里得聚类无法处理嵌入各向异性，亟需更好的数据配比方法。

Method: GEM框架将数据配比重构为超球面上的变分问题并引入混合平衡正则化项；通过解耦生成先验并利用可证明的MM算法优化目标函数；采用师生蒸馏将几何保真度扩展到Web规模语料；引入几何影响分数(GIS)用于可解释的类别生成。

Result: 在1.1B参数模型上，GEM集成到DoReMi和RegMix等混合策略中达到新的SOTA，平均下游准确率提升最高1.2%，提供了可预测数据混合的鲁棒坐标系统。

Conclusion: GEM通过几何视角重新定义数据配比问题，有效克服了传统方法的聚类坍塌和嵌入各向异性缺陷，证明了几何保真度在数据混合中的关键价值，且GIS可解释性强。

Abstract: LLM pre-training efficacy increasingly depends on data composition rather than sheer volume. Yet, optimal mixing is hindered by categorization flaws: human taxonomies suffer from ontological misalignment, and Euclidean clustering fails to address embedding anisotropy. We introduce GEM (Geometric Entropy Mixing), a framework reformulating data curation as a variational problem on the hypersphere augmented with a mixing-balance regularizer. By decoupling the generative prior and optimizing the objective via a provable MM (Minorize-Maximize) algorithm, GEM effectively counteracts the cluster collapse to discover balanced semantic structures invisible to Euclidean heuristics. We employ teacher-student distillation to scale this geometric fidelity to web-scale corpora and introduce the Geometric Influence Score (GIS) for interpretable taxonomy generation. Experiments with 1.1B-parameter models demonstrate that GEM establishes a new state-of-the-art when integrated into mixing strategies like DoReMi and RegMix, improving average downstream accuracy by up to 1.2% and offering a robust coordinate system for predictable data mixing.

</details>


### [225] [The Constraint Tax: Measuring Validity-Correctness Tradeoffs in Structured Outputs for Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26128)
*Jaideep Ray*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了一个严重的安全隐患：在小型语言模型（<3B参数）上施加硬性结构化约束（如JSON Schema、工具调用格式）会显著降低答案准确率，而非通常假设的“不影响答案质量”。通过对15,000次生成的实验，作者量化了“约束税”：强制schema解码虽然将格式合规率从61.5%提升至100.0%，但答案准确率从19.7%降至11.0%，错误合规输出从49.5%激增至88.9%。即使是行业级日历工具调用任务，Qwen2.5-1.5B在无约束模式下准确率91.5%，硬约束下仅48.0%。作者提出“自由推理、延迟约束”的设计范式，并建议生产系统应独立报告schema合规率、答案准确率、可执行准确率和错误合规率四项指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前生产级LLM系统越来越需要结构化输出，但针对小模型（<3B参数）的常见工程假设——硬输出约束在不改变答案的前提下提升可靠性——尚未被严格检验。该假设对小模型可能是危险的，因为小模型能力有限，强制约束可能损害语义理解。作者旨在量化这种“约束税”，并推动更安全的评估实践。

Method: 提出“约束税”测量协议，分别在固定模型、固定任务分布和固定问题实例下隔离结构化约束带来的答案准确率与可执行准确率损失。实验选用Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、SmolLM2-1.7B三个小模型，通过15,000次commodity-GPU生成，对比无约束（prompt-only）与硬性schema解码（constrained decoding）的效果，同时设计行业级日历工具调用任务进行类比验证。

Result: 硬性schema解码将schema合规率从61.5%提升至100.0%，但答案准确率从19.7%降至11.0%，错误合规输出（格式正确但答案错误）从49.5%增至88.9%。在日历工具调用任务中，Qwen2.5-1.5B的无约束可执行准确率为91.5%，硬约束下仅48.0%（两者schema合规率均为100.0%）。3B参数边界仍存在直接schema税。

Conclusion: 硬性结构化约束对小模型存在显著的语义级准确率损失，并非“不影响答案”。建议采用“自由推理、延迟约束”设计模式，在生产系统中独立报告schema合规率、答案准确率、可执行准确率和错误合规率四项指标，以正确评估结构化输出对任务质量的实际影响。

Abstract: Production LLM systems increasingly require machine-readable outputs: JSON objects, typed traces, regex-constrained fields, and tool-call schemas. This paper targets on-device and low-cost small language model (SLM) deployments, where sub-3B models are attractive for privacy, latency, and commodity hardware but have limited capacity to satisfy schemas while solving tasks. The usual engineering assumption is that hard output constraints improve reliability without changing the underlying answer. We show that this assumption is unsafe for small models. We introduce \emph{constraint tax}, a measurement protocol for isolating the answer and executable-accuracy loss caused by structured-output constraints at fixed model, fixed task distribution, and fixed problem instances. Across 15,000 commodity-GPU generations with Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and SmolLM2-1.7B, hard answer-only schema decoding raises schema validity from 61.5\% to 100.0\%, but lowers answer accuracy from 19.7\% to 11.0\% and increases wrong-valid-schema outputs from 49.5\% to 88.9\%. The strongest industry analogue is a deterministic calendar tool-call task: Qwen2.5-1.5B achieves 91.5\% executable accuracy with prompt-only JSON but only 48.0\% under the same hard tool-call schema, while both modes are 100.0\% schema-valid. The error is semantic, not structural. We also show that the 3B boundary still pays a direct-schema tax and that delayed packaging supports a constructive design pattern: reason free, constrain late. The practical conclusion is direct: production systems should report schema validity, answer accuracy, executable accuracy, and wrong-valid-schema rate separately.

</details>


### [226] [AirCast-SR: A Foundation Model for Kilometer-Scale Atmospheric Super-Resolution via Latent Consistency Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26130)
*Somnath Luitel,Manmeet Singh,Joshua Durkee,Abdullah Al Fahad,Naveen Sudharsan,Prabhjot Singh,Cenlin He,Harsh Kamath,Zong-Liang Yang,Krishnagopal Halder,Sandeep Juneja,Parthasarathi Mukhopadhyay,Saptarishi Dhanuka,Amit Kumar Srivastava*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EarthMind-SR（原文中前后名称不一致，实际为EarthMind-SR），一种基于潜一致性模型（LCM）扩散框架的大气超分基础模型，可将0.25度（~28 km）的全球AI天气预报降尺度至1 km水平分辨率，在CONUS区域训练并在印度和德国实现零样本全球迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 千米级业务天气预报对于传统NWP模型而言计算成本过高，限制了能源、农业和灾害管理等需要精细时空细节的应用场景对高分辨率预报的获取。现有粗分辨率AI天气模型无法提供足够的细粒度信息，亟需一种高效的超分方法。

Method: 采用三维U-Net架构，在潜一致性模型（LCM）扩散框架下进行条件建模。以GraphCast预报作为输入，NOAA的AORC再分析数据作为目标，在CONUS区域以基于patch的样本进行训练，生成八个耦合地表变量的67小时预报序列。

Result: 在所有变量和预报时长上实现近零偏差；径向功率谱密度分析表明在10 km至100 km波长范围内保留精细大气结构，而粗分辨率模型在此区间丧失谱功率；在CONUS三个季节案例及印度、德国零样本测试中均表现良好。

Conclusion: EarthMind-SR以开放权重基础模型的形式，建立了千米级AI天气预报的新范式，为区域微调、知识蒸馏以及气候服务和灾害预报等下游应用提供了平台。

Abstract: Operational weather prediction at kilometer scales remains computationally prohibitive for traditional numerical weather prediction (NWP) models, limiting forecast access for applications in energy, agriculture, and disaster management that require fine-grained spatiotemporal detail. Here we introduce AirCast-SR, a foundation model for atmospheric super-resolution that downscales global AI weather forecasts from 0.25 degree (~28 km) to 1 km horizontal resolution at hourly temporal resolution, producing 67-hour forecasts of eight coupled surface variables simultaneously. EarthMind-SR employs a three-dimensional U-Net conditioned within a Latent Consistency Model (LCM) diffusion framework, trained on patch-based samples over the contiguous United States (CONUS) using GraphCast forecasts as input and NOAA's Analysis of Record for Calibration (AORC) as the target. The model achieves near-zero bias across all variables and lead times, and its radial power spectral density analysis demonstrates preservation of fine-scale atmospheric structure at wavelengths of 10 km to 100 km where coarser models lose spectral power. We validate EarthMind-SR across three CONUS case studies spanning winter, summer, and spring seasons, and demonstrate zero-shot global transferability over India and Germany using independent surface station observations without any retraining or fine-tuning. As an open-weights foundation model, EarthMind-SR establishes a new paradigm for kilometer-scale AI weather prediction and provides a platform for regional fine-tuning, distillation, and downstream applications in climate services and hazard forecasting.

</details>


### [227] [Probabilistic Recurrent Intention Switching Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26998)
*Wenyuan Sheng,Hao Zhu,Joschka Boedecker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM模型，用轻量级循环网络替代马尔可夫链或固定历史窗口，实现每步意图分布的推断，并在非马尔可夫网格世界、小鼠迷宫及BridgeData V2机器人操作任务中取得最优的留出对数似然，恢复出可命名、时序连贯的意图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) 假设单一固定奖励函数，无法捕捉回合内的目标切换。现有多意图 IRL 方法要么采用无记忆马尔可夫链建模意图转移，要么通过手动状态增强并固定历史窗口，这些方式限制了模型对复杂非马尔可夫目标切换的表达能力。

Method: 提出 Probabilistic Recurrent Intention Switching Model (PRISM)，使用轻量级循环神经网络将观测历史映射到单步意图分布。在 EM 框架下，证明了 E-step 可分解为每个意图独立的奖励子问题，且每个子问题有闭式解，E-step 复杂度仅为 O(nK)，无需变分近似。

Result: 在非马尔可夫网格世界、小鼠迷宫以及 BridgeData V2 机器人操作任务上，PRISM 在所有设定下取得了最高的留出对数似然，并恢复了具有可命名性、时序连贯性的意图。

Conclusion: 离散的目标切换在生物体（小鼠）和人工体（机器人）中均存在，PRISM 提供了一种轻量、可分解且无需变分近似的有效建模方案。

Abstract: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) recovers reward functions from observed behavior, yet traditional methods assume a single stationary reward that cannot capture goal switching within an episode. Recent multi-intention IRL methods address this by segmenting trajectories, but model intention transitions as either a memoryless Markov chain or via manual state augmentation with a fixed history window. We propose the Probabilistic Recurrent Intention Switching Model (PRISM), which replaces both mechanisms with a lightweight recurrent network that maps observation history to a per-step intention distribution. We prove that the resulting EM objective decomposes exactly into independent per-intention reward subproblems, each solvable in closed form, yielding an $\mathcal{O}(nK)$ E-step with no variational approximation. We evaluate PRISM on a non-Markovian gridworld, a mouse labyrinth, and BridgeData~V2 robotic manipulation, the first large-scale robotic application of multi-intention IRL. Across all settings PRISM achieves the highest held-out log-likelihood while recovering nameable, temporally coherent intentions from unlabeled demonstrations, suggesting that discrete goal switching is present in both biological and artificial agents.

</details>


### [228] [SilIF: Silhouette-Augmented Isolation Forest for Unsupervised Transaction Fraud Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26135)
*Venkatakrishnan Gopalakrishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SilIF是一种增强型孤立森林算法，通过树路径长度构建指纹向量并计算轮廓分数，在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上AUC-PR提升0.0080，但在Sparkov合成数据集上无改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无监督异常检测在标签稀缺的交易欺诈检测中广泛应用，孤立森林(IF)因其可扩展性和易部署性而流行，但存在改进空间以提升检测性能。

Method: SilIF在孤立森林基础上增加基于轮廓系数( silhouette )的评分层：提取每个样本在各棵树上路径长度向量作为"指纹"，聚类为结构组，计算样本归属其组与最近邻组的轮廓分数，通过超参数α将轮廓信号与基础IF得分结合。

Result: 在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测基准（约59万笔交易，3.5%欺诈率）上，SilIF(α=1.0)在5个随机种子下平均AUC-PR比原始IF提升0.0080，全部5个种子均优于基线（配对t检验p=0.046）；在Sparkov合成信用卡数据集上无改进。

Conclusion: SilIF是一种可调参、易部署的孤立森林增强方案，并在适用与不适用的场景上给出了诚实报告。

Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection is widely used in transaction fraud detection where labels are scarce. Isolation Forest (IF) is among the most popular classical methods due to its scalability and ease of deployment. We propose SilIF, an augmentation of Isolation Forest that adds a silhouette-based scoring layer computed in a representation space induced by the trees of the forest. For each point, we extract a vector of per-tree path lengths, cluster these "fingerprints" into structural groups, and compute a silhouette score that measures how well the point fits its assigned group versus the nearest alternative. The silhouette signal is combined with the base IF score via a single hyperparameter alpha. On the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection benchmark (~590K transactions, 3.5% fraud), SilIF with alpha=1.0 improves over plain Isolation Forest by +0.0080 AUC-PR on average across five seeds, with SilIF winning on all five seeds (paired t-test p=0.046). We also report results on a synthetic credit-card dataset (Sparkov) where the silhouette augmentation does not improve over plain IF, and we characterize the conditions that distinguish the two outcomes. The paper presents SilIF as a tunable, easy-to-deploy enhancement to Isolation Forest with honest reporting of when it helps and when it does not. Code at https://github.com/venkat15vk/silif-anomaly-detection.

</details>


### [229] [Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26147)
*Yongchao Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出神经贝叶斯顺序路由（NBSR）框架，将神经网络推理建模为层次化有向无环图上的主动证据累积过程。通过Dirichlet-Categorical共轭框架，神经专家从全局知识库提取正证据向量作为伪计数，实现精确的共轭信念更新；结合Gumbel-Softmax直通估计器实现硬路径路由与端到端训练。Dirichlet精度与熵提供了不确定性量化、早退、OOD拒绝和成本感知证据获取机制。理论证明了单调精度增长与边界预测方差，经验上在多项任务中达到竞争性能并提供透明路由轨迹与资源理性推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准神经网络依赖静态稠密前向计算，缺乏对证据获取过程、不确定性演化和计算何时停止的显式建模，无法模拟人类序贯、不确定性感知的决策方式。

Method: 在层次化DAG上，神经专家通过查询全局知识库提取正证据向量（伪计数），以共轭方式更新Dirichlet信念状态；使用Gumbel-Softmax直通估计器实现离散路径选择与可微训练；利用Dirichlet精度/熵进行不确定性量化与计算控制。

Result: 在图像分类、医学诊断、语言建模、部分可观测控制和贝叶斯实验设计等任务上，NBSR取得竞争性预测性能，同时提供透明路由轨迹、路径依赖证据归因、不确定性感知决策控制和资源理性推理。

Conclusion: NBSR为可解释、模块化、资源理性的智能体AI提供了数学基础扎实的框架，通过贝叶斯序贯决策统一了推理、不确定性与计算效率。

Abstract: Human decision-making is sequential and uncertainty-aware, yet standard neural networks often rely on static, dense forward computation with limited visibility into evidence acquisition, uncertainty evolution, or when computation should stop. We introduce \textbf{Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing (NBSR)}, a framework that models neural inference as active evidence accumulation over a hierarchical Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). Within a Dirichlet--Categorical conjugate framework, neural experts query a persistent global knowledge oracle to extract positive evidence vectors, which act as pseudo-counts and update a Dirichlet belief state by exact conjugate addition. Coupled with a Gumbel-Softmax Straight-Through estimator, this update enables hard, path-dependent routing while preserving surrogate gradients for end-to-end training. The resulting Dirichlet precision and entropy provide mechanisms for uncertainty quantification, entropy-based early exiting, OOD abstention, and cost-aware evidence acquisition. We prove that, under strictly positive evidence extraction, total Dirichlet precision increases monotonically along any valid trajectory and marginal predictive variance is bounded, formalizing sequential ``hypothesis sharpening''; under idealized capacity and optimization assumptions, the terminal Dirichlet expectation recovers the Bayes-optimal conditional distribution. Empirical evaluations across visual categorization, structured medical diagnosis, language modeling, partially observable control, and cost-aware Bayesian experimental design show that NBSR achieves competitive predictive performance while providing transparent routing traces, path-dependent evidence attribution, uncertainty-aware decision control, and resource-rational inference. Overall, NBSR offers a mathematically grounded framework for interpretable, modular, and resource-rational agentic AI.

</details>


### [230] [TSFMAudit: Data Contamination Auditing in Forecasting Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26161)
*Hongkai Li,Shifeng Xie,Lefei Shen,Zhuo Li,Mouxiang Chen,Xiaobin Zhang,Han Fu,Jianling Sun,Xiaoxue Ren,Chenghao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次研究时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）的预训练污染审计问题，提出TSFMAudit方法，通过探测适应动态（微调后污染数据集表现更快的损失下降和更小的骨干网络变化）来检测污染，在6个TSFM和187个数据集上验证，优于10个来自LLM领域的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型在大规模语料上预训练，评估数据集可能已被暴露导致性能估计过于乐观，而时间序列信号的连续性和异质性使得污染审计极具挑战，且缺乏语料文档记录，目前尚无相关工作。

Method: 提出TSFMAudit方法，基于探测适应动态（probe adaptation dynamics）：污染数据集在微调探测后表现出更快的损失减少和更小的骨干网络参数移动；利用文档化的训练来源证据作为监督信号进行验证。

Result: 在6个TSFM和187个数据集上评估，与10个来自LLM领域的竞争基线方法对比，TSFMAudit表现更优。

Conclusion: TSFMAudit能有效审计时间序列基础模型的预训练污染问题，为时间序列领域的模型评估可靠性提供了重要保障。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) are increasingly pretrained on large corpora, raising concerns that evaluation datasets may have been exposed during pretraining and thus yield overly optimistic performance estimates. Auditing such contamination is challenging in time series because signals are continuous and heterogeneous, and often lack corpus documentation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to study pretraining contamination auditing for TSFMs. We formalize the problem of pretraining contamination auditing for TSFMs and propose TSFMAudit, a method based on probe adaptation dynamics. Our key intuition is that contamination manifests as unusually efficient adaptation: after a fine tuning probe, contaminated datasets tend to exhibit faster loss reduction with smaller backbone movement. We evaluate TSFMAudit on 6 TSFMs and 187 datasets using documented training source evidence as supervision, and compare against 10 competitive baselines adapted from the LLM literature.

</details>


### [231] [On the Push-Based Asynchronous Federated Learning: A Bias-Correction Aggregation Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26162)
*Jiahui Bai,Hai Dong,A. K. Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PushCen-ADFL是一个通信高效的异步去中心化联邦学习框架，通过耦合通信、聚合与局部稳定在共享质心表示空间中，采用保均推求和混合纠正聚合偏差、质心正则化缓解模型漂移，以及有界发送端去重缓冲区增强异步鲁棒性，在视觉数据集上实现了高达6%的精度提升和80%以上的通信成本降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异步去中心化联邦学习(ADFL)面临频繁点对点通信、有向拓扑上的异步更新和非独立同分布数据共同导致的通信开销过大、聚合有偏和严重的模型漂移问题，亟需一种通信高效且训练稳定的方案。

Method: 1) 在共享质心表示空间中耦合通信、聚合与局部稳定，形成压缩与优化的闭环；2) 客户端交换质心形式消息，采用保均推求和混合(push-sum mixing)纠正聚合偏差；3) 轻量级质心正则化锚定在同一质心空间，缓解异构性和陈旧性导致的漂移；4) 有界发送端去重缓冲区提升异步到达不规则性下的鲁棒性。

Result: 在视觉数据集上，PushCen-ADFL在数据异构下精度提升高达6%，每次推送的通信成本降低超过80%，实现了良好的精度-通信权衡。

Conclusion: PushCen-ADFL有效解决了ADFL中通信效率与训练稳定性的矛盾，为大规模异构系统下的去中心化异步联邦学习提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Asynchronous decentralized federated learning (ADFL) eliminates central coordination and global synchronization, making it attractive for large-scale and heterogeneous systems. However, frequent peer-to-peer communication, asynchronous updates on directed topologies, and non-IID data jointly lead to excessive communication overhead, biased aggregation and severe model drift. We propose PushCen-ADFL, a communication-efficient ADFL framework that enables stable training under asymmetric communication and delayed client participation. PushCen-ADFL couples communication, aggregation, and local stabilization in a shared centroid representation space, forming a closed loop between compression and optimization. Clients exchange centroid-form messages, apply average-preserving push-sum mixing to correct aggregation bias, and use a lightweight centroid regularization anchored in the same centroid space to mitigate drift under heterogeneity and staleness. A bounded, sender-deduplicated buffer further improves robustness under irregular asynchronous arrivals. Experiments on vision datasets demonstrate that PushCen-ADFL improves accuracy under data heterogeneity by up to 6\% while reducing per-push communication cost by more than 80\%, achieving a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off.

</details>


### [232] [Planning Neural Dynamics with Lie Group Embedding through Supervised Projective Manifold Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26167)
*Tianwei Wang,Bryan Chen,Qian Zuo,Qiyue Xia,Xin Li,Wei Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出李群嵌入动态神经网络(LieEDNN)，通过伴随李群作用将李代数参数化为线性变换，实现一般李群上可学习且稳定的动力系统，并应用于机械臂操控等工程问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经ODE无法直接处理李群上的非线性表示空间中的动力学演化，且一般李群与神经网络所需的加法运算不兼容，限制了其在机器人、图形学、控制等工程领域的应用。

Method: 引入伴随李群作用将李代数线性化并映射为分块权重矩阵，使加法可在李代数向量空间中运算；基于梯度下降和流形度量投影的学习算法，对权重施加分块流形约束，保证动力系统稳定性和均衡点可学习。

Result: 在SE(3)李群上验证，应用于伸缩机械臂场景，实现了流形上具有稳定性保证的可学习动力学。

Conclusion: LieEDNN将李群的结构化表达能力与神经网络学习能力结合，为工程中具有连续对称性的流形动力学建模提供了通用框架。

Abstract: We propose Lie group embedded dynamical neural networks (LieEDNN) and the corresponding learning algorithms based on gradient descent and metric projection on smooth manifold, where we treat Lie group as an intrinsic representation for continuous symmetry of manifold geometry. Thereby we achieve learnable and stable dynamics on the underlying manifold for general Lie group, and we are able to utilize the powerful representation capability of Lie group such as SO(3) and SE(3) to solve real world engineering problems in areas such as robotics, graphics, and control. Two core challenges are: (i) General Lie groups are incompatible with addition arithmetic, which is necessary for neural network interactions. (ii) The dynamics evolve in the nonlinear representation space of special algebra rather than the normal Euclidean space, which violates the paradigm of common neural ODEs. To address these two challenges, we firstly introduce adjoint Lie group action on the Lie algebra, which induces a linear mapping and transfer to the block-wise structure of weight matrices, such that addition could operate on the Lie algebra as a vector space. Then we parameterize the Lie algebra and the adjoint action as linear transformation so that the architecture is aligned with neural network perceptrons. Explicitly, this embedding appears as block-wise manifold constraints on weights, and we develop algorithms to learn the equilibrium with stability guarantees of the temporal neural network dynamics. Experiments are implemented on a specific Lie group SE(3), with the application scenario of telescopic manipulators.

</details>


### [233] [When Rule Violations Are Rare: Chimera Training for Logical Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26171)
*Alejandro Ascarate,Leo Lebrat,Rodrigo Santa Cruz,Clinton Fookes,Olivier Salvado*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出神经规则评估器，通过将逻辑约束编译为DAG并引入嵌合体训练（特征级反事实构造），在无真实异常样本的场景下学习违反语义约束的异常检测，在CLEVRER、OpenImages、VidOR上提升了组合与关系规则的异常检测AUROC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际异常不仅是罕见输入，更是对语义约束（对象共现、动作前提、时序/关系规律）的违反。现有方法在训练时缺乏真实异常样本，难以学习规则违反的检测。

Method: 1) 将逻辑约束编译为有向无环图（DAG），为内部逻辑算子设计特征感知子树MLP门控，输出父节点表示和规则满足概率；2) 利用真实概念标签的布尔传播提供中间监督；3) 提出嵌合体训练：在特征级别拼接不同样本的子树特征，每个操作数保留其原始样本的真值标签，通过逻辑算子计算嵌合体目标，构造反事实训练样本。

Result: 在CLEVRER、OpenImages、VidOR上，该方法在规则级别的异常检测AUROC上超越独立事件基线和同图像语义训练基线，尤其在组合规则和关系规则上提升显著。

Conclusion: 该方法能有效检测语义约束违反，输出标量异常分数和规则级归因，无需真实异常样本即可训练。

Abstract: Many practical anomalies are not merely rare inputs, but violations of semantic constraints: objects co-occur in structured ways, actions imply preconditions, and events satisfy temporal or relational regularities. We study anomaly detection in this setting, where constraints are given as logical rules over learned visual concepts, but real rule violations are rare or absent during training. We propose a neural rule evaluator that compiles each constraint into a directed acyclic graph and learns feature-aware subtree MLP gates for its internal logical operators. Each gate maps child features and edge-level negations to a parent representation and a rule-satisfaction probability, with intermediate supervision obtained from exact Boolean propagation over ground-truth concept labels. The key difficulty is that same-image training data often provide insufficient coverage of informative truth configurations and also allow shortcut solutions. To address this, we introduce chimera training: an operand-level counterfactual construction at the feature level. Instead of mixing input images, we concatenate subtree features from different samples; each operand keeps the hard truth label of the sample it came from, and the chimera target is obtained by applying the node's logical operator to those inherited labels. This supplies supervised logical counterexamples without requiring real anomalous images. Across CLEVRER, OpenImages, and VidOR, the resulting evaluator improves rule-level anomaly AUROC over independent-events and same-image semantic-training baselines, especially for compositional and relational rules. The method yields both scalar anomaly scores and rule-level attributions.

</details>


### [234] [ARBITER: Reasoning Trajectory Basins and Majority Vote Failures in Test-Time Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26172)
*Meng Cai,Lars Kulik,Farhana Choudhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现语言模型在测试时采样生成的推理轨迹会聚集为少数“推理盆地”，多数投票会选择最稳定而非最准确的盆地，导致错误多数失败。提出ARBITER方法，利用模型自身的采样输出、隐藏状态和证据来建模盆地间交互，在不依赖外部信息的情况下部分恢复准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型测试时采样生成的多个推理轨迹并非独立，而是聚集为少数推理盆地，多数投票倾向于选择最稳定的盆地而非最准确的盆地，导致正确答案虽存在但被票数否决的错误多数失败。现有方法无法有效纠正这一现象。

Method: 提出ARBITER方法，包含两种变体：ARBITER-Δ在多数先验上添加同模型证据；ARBITER-Enc进一步利用完整解上的隐藏状态残差信号。该方法仅使用基模型自身的采样输出、隐藏状态和推导证据，无需外部信息。

Result: 在GSM8K上，Qwen3-4B的K=24多数投票达到约94.5%，ARBITER恢复部分top-2 oracle约96.5%的差距。在三个模型家族和三个数学基准上一致提升，无净负例；Llama-3.1-8B在MMLU-HS-Math上从约78.5%提升至约82.5%，恢复约22%的可用oracle headroom。

Conclusion: 推理轨迹的非独立性导致多数投票失败，ARBITER通过建模盆地间交互可部分恢复准确率，且零外部信息即可获得一致提升，表明样本池自身蕴含可被利用的信号。

Abstract: When language models use test-time sampling, they generate multiple reasoning trajectories and select an answer by majority vote. We show that these trajectories are not independent: for a given question, they concentrate into a small number of clusters, or reasoning basins, each defined by a normalized final answer and the solutions that reach it. A majority vote therefore selects the most stable basin rather than the most accurate one, which creates wrong-majority failures where the correct answer is present but outvoted. We introduce ARBITER, a model-agnostic approach that models interactions between basins using only the base model's own sampled outputs, hidden states, and derived evidence. Most direct correction strategies fail; ARBITER instead uses conservative additive evidence on top of consensus. In its simplest parameter-free form, ARBITER-Δ adds same-model evidence to the majority prior, while ARBITER-Enc augments this with bounded residual signals from hidden states over complete solutions. On GSM8K with Qwen3-4B, consensus over K=24 samples achieves around the mid-94% range, while a same-pool top-2 oracle reaches around the mid-96% range. ARBITER recovers a subset of these cases using zero external information. Across three model families and three math benchmarks, it yields consistent gains with no net-negative cases; for example, on Llama-3.1-8B MMLU-HS-Math, it improves accuracy from the mid-78% range to the mid-82% range, recovering about 22% of the available oracle headroom, indicating that this headroom can be partially recovered from the sample pool itself.

</details>


### [235] [InfoQuant: Shaping Activation Distributions for Low-Bit LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26175)
*Ke Li,Dong An,Xiaoling Zang,Can Ye,Liang Xie,Qibo Qiu,Chen Shen,Xiaofei He,Wenxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: InfoQuant提出了一种无需训练的激活量化方法，通过峰值抑制正交变换（PSOT）将激活分布重塑为更利于量化的形式，在W4A4KV4设置下平均保留97%的浮点精度，相比先前SOTA将LLaMA-2 13B性能差距缩小42%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特激活量化中，激活值不仅存在异常值，其分布与低比特均匀量化器不匹配，现有PTQ方法虽能抑制峰值或平衡通道，但未明确何种分布易于量化，导致量化误差仍然较大。

Method: 从信息论角度分析量化误差，提出量化友好的激活应同时具有较小的数值范围和足够的分布分散度；设计无需训练的InfoQuant方法，采用峰值抑制正交变换(PSOT)重塑激活分布，并引入自适应异常值标记选择提升优化鲁棒性。

Result: 在多种LLM家族上，InfoQuant一致优于先前的PTQ和端到端训练基线。在W4A4KV4设置下平均保留97%的浮点精度，将LLaMA-2 13B的性能差距相比之前SOTA缩小42%。

Conclusion: 从量化器面向的分布设计角度重新审视激活变换问题，通过信息论分析指导的PSOT变换有效提升了低比特激活量化的效果，无需训练即可达到优异性能。

Abstract: Low-bit activation quantization remains a major bottleneck in efficient large language model (LLM) deployment. The difficulty is not only that activations contain outliers, but that their distributions are often poorly matched to a low-bit uniform quantizer. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suppress peaks, balance channels, or minimize reconstruction error, yet they rarely specify what activation distribution is actually easy to discretize. As a result, activations may appear numerically smoother while still incurring large quantization error because the quantization range remains wide or most values collapse into a few levels near the mean. We recast activation transformation as quantizer-facing distribution design and analyze quantization error from an information-theoretic perspective. Our analysis shows that quantization-friendly activations should jointly have a smaller numerical range and sufficient dispersion within that range. Guided by this analysis, we propose InfoQuant, a train-free method that employs Peak Suppression Orthogonal Transformation (PSOT) to shape activations into more quantization-friendly distributions. We further introduce adaptive outlier-token selection to improve the robustness of PSOT during optimization. Across multiple LLM families, InfoQuant consistently outperforms prior PTQ and end-to-end training baselines. Under W4A4KV4, it preserves 97% of floating-point accuracy on average and reduces the LLaMA-2 13B performance gap by 42% over the previous state of the art. Code is available at [https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant](https://github.com/LLIKKE/InfoQuant)

</details>


### [236] [GAC: Noise-Aware Adaptive Mixing for Hybrid SFT-RL Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26184)
*Yuelin Hu,Zhenbo Yu,Zhengxue Cheng,Wei Liu,Li Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GAC方法，通过在线估计梯度方差和信号差异来自适应混合权重，在混合后训练中优于固定调度方案，训练开销小于1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合后训练中固定混合调度无法适应两种训练信号相对噪声随时间变化的问题。

Method: GAC是一种噪声感知控制器，通过在线估计梯度方差和两种训练信号之间的不一致性来推导自适应混合权重，并加入平滑、先验引导和有界更新，复用现有训练张量。

Result: 在数学、代码、科学和逻辑基准上，GAC持续优于强固定基线和基于规则的基线，在更大模型规模上提升更显著，训练开销小于1%。

Conclusion: GAC作为一种轻量级自适应混合权重方法，能有效提升混合后训练性能，且计算开销极低。

Abstract: Hybrid post-training usually combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, but fixed mixing schedules cannot adapt when the relative noise of the two signals changes over time. We propose GAC, a noise-aware controller that derives an adaptive mixing weight from online estimates of gradient variance and disagreement between the two training signals. The method adds smoothing, prior guidance, and bounded updates while reusing existing training tensors. Experiments on math, code, science, and logic benchmarks show that GAC consistently improves hybrid post-training over strong fixed and rule-based baselines, with larger gains at larger model scales and less than 1% training overhead.

</details>


### [237] [Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26189)
*Yingying Cheng,Jinquan Shi,Li Zhou,Zhiyang He,Zhaoyi Sun,Fan Zhang,Jie Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了HiF8 W8A8量化感知训练(QAT)在1B参数模型中的两种正交失败模式：amax饱和(延迟缩放估计导致的前向裁剪破坏知识敏感表示)和灾难性遗忘(激进学习率覆盖预训练常识知识)。通过64步历史窗口的保守max算法和500步BF16预热+lr=1e-5的QAT策略，最终配置在MMLU、HellaSwag、ARC-Challenge上仅分别下降0.43%、0.58%、0.22%，训练损失APE仅0.11%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低比特浮点格式的QAT在LLM部署中虽高效，但会引入标准训练指标无法检测的细微失败模式，需要系统识别和解决这些隐藏问题。

Method: 在OpenPangu-Embedded-1B上进行8组受控实验，通过延迟张量缩放(DTS)视角分析HiF8 W8A8 QAT；提出保守的64步历史窗口max算法解决amax饱和，采用500步BF16预热+lr=1e-5缓解灾难性遗忘。

Result: 最终配置相比匹配的BF16基线：MMLU下降0.43%，HellaSwag下降0.58%，ARC-Challenge下降0.22%，训练损失APE仅0.11%。两种修复措施既必要又充分。

Conclusion: amax饱和与灾难性遗忘是QAT中两种正交的失败模式，无法通过训练损失检测；所提策略能有效恢复量化模型性能至接近BF16基线水平。

Abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) with low-bit floating-point formats enables efficient LLM deployment, yet introduces subtle failure modes invisible to standard training metrics. We present a systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 QAT for OpenPangu-Embedded-1B through the lens of Delayed Tensor Scaling (DTS). Across eight controlled experiments, we identify and disentangle two orthogonal failure modes: (i)amax saturation, where delayed scale estimates silently corrupt knowledge-sensitive representations via forward-pass clipping, and (ii)catastrophic forgetting, where an aggressive learning rate overwrites pretrained commonsense knowledge independently of quantization. Neither is detectable from training loss alone. We address amax saturation with a conservative max-algorithm DTS strategy over a 64-step history window, and mitigate forgetting via a 500-step BF16 warmup followed by QAT at lr=10^{-5}. Both fixes are necessary and sufficient: our final configuration achieves 0.43% MMLU drop, 0.58% HellaSwag drop, and 0.22% ARC-Challenge drop versus a matched BF16 baseline, with a training loss APE of only 0.11% over 10,000 steps.

</details>


### [238] [HRVConformer: Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Classification from the Heart Rate signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26190)
*Shuwen Yu,William P Marnane,Geraldine B. Boylan,Gordon Lightbody*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HRVConformer，一种混合卷积-Transformer的深度学习架构，用于基于瞬时心率信号对缺氧缺血性脑病(HIE)进行分类。模型以端到端方式处理原始心率信号，在包含1,573小时的大规模数据集上训练，在测试集上达到83.23%的AUC和74.56%的准确率，优于Transformer、ResNet50和全卷积网络等基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统HIE分类方法依赖手工特征，无法充分捕捉心率信号中的局部和长程依赖关系，亟需一种能够端到端处理原始心率信号、同时捕获局部与全局特征的自动分类方法。

Method: 提出HRVConformer架构，融合卷积层（局部特征提取）与Transformer注意力机制（全局上下文建模），采用改进的Pan-Tompkins算法从ECG中提取心率信号，使用监督学习在1,573小时心率数据（含259小时专家标注和大量弱标注数据）上训练。

Result: 在测试集上，HRVConformer达到83.23%的AUC和74.56%的准确率，性能优于Transformer、ResNet50和全卷积网络基线。

Conclusion: 卷积与Transformer组件的有效集成能够提升基于心率信号的HIE分类性能，为自动化HIE评估提供了有前景的方向。

Abstract: This paper presents the HRVConformer, a novel deep learning architecture for the classification of hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) using the instantaneous heart rate (HR) signal. Unlike conventional approaches that rely on handcrafted features, HRVConformer directly processes raw HR signals in an end-to-end manner, capturing both local and long-range dependencies through a hybrid Convolution-Transformer framework. By integrating convolutional layers for local feature extraction and Transformer-based attention mechanisms for global context modelling, the architecture effectively enhances signal representation and classification performance. The model was trained using supervised learning on a large HR dataset consisting of 1,573 one-hour epochs, including 259 one-hour expert-annotated epochs and a substantial set of weakly labelled data. A 314-hour validation set provided a robust performance estimation, while an independent 215-hour dataset with expert annotations was reserved for final testing. HR signals were extracted from electrocardiogram (ECG) recordings using an improved Pan-Tompkins algorithm, which significantly enhanced both signal quality and data availability. Experimental results demonstrate that the HRVConformer achieves an AUC of 83.23\% and accuracy of 74.56\% on the test set. These results surpass the performance of the Transformer, ResNet50 and fully convolutional networks baselines, highlighting the advantages of integrating convolutional and Transformer-based components for HR-based HIE classification. The proposed method provides a promising step toward a more accurate and automated assessment of HIE using HR signals. The code is available at: https://github.com/syu-kylin/HRVConformer.

</details>


### [239] [Modeling Dynamic Mixtures of Time-Delay Systems from Streaming Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26191)
*Ren Fujiwara,Yasuko Matsubara,Yasushi Sakurai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DelayMix，一种将流式时间序列视为动态混合时延系统的在线框架，通过固定长度的马尔可夫参数张量总结历史状态，在保持鲁棒性的同时减少内存使用，实现对环境变化和延迟变化的快速自适应建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列数据流中，系统快速变化（如环境因素或输入延迟变化导致的体制转换）会降低模型性能，且使用多个小模型来适配不同时间序列模式时存在准确性、鲁棒性和内存使用之间的权衡问题。

Method: 将流式时间序列建模为动态混合的时延系统；使用系统马尔可夫参数序列构建固定长度的摘要系统张量，同时捕获动态行为和延迟特征；必要时通过张量分解算法从张量中提取相关历史模型并选择最适配当前体制的系统。

Result: 在真实数据集上，DelayMix在预测准确性和延迟适应速度上 consistently 优于其他方法，尤其在高非平稳数据上表现突出。

Conclusion: 该框架能快速适应环境变化且计算高效，有效解决了自适应建模中准确率、鲁棒性和内存使用之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: This research addresses the problem of adaptive modeling in time-series data streams with clear input-output relationships. This problem is challenging because rapid system changes (regime shifts) caused by environmental factors or input delay changes degrade model performance, and the trade-off among accuracy, robustness, and memory usage arises when using multiple small models for each time-series pattern. To address these issues, this paper presents an online framework/method that treats streaming time series as dynamic mixtures of time-delay systems. This framework maintains robustness of model tracking and reduces memory usage by summarizing past regimes using a fixed-length representation that captures both the system dynamics and input-output delays. Concretely, this approach constructs a summary system tensor using the system's Markov parameter series, capturing both dynamic behavior and delay characteristics. If necessary, a tensor decomposition algorithm extracts relevant past models from the tensor and helps select the system that best fits the current regime. This method enables rapid adaptation to environmental changes and is computationally efficient. Tests on real datasets show that DelayMix consistently outperforms other methods, achieving superior forecast accuracy and faster adaptation to delays, especially for highly non-stationary data.

</details>


### [240] [Co-folding model guided by structural proteomics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26192)
*Alon Shtrikman,Nitzan Simchi,Michal Ran Shchory,Sagie Brodsky,Eran Seger,Kirill Pevzner*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AIMS-Fold是一个推理时引导扩散框架，通过整合XL-MS空间约束和HDX-MS溶剂可及性分布等结构蛋白质组学数据，引导蛋白质生成轨迹，在挑战性的诱导接近靶点上优于Boltz-2等纯计算模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有蛋白质结构生成模型虽能从序列预测静态结构，但无法捕捉蛋白质复合物的正确构象状态，这对蛋白质设计和诱导接近药物（如抗体、PROTACs）至关重要。而结构蛋白质组学数据（XL-MS、HDX-MS）提供的空间和动态信息未能有效整合到这些模型中。

Method: 提出AIMS-Fold框架，采用推理时引导扩散方法，利用可微物理势能（来自XL-MS空间约束和HDX-MS溶剂可及性分布）主动引导扩散模型的生成采样轨迹。

Result: XL-MS和HDX-MS各自提升预测精度，二者整合产生协同效应。在诱导接近靶点上，AIMS-Fold精度高于Boltz-2等无引导的最先进模型。

Conclusion: AIMS-Fold建立了一种强大的整合计算范式，可用于诱导接近药物的基于结构的药物设计。

Abstract: Protein structure generative models excel at predicting single protein static structures from sequence, but routinely fail to capture the correct conformational state of protein complexes, critical for protein design and induced proximity modalities such as antibodies and PROTACs. While structural proteomics techniques like Cross-Linking Mass Spectrometry (XL-MS) and Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange (HDX-MS) offer valuable spatial and dynamic insights, integrating these sparse, heterogeneous measurements into these models remains an open challenge. Here, we bridge this gap by combining structural proteomics data with the rich biophysical priors learned by pretrained diffusion models. We introduce AIMS-Fold, an inference-time guided-diffusion framework that actively steers the generative sampling trajectory using differentiable physical potentials derived from XL-MS spatial restraints and HDX-MS solvent accessibility profiles. We demonstrate that these structural methods individually enhance predictive accuracy, and their integration yields synergistic improvement. Crucially, by leveraging these experimental restraints, AIMS-Fold achieves higher accuracy on challenging induced proximity targets than purely computational, unguided state-of-the-art models like Boltz-2. This establishes our framework as a powerful, integrative computational approach for the structure based drug design of induced proximity drugs. Evaluation code will be made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [241] [Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26193)
*Qideng Tang,Dai Chaofan,Wubin Ma,Yahui Wu,Haohao Zhou,Tao Zhang,Huan Li,Dalin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CoAD框架，通过统一分类（Outlier Exposure）和重建（Masked Autoencoder）两种范式，利用分类模块生成概率软掩码指导重建模块，同时重建模块缓解分类模块的泛化问题，实现了对微妙和复杂时序异常的有效检测，在严格评估协议下显著优于现有方法，且计算效率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度TSAD方法难以检测微妙和持续异常；OE方法泛化能力差，MAE方法存在掩码对齐问题，两种范式各有局限。

Method: 提出CoAD框架，统一分类与重建双范式：分类模块生成概率引导的软掩码提供给重建模块，重建模块反过来缓解分类模块的泛化问题；分类模块还针对分类粒度过粗和忽略频率信息的问题进行了专门设计。

Result: 在高质量基准数据集上，CoAD显著优于当前最先进的深度学习和传统数据挖掘方法；同时轻量级且速度远快于现有SOTA方法。

Conclusion: CoAD证明了深度学习在TSAD中的潜力，通过协同设计实现优劣互补，兼具高检测精度和实际部署价值。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) has long been a hot research topic in data mining due to its various applications. Recent studies challenge the effectiveness of popular deep learning methods for TSAD, suggesting their failure in detecting subtle and prolonged anomalies. Outlier Exposure (OE) and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) emerge as two promising paradigms (classification and reconstruction) for solving the above problems. However, OE-based methods are constrained by poor generalization, while MAE-based methods are limited by masking misalignment issues. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel framework, CoAD, which unifies the two paradigms to leverage their complementary strengths while mitigating their respective weaknesses. In this framework, the classification module generates probability-informed soft masks for the reconstruction module, which in turn alleviates the generalization problem of the classification module. This cooperative design enables CoAD to effectively detect subtle and complex anomalies that are often overlooked by existing methods. Additionally, the classification module is carefully designed to resolve issues related to improper classification granularity and the neglect of frequency information. Extensive experiments on high-quality benchmark datasets, conducted under rigorous evaluation protocols, demonstrate that CoAD significantly outperforms both state-of-the-art deep learning and traditional data mining methods, highlighting the potential of deep learning in TSAD. Moreover, CoAD is lightweight and substantially faster than existing SOTA methods, demonstrating its practical value for large-scale, real-time applications.

</details>


### [242] [On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26194)
*Sharmita Dey,Diego Paez-Granados*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PathoFM是一种面向病理性步态分析的多目标预训练Transformer，通过局部重建、时间连续性和无监督上下文动态三种互补目标联合学习，在脊髓损伤患者的小样本异质性数据集上实现了跨任务类型（分类/回归）和跨受试者的鲁棒表征迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床时间序列学习受限于小样本、异质性队列和协议漂移，同时下游任务涵盖分类和回归。这使基础模型预训练具有吸引力，但核心问题是：预训练目标应施加何种归纳偏置，才能使表征跨任务类型和跨受试者有效迁移？

Method: 提出PathoFM，一种以编码器为中心的Transformer，在多元步态窗口上使用三个互补目标进行预训练：(1)局部完成——重建连续掩码跨度以强化局部结构；(2)时间连续性——从观察前缀预测掩码的中期延续以强化平滑性和因果一致性；(3)无监督上下文动态——通过注意力机制基于受试者样本窗口进行支持-查询重建。

Result: 实证比较三类目标族（分组/对比、基于动力学、生成式重建）发现：动力学为中心的混合目标产生最均衡的迁移效果。分组目标有利于判别边界但降低连续目标所需的幅度保真度；仅重建目标保留波形结构但分类性能不足。综合局部重建与时间连续性，并在可获得样本时添加上下文条件化，可获得鲁棒的受试者泛化表征。

Conclusion: 对于临床时间序列的跨任务迁移学习，动力学为中心的混合预训练目标（特别是局部重建+时间连续性+上下文条件化）比单一目标族更有效，能平衡分类与回归任务的需求。

Abstract: Clinical time-series learning is routinely constrained by small, heterogeneous cohorts and protocol drift, while its downstream use spans both classification (e.g., pathology diagnosis) and regression (e.g., temporal forecasting). These constraints make foundation-model pretraining appealing, but raises an important question of which inductive biases should the pretraining objective impose so that representations transfer across task types and subjects. We study this question in pathological gait analysis for spinal cord injury (SCI) via PathoFM, an encoder-centric transformer pretrained on multivariate gait windows with three complementary objectives: Local Completion (reconstruct contiguous masked spans to enforce local structure), Temporal Continuity (predict a masked mid-horizon continuation from an observed prefix to enforce smoothness and causal consistency), and Unsupervised In-Context Dynamics (support-query reconstruction conditioned on subject exemplar windows via attention). Empirically comparing objective families (grouping/contrastive, dynamics-based, and generative reconstruction), we find that dynamics-centric mixtures produce the most balanced transfer: grouping objectives favor discriminative margins but can degrade magnitude fidelity needed for continuous targets, whereas reconstruction-only objectives preserve waveform structure but may underperform on classification. Overall, combining local reconstruction with temporal continuity, and adding in-context conditioning when exemplar access is realistic, yields robust subject-generalizing representations.

</details>


### [243] [From Privacy to Generalization: Linear Max-Information Bounds for DP-SGD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26222)
*Christoph H. Lampert,Hossein Zakerinia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了DP-SGD的近似最大信息量具有与ε-差分隐私算法相当的有限样本界（与数据集大小呈线性关系），并由此得到了PAC-Bayes泛化界（先验分布可由DP-SGD学习）以及DP-SGD训练模型自身的显式泛化界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解泛化与隐私之间的关系是现代机器学习理论的核心挑战，尤其对于由差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）训练的深度网络而言，这一开放问题长期未得到解决。

Method: 通过证明DP-SGD的近似最大信息量（approximate max-information）的有限样本界，该界与数据集大小呈线性关系，与Dwork等人（2015）关于ε-差分隐私算法的经典结果具有可比性。

Result: 1) 获得了DP-SGD的近似最大信息量的有限样本界，其缩放性质与ε-差分隐私算法相当；2) 得到了通用PAC-Bayes泛化界，其中先验分布可由DP-SGD自身学习；3) 得到了DP-SGD训练模型的泛化界，复杂度项完全显式且受优化超参数控制。

Conclusion: 本研究弥合了差分隐私与泛化理论之间的缺口，证明DP-SGD的隐私保护机制能够提供可量化的泛化保证，且泛化复杂度可由训练超参数显式调控。

Abstract: Understanding the relationship between generalization and privacy remains a central challenge in modern machine learning theory, particularly for deep networks trained by variants of differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD). In this work we make progress on this persistent open problem by proving a finite-sample bound on the approximate max-information of DP-SGD that exhibits scaling properties comparable with (Dwork et al, 2015)'s classic result for $ε$-differentially private algorithms, namely at most linear in the dataset size. From our result we obtain a general-purpose PAC-Bayes generalization bound in which the necessary prior distribution can be learned by DP-SGD, as well as a generalization bound for DP-SGD-trained models themselves, with a complexity term that is fully explicit and controlled by the optimization hyperparameters.

</details>


### [244] [Provably Communication-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Federated Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26243)
*Zhishuai Guo,Wenhan Wu,Chen Chen,Lei Zhang,Olivera Kotevska,Ravi K Madduri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CE-FedGNN提出了一种通信高效且隐私保护的去中心化图神经网络框架，通过低频交换聚合节点表示、移动平均估计器处理跨客户端依赖和过时性，并采用度量差分隐私提供隐私保障，在合成银行反洗钱和引文网络数据集上取得了良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界的图数据常分散在不同组织间，因隐私和政策约束无法共享原始数据。现有联邦GNN方法要么忽略跨客户端链接导致精度下降，要么频繁交换嵌入带来巨大的通信和隐私成本。

Method: 1) 低频交换聚合节点表示而非逐轮嵌入，降低通信开销；2) 移动平均估计器持续追踪节点表示，实现跨轮稳定重用，处理过时性；3) 采用度量差分隐私框架，基于嵌入空间距离度量隐私，在噪声水平上比标准差分隐私更灵活；4) 通过Rényi差分隐私组合推导(ε,δ)-metric-DP保证。

Result: 在合成银行反洗钱基准和引文网络数据集上，CE-FedGNN在显著降低通信开销的同时保持强性能，且在隐私保护噪声下具有鲁棒性；理论收敛率达到O(1/√T)，通信复杂度为O(T^{3/4})。

Conclusion: CE-FedGNN成功解决了耦合图数据联邦学习中跨客户端依赖与隐私保护的矛盾，实现了通信效率与隐私保障的有效平衡。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong performance on relational data, but real-world graphs are often distributed across organizations that cannot share raw data due to privacy and policy constraints. Existing federated GNN methods either ignore cross-client links, leading to degraded accuracy, or require frequent embedding exchanges, incurring substantial communication and privacy costs. We propose CE-FedGNN, a communication-efficient and privacy-preserving federated GNN framework for learning over such coupled graphs. Our approach avoids sharing raw data or per-round embeddings by infrequently exchanging aggregated node representations. To handle cross-client dependency and staleness, we introduce a moving-average estimator that continuously tracks node representations and enables their stable reuse across rounds. To provide formal privacy guarantees for the released representations, we adopt the metric differential privacy (metric-DP) framework, which measures privacy with respect to distances in the learned embedding space rather than worst-case input perturbations. This yields meaningful guarantees at noise levels where standard differential privacy becomes overly conservative. We establish convergence to a stationary point at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ with $O(T^{3/4})$ communication complexity. In addition, we derive $(\varepsilon,δ)$-metric-DP guarantees via Rényi differential privacy composition under a public-cohort threat model. Experiments on synthetic interbank anti-money laundering benchmarks and citation networks demonstrate that CE-FedGNN achieves strong performance while significantly reducing communication and maintaining robustness under privacy-preserving noise.

</details>


### [245] [The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26246)
*Guanghui Wang,Kaiwen Lv Kacuila,Zhiyong Yang,Zitai Wang,Jin-Wen Wu,Longtao Huang,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Bridge-Garden分解理论，揭示了知识蒸馏中混合硬标签与软标签能降低暴露偏差（exposure bias），并基于此开发了Bridge-Garden混合监督方法，在多种大语言模型（Qwen、Llama、Gemma、DeepSeek）上优于现有KD方法，同时降低9.7倍训练成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管软标签理论上比硬标签信息更丰富，但实践中混合硬软标签效果更好，现有理论无法解释这一现象。作者旨在揭示混合策略有效的根本原因，并据此设计更优的蒸馏方法。

Method: 提出Bridge-Garden分解理论，将生成步骤分为两类：Bridge（下一token必须精确匹配）和Garden（下一token可灵活选择）。硬标签在Bridge中避免风险偏差，软标签在Garden中保持多样性，混合策略通过自适应平衡两者来降低暴露偏差。基于该理论开发了Bridge-Garden混合监督方法族。

Result: 在7组教师-学生对（Qwen、Llama、Gemma、DeepSeek）及推理、编程基准上，所提方法超越基于散度的KD和on-policy KD基线，同时训练成本降低9.7倍。

Conclusion: 混合硬软标签优于纯软标签的根本原因在于降低了暴露偏差，而非更接近教师分布。Bridge-Garden理论为设计高效知识蒸馏策略提供了新视角。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student. In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (hard labels) or the teacher's full next-token distribution (soft labels). Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results. Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training. Instead, it comes from reduced exposure bias, the mismatch between training and inference distributions. To explain this phenomenon, we introduce the Bridge-Garden Decomposition theory, which categorizes generation steps into two types: Bridges, where the next token must be exact, and Gardens, where it can be flexible. We show that hard-only KD excels in Bridges by avoiding risky deviations, while soft-only KD preserves diversity in Gardens. A hybrid strategy handles both cases and, as a result, reduces exposure bias across the sequence. Guided by this theory, we develop a family of Bridge-Garden hybrid supervision methods that adaptively balance hard and soft labels. Across a primary suite of seven teacher-student pairs (including Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek) and benchmarks in reasoning and coding, our approach outperforms divergence-based and on-policy KD baselines while reducing training cost by 9.7x, enabling efficient model compression. Code is available at https://github.com/ghwang-s/bridge_garden_hybrid_kd_release.

</details>


### [246] [Unified Neural Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26248)
*Ethan Caballero,Priyank Jaini,David Krueger,Irina Rish*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种统一神经缩放定律（UNSL），能够同时建模和推断深度神经网络在多个维度（模型参数、数据集大小、训练步数、推理步数、计算量及各种超参数）上的缩放行为，在视觉、语言、数学和强化学习等多种任务上比现有缩放函数形式更准确地预测缩放行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的神经缩放定律通常只考虑单一维度的缩放（如仅模型参数或仅数据量），缺乏能够同时建模多个维度联合变化影响的统一函数形式，因而难以准确预测实际中多维度同时变化时的模型性能。

Method: 提出了一种统一神经缩放定律（UNSL），这是一种函数形式，能够同时将模型参数数量、训练数据集大小、训练步数、推理步数、计算量及各种超参数作为输入，建模它们对评估指标的联合影响。

Result: 在大规模视觉、语言、数学和强化学习等多种上游和下游任务上，UNSL相比其他缩放函数形式，对缩放行为的推断显著更准确。

Conclusion: UNSL作为统一的缩放定律函数形式，能更准确地建模和预测多维度同时变化下的深度神经网络性能缩放行为，为理解模型缩放规律提供了更全面的框架。
