Abstract: We present a functional form (that we refer to as a Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL)) that accurately models and extrapolates the scaling behaviors of deep neural networks as multiple dimensions all vary simultaneously (i.e. how the evaluation metric of interest varies as one simultaneously varies the number of model parameters, training dataset size, number of training steps, number of inference steps, amount of compute, and various hyperparameters) for various architectures and for each of various tasks within a varied set of upstream and downstream tasks. This set includes large-scale vision, language, math, and reinforcement learning. When compared to other functional forms for neural scaling, this functional form yields extrapolations of scaling behavior that are considerably more accurate on this set.

</details>


### [247] [Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26266)
*Tuna Tuncer,Felix Becker,Thomas Pfeil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对视频扩散模型中KV缓存量化导致的质量下降问题，本文发现根本原因是softmax注意力中的Jensen偏差——量化噪声使缓存的键注意力权重膨胀。提出一种基于泰勒展开的在线校正方法，在INT2量化下恢复接近BF16的视频质量，比INT4节省50%内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分块自回归视频扩散模型依赖KV缓存避免冗余计算，但长视频下缓存成为内存瓶颈。量化KV缓存到低比特虽能减少内存压力，却会严重降低视频质量，需要探索该质量下降的原因及解决方案。

Method: 理论分析发现量化噪声在softmax注意力中导致Jensen偏差：由于指数函数的凸性，量化后的键会从当前未量化的块中"窃取"注意力权重。推导出每个注意力分数的在线校正项，基于缓存键的量化步长和查询范数计算，利用二阶泰勒近似使额外计算开销可忽略。

Result: 在MAGI-1、SkyReels-V2和HY-WorldPlay三个模型上评估，INT2量化下该方法恢复了大部分因激进量化损失的质量，达到接近BF16的视频质量，且优于INT4量化同时减少50%内存使用。

Conclusion: 提出了一种轻量级、无需额外内存的注意力偏差校正方法，有效解决了低比特量化KV缓存在视频扩散模型中的质量退化问题，实现了内存效率与视频质量的良好权衡。

Abstract: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contribution of cached keys, a phenomenon we call the Jensen bias. This effect causes quantized keys to steal attention mass from the unquantized current chunk. We derive a per-attention-score correction that removes this bias in expectation, computed on the fly from the quantization step sizes of the cached keys and the query norm. Using a second-order Taylor approximation, the additional computational overhead is negligible, and no additional memory is needed alongside the cache. Evaluated on MAGI-1, SkyReels-V2, and HY-WorldPlay at INT2 quantization, our correction recovers most of the quality lost to aggressive quantization, reaching near-BF16 video quality, and can outperform INT4 quantization while using 50% less memory.

</details>


### [248] [DeepInterestGR: Mining Deep Multi-Interest Using Multi-Modal LLMs for Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.18907)
*Yangchen Zeng,Zhenyu Yu,Zhiyuan Hu,Wenxin Zhang,Jinze Wang,Rongfeng Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DeepInterestGR框架，通过多LLM兴趣挖掘、奖励标记深度兴趣和兴趣增强的物品离散化技术，解决生成式推荐中的"浅层兴趣"问题，在三个Amazon数据集上相比14个基线模型实现HR@10提升5.8%-8.3%、NDCG@10提升7.7%-9.9%，跨领域泛化提升24.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法仅依赖表面文本特征（浅层兴趣），无法捕捉用户潜在动机，导致个性化深度不足和推荐可解释性差。

Method: 提出DeepInterestGR框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 多LLM兴趣挖掘(MLIM)通过结构化推理提示提取用户深层兴趣；2) 奖励标记深度兴趣(RLDI)进行质量控制；3) 基于RQ-VAE的兴趣增强物品离散化(IEID)。采用两阶段SFT-GRPO训练流程，由兴趣感知奖励引导。

Result: 在Amazon Beauty、Sports、Instruments三个数据集上，相比SASRec、BERT4Rec、TIGER、LC-Rec、S-DPO等14个基线，HR@10提升5.8%-8.3%，NDCG@10提升7.7%-9.9%，跨领域泛化提升24.8%。

Conclusion: 融入深度语义兴趣能够有效改进基于SID的生成式推荐性能。

Abstract: We introduce DeepInterestGR, a novel framework that integrates deep interest mining into the generative recommendation pipeline. This addresses the "Shallow Interest" problem - existing generative methods rely on surface-level textual features and fail to capture latent user motivations, limiting personalization depth and recommendation interpretability. Our approach leverages Multi-LLM Interest Mining (MLIM) via structured reasoning prompting, Reward-Labeled Deep Interest (RLDI) for quality control, and Interest-Enhanced Item Discretization (IEID) via RQ-VAE, combined with a two-stage SFT-GRPO training pipeline guided by an Interest-Aware Reward. We validate DeepInterestGR on three Amazon Review benchmarks (Beauty, Sports, Instruments), comparing against 14 state-of-the-art baselines including SASRec, BERT4Rec, TIGER, LC-Rec, and S-DPO. Our method achieves 5.8%-8.3% relative improvements on HR@10 and 7.7%-9.9% on NDCG@10 over the strongest baseline, with cross-domain generalization gains of +24.8%. These results provide evidence that incorporating deep semantic interests can effectively improve SID-based generative recommendation.

</details>


### [249] [Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26282)
*Xiaoyuan Cheng,Wenxuan Yuan,Zhancun Mu,Yuanzhao Zhang,Yiming Yang,Hai Wang,Zhuo Sun,Che Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MBDPO框架，通过扩散策略表示统一世界模型中的搜索与策略优化，解决结构不对齐问题，在离线预训练、在线学习和微调中均表现优异，且随模型容量增加性能持续提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的强化学习方法存在模型偏差和误差累积问题，但更关键的是搜索与值学习之间的结构不对齐——策略改进依赖于非搜索策略诱导的值函数，导致训练不一致和次优学习。

Method: 提出MBDPO框架，将策略优化重新表述为潜在世界模型中搜索轨迹上的扩散过程，从收集的数据集中提取隐式能量函数来锚定策略，通过优化得分场来缓解不对齐问题。

Result: 在多任务离线预训练、在线学习和离线到在线微调等多种设置下进行评估，离线预训练中观察到随模型容量增加性能持续单调提升的良好扩展行为。

Conclusion: MBDPO通过扩散策略表示统一搜索与策略优化，有效解锁了世界模型在可扩展策略学习中的潜力。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) can be effectively supported at scale through the use of world models. However, in practice, scaling such approaches remains fundamentally limited. A commonly recognized challenge is model bias and error compounding, which degrade long-horizon predictions. Beyond these issues, we identify a more critical yet underexplored bottleneck: a structural misalignment between search and value learning in existing world model approaches. In particular, policy improvement often relies on value functions induced by a separate, non-search policy, resulting in training inconsistency and ultimately suboptimal learning. To address this limitation, we propose Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization (MBDPO) in world models, a framework that unifies search and policy optimization through diffusion policy representations, thereby unlocking the potential of world models for scalable policy learning. Instead of constructing an explicit planner over a learned world model, we reformulate policy optimization as a diffusion process over searched trajectories in latent world models. In this view, we extract an implicit energy function from the collected dataset that anchors the policy, enabling MBDPO to refine the score field for policy optimization while mitigating misalignment. We evaluate MBDPO across a wide range of settings, including multi-task offline pretraining, online learning, and offline-to-online fine-tuning. In the offline regime, we further investigate its scaling behavior by pretraining on large-scale datasets, observing consistent and monotonic performance gains with increasing model capacity.

</details>


### [250] [Two-Parameter Flows for Learning Population Dynamics of Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26285)
*Paul Schwerdtner,Tobias Blickhan,Benjamin Peherstorfer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需轨迹数据、仅利用无标签样本学习高维概率密度随时间演化的方法。通过两参数流先学习从基分布到各时刻边缘分布的采样时间传输，再对合成的耦合轨迹回归提取物理时间速度，从而获得唯一且正则的动力学。该方法可扩展至高维，无需每步最优传输耦合，并支持非梯度动力学（如旋转/循环现象）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在无轨迹信息的情况下学习高维概率密度演化存在困难，且通常局限于梯度流或需要每步最优传输耦合，无法自然解释旋转/循环等非梯度物理现象。

Method: 引入两参数流：1）利用条件流匹配技术学习从基分布到各边缘分布的采样时间传输；2）在合成耦合轨迹上回归物理时间速度场，证明该速度场的唯一性及正则性继承自采样时间传输。

Result: 证明所提取的物理时间动力学唯一且继承采样时间传输的正则性；方法可扩展至高维，避免每步最优传输耦合；支持非梯度动力学，能自然地解释旋转或循环物理现象。

Conclusion: 基于条件流匹配的两参数流框架为无轨迹数据的高维概率密度演化学习提供了有效且灵活的解决方案，尤其适用于存在旋转/循环等非梯度动力学的场景。

Abstract: This work addresses the problem of learning the dynamics of high-dimensional probability densities over time using unlabeled samples, without assuming access to trajectory information. We introduce two-parameter flows that learn only sampling-time transports from a base distribution to each marginal and then extract a physics-time velocity by regressing on coupled synthetic trajectories. We prove that the resulting physics-time dynamics are unique and inherit regularity from the sampling-time transports. Because we can build on standard, well-developed conditional flow matching techniques for learning the base-to-marginal transports, our approach scales to high dimensions and avoids per-step optimal-transport couplings, while allowing admissible non-gradient dynamics that can naturally explain rotational or circulating physics phenomena.

</details>


### [251] [Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26289)
*Victor Norgren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种有状态推理架构，通过持久化KV缓存、基数前缀缓存和提示查找投机解码，将多智能体工具调用场景下每次对话的成本从O(n_t)降至O(Δ_t)，在6轮和35轮工作流中分别实现了每轮2.1倍和4.2倍的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM推理框架将每次工具调用视为独立请求，即使85-95%的提示内容与上一轮相同，也从头重新处理整个对话，导致计算效率低下。

Method: 提出有状态推理架构，包含三个关键组件：(1) 持久化KV缓存跨轮次存活，仅增量吸收新token；(2) 基数前缀缓存将复用扩展至交错的多智能体流量；(3) 提示查找投机解码加速结构化输出。

Result: 与vLLM和SGLang相比，在6轮智能体工作流中每轮加速2.1倍，在35轮工作流的中位数轮次上加速4.2倍，端到端墙钟时间减半。

Conclusion: 该方法通过有状态复用和投机解码而非传统缓存机制实现了显著的推理加速，有效解决了多智能体工具调用场景中的计算冗余问题。

Abstract: Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.
  We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by ingesting only the new tokens, while a radix prefix cache extends this across interleaved multi-agent traffic and a prompt-lookup speculative decoder accelerates structured output. Against vLLM and SGLang on novel, fully-generated workloads, the reference implementation is $2.1\times$ faster per turn on a 6-turn agentic workflow and $4.2\times$ on the median turn of a 35-turn one, halving end-to-end wall time. The advantage comes from stateful reuse and speculation, not caching.

</details>


### [252] [Dynamic Link Prediction with Temporally Enhanced Signed Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26290)
*Derek Regier,Andrew Polyak,Aresh Dadlani,Khosro Salmani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向时序符号图网络的模块化时间增强框架，通过历史上下文整合模块(HCIM)融合可学习时间加权、LSTM轨迹建模和多头时间注意力，在保持可解释性的同时显著提升了符号图Transformer的时序链接预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序符号网络(TSNs)中符号关系、结构演化和平衡理论约束的相互作用使得有效学习存在挑战，现有GNN方法主要针对静态或无符号链接预测，缺乏专门处理时序符号图的学习框架。

Method: 提出模块化时间增强框架，包含HCIM模块：(1)可学习的时效感知时间加权；(2)LSTM嵌入轨迹建模；(3)多头时间注意力。采用全局或节点自适应加权融合历史信息，实例化于SE-SGformer架构。

Result: 在Bitcoin OTC、Bitcoin Alpha、Reddit和小世界网络模型上取得一致且统计显著的性能提升。

Conclusion: 模块化时间增强框架能有效提升静态符号GNN在时序符号网络上的表现，且保持了架构无关性和可解释性。

Abstract: Temporal signed networks (TSNs) model the time evolution of cooperative and adversarial relationships that arise in applications such as social media analysis, trust and reputation systems, and financial transaction networks. While graph neural networks (GNNs) perform well for static or unsigned link prediction, effective learning in temporal signed graphs remains challenging due to the interaction of signed relations, evolving structure, and balance-theoretic constraints. To address this gap, we propose a \emph{modular} temporal enhancement framework for signed GNNs that integrates historical context into otherwise static architectures. The framework introduces a Historical Context Integration Module (HCIM) that combines learnable recency-aware temporal weighting, LSTM-based embedding trajectory modeling, and multi-head temporal attention to capture both short- and long-term signed interaction dynamics. Historical information is fused with current node representations using either global or node-adaptive weighting, allowing the architecture-agnostic framework to accommodate heterogeneous temporal behaviors. We instantiate the approach on the Self-Explainable Signed Graph Transformer (SE-SGformer), preserving interpretability while extending it with temporal awareness. Experiments on real-world and synthetic TSNs, including Bitcoin OTC, Bitcoin Alpha, Reddit, and small-world network models, demonstrate consistent and statistically significant improvements over the static baseline.

</details>


### [253] [Classification and detection of multiple UAVs using rational Gaussian wavelet neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26310)
*Ungvári Gergő,Ferenc Braun,Attila Ámon,Péter Kackstädter,János Volk,Péter Kovács,Tamás Dózsa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于声音信号的无人机检测系统，采用可解释的自适应有理高斯小波特征提取器结合小型神经网络，能够有效检测和分类单个无人机及无人机群，在室内外环境中均优于传统机器学习方法，同时保持了高度的可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保护民用和军用基础设施需要有效的无人机检测手段，现有方法需要更经济且可解释的解决方案。

Method: 使用麦克风采集声音信号，通过可解释的自适应有理高斯小波进行特征提取，将自适应小波变换嵌入并与小型神经网络联合训练，实现无人机检测与分类。

Result: 在室内录音棚和嘈杂室外环境中的实验表明，该方法在检测和分类单个无人机及无人机群方面优于传统机器学习方法。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法不仅性能优越，且具有高可解释性，代码已开源以支持可复现性。

Abstract: The detection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is important for the protection of civilian and military infrastructure. In this paper we propose a cost effective UAV detection system using sound signals obtained from microphones. The recorded signals are passed through a signal processing pipeline which employs interpretable adaptive feature extractors using so-called rational Gaussian wavelets. These adaptive wavelet transformations are embedded into and trained together with an underlying small neural network which detects and classifies UAVs based on the obtained features. This leads to a physically interpretable machine learning algorithm that in addition to classifying UAVs is also capable of detecting UAV swarms. We demonstrate our results using data collected in indoor studio and noisy outdoor environments. We conclude that the proposed method outperforms traditional machine learning approaches for detecting and classifying single UAVs as well as drone swarms, while retaining a high degree of interpretability. Our implementation of the proposed methods is made publicly available for reproducibility.

</details>


### [254] [Curriculum Learning for Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26315)
*Sandeep Kumar,Virginia Smith,Chhavi Yadav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Staged-Competence课程学习框架，通过按难度组织偏好数据、基于能力采样、渐进更新参考模型，显著提升了DPO安全对齐的鲁棒性，OOD有害响应率降低16%，越狱攻击成功率降低20%，且仅需75%的训练数据即可匹配基线安全性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO在安全对齐中存在脆性问题，尤其是在分布外（OOD）场景下泛化能力差，现有方法未能有效解决这一局限性。

Method: 提出Staged-Competence框架：1) 按难度组织偏好数据；2) 采用基于当前模型能力的采样策略；3) 训练过程中渐进式更新参考模型。该框架与策略优化损失无关，可扩展至其他DPO变体。

Result: 在三个模型家族上平均OOD有害响应率降低16%，越狱攻击成功率降低20%，近零过度拒绝，保留通用能力。仅用75%训练数据即可匹配基线安全性能，且能更好分离安全与不安全响应。

Conclusion: 课程学习能有效提升DPO安全对齐的鲁棒性，Staged-Competence框架具有通用性，可应用于其他DPO变体和对齐领域。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) is widely used for safety alignment in large language models. However, prior work shows it is brittle and exhibits poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation. In this paper, we investigate whether Curriculum Learning can improve the robustness of DPO-based safety alignment. We propose Staged-Competence, a curriculum-based framework that organises preference data by difficulty, employs competence-based sampling, and progressively updates the reference model during training. Averaged across three model families, Staged-Competence reduces OOD harmful response rates by 16% and jailbreak attack success rates by 20%, while preserving general capabilities with near-zero over-refusal. We further show that Staged-Competence (1) matches baseline safety with only 75% of the training data and (2) yields better separation between safe and unsafe responses. Staged-Competence is agnostic to the policy optimisation loss and can extend to other DPO variants and alignment domains. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Sandeep5500/curriculum-learning-for-safety.

</details>


### [255] [MULTISEISMO: A Multimodal Seismic Dataset and Model for Cross-Modal Seismic Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26320)
*Sai Munikoti,Ian Stewart,Chengping Chai,Lisa Linville,Scott Vasquez,Sameera Horawalavithana,Karl Pazdernik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MultiSeismo，一个包含16K+地震事件、整合波形数据、地理图像和文本描述的多模态地震数据集；同时构建了MISCE指令集及领域专用模型SeisModal，实验表明领域适配架构显著优于通用多模态模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态模型在科学领域的应用受限，因为缺乏整合文本和图像之外多种数据模态的领域专用数据集；地震学中理解地震现象需要综合时序波形数据、地理图像和上下文元数据，而现有地震数据集缺乏这种多模态整合。

Method: 构建MultiSeismo数据集（16K+事件，2010-2023年，含波形记录、烈度图、人口暴露可视化及文本描述）；设计MISCE多模态指令集用于监督训练和评估；在Unified IO 2模型基础上增加专用时序编码器得到SeisModal模型。

Result: 通用多模态模型在MultiSeismo上表现挑战显著，尤其是时序数据处理方面；SeisModal在地震多模态推理任务上展现出优越性能。

Conclusion: MultiSeismo为未来地震学多模态研究提供了严格的基准，验证了领域专用架构适配的成功性。

Abstract: The application of generalist multimodal models (GMMs) to specialized scientific domains remains limited due to the scarcity of comprehensive domain-specific datasets that integrate multiple data modalities beyond text and images. In seismology, understanding earthquake phenomena requires the synthesis of timeseries waveform data, geographical imagery, and contextual metadata, a multimodal integration absent in existing seismic datasets. We present MultiSeismo, a large scale structured multimodal seismic dataset, comprising over 16K seismic events spanning 13 years (2010 to 2023) across diverse geographical regions. Each event data integrates waveform recordings from global station networks, intensity maps, population exposure visualizations, and a comprehensive textual description within a standardized JSON format. We additionally develop MISCE, a multimodal instruction set on top of raw data to enable supervised training and evaluation of GMMs on seismic reasoning tasks ranging from basic information retrieval to complex cross modal analysis. We leverage MISCE to finetune an existing multimodal model (Unified IO 2) enhanced with a specialized timeseries encoder, which yields SeisModal, the first domain specific multimodal model for comprehensive seismic analysis. Evaluation of state of the art multimodal models on MultiSeismo reveals significant challenges, particularly with time-series data processing for general purpose models, while demonstrating SeisModal's superior performance on seismic multimodal reasoning tasks. These results prove that MultiSeismo provides a rigorous benchmark for future multimodal research in seismology and validate the success of our domain specific architectural adaptations.

</details>


### [256] [Trust Region Q Adjoint Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27079)
*Yonghoon Dong,Kyungmin Lee,Changyeon Kim,Jaehyuk Kim,Jinwoo Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TRQAM，一种用于预训练流策略的稳定离策略强化学习微调算法，通过投影对偶下降自适应控制路径空间KL散度，在50个OGBench任务中离线RL成功率达68%，显著超越最强基线46%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离策略强化学习微调预训练流策略时，多步采样过程导致优化不稳定。现有QAM方法虽将其转化为无记忆随机最优控制问题，但存在critic引导改进的根本脆弱性：critic误差在条件不佳时被放大，导致模型崩溃。

Method: 提出信任区域Q-伴随匹配（TRQAM），通过投影对偶下降自适应控制与预训练流策略之间的路径空间KL散度。优化SOC动力学中的信任区域参数λ，并理论上证明路径空间KL可表示为λ的闭式函数，从而精确控制与预训练策略的偏差。

Result: 在50个OGBench任务上，TRQAM在离线RL和离线到在线RL中均一致超越先前方法。离线RL总体成功率达68%，显著高于最强基线46%。

Conclusion: TRQAM通过自适应信任区域机制实现了稳定的离策略RL微调，有效解决了critic引导改进中误差放大的问题，为预训练流策略的离策略强化学习提供了更稳定的方案。

Abstract: Off-policy reinforcement learning of pretrained flow policies remains challenging due to the instability of optimization arising from the multi-step sampling process. Recently, Q-learning with Adjoint Matching (QAM) addressed this issue by reformulating into a memoryless stochastic optimal control (SOC) problem with a learned critic. However, QAM inherits a fundamental fragility of critic-guided improvement: small critic errors are amplified when critics are ill-conditioned, often leading to model collapse. This paper introduces Trust Region Q-Adjoint Matching (TRQAM), a stable off-policy fine-tuning algorithm that adaptively controls the path-space KL with pretrained flow policies through projected dual descent. Specifically, we optimize the trust-region parameter $λ$ in SOC dynamics, and theoretically show that the path-space KL can be represented by a closed-form function of $λ$. As a result, our method can precisely control the exact deviation from pretrained flow policies, achieving stable off-policy RL. Through experiments on 50 OGBench tasks, TRQAM consistently outperforms prior arts in both offline RL and offline-to-online RL. In particular, TRQAM achieves an overall success rate of 68% in offline RL, substantially improves the strongest baseline at 46%.

</details>


### [257] [Reparametrizing Shampoo and SOAP for Subspace Basis Updates and BFloat16 Storage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26327)
*Alan Milligan,Zikun Xu,Simon Lacoste-Julien,Felix Dangel,Wu Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种重参数化预条件子的方法，支持BFP16存储并通过子空间部分QR分解更新基向量，从而降低Shampoo类方法的计算和内存开销，同时缓解BFP16存储带来的性能下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Shampoo类方法（如KL-Shampoo、SOAP）依赖QR分解，但QR分解需要FP32精度且计算昂贵，导致大预条件矩阵时时间和内存开销大；使用BFP16存储虽能减少内存但会降低方法性能。

Method: 提出一种预条件子的重参数化方案，支持BFP16存储；通过将更新后的基向量与未变化的基向量组合形成完整基；仅在子空间中对部分基进行QR分解更新，减少计算量并缓解BFP16存储带来的性能退化。

Result: 该方法广泛适用于使用QR分解的Shampoo类方法（KL-Shampoo、SOAP、KL-SOAP）；在BFP16存储下提升了SOAP和KL-SOAP的性能；使KL-SOAP能达到或超过KL-Shampoo的水平。

Conclusion: 所提方法使Shampoo类方法在内存和时间效率上更优。

Abstract: Shampoo-based methods, such as KL-Shampoo and SOAP, have demonstrated strong performance in training neural networks and rely on QR decomposition. Because existing QR implementations require single-precision (FP32) arithmetic and remain computationally expensive, these methods become time- and memory-intensive when their preconditioning matrices are large. Moreover, using BFloat16 (BFP16) storage to reduce memory usage can degrade the performance of Shampoo-based methods. We propose a reparametrization of the preconditioner that supports BFP16 storage and forms a complete basis by combining updated basis vectors with unchanged ones. By updating only part of the basis through QR decomposition in a subspace, our approach reduces computational overhead while mitigating the performance degradation caused by BFP16 storage. Our approach applies broadly to Shampoo-based methods that employ QR decomposition, including KL-Shampoo, SOAP, and KL-SOAP. In particular, it improves the performance of SOAP and KL-SOAP under BFP16 storage, enabling KL-SOAP to match or exceed KL-Shampoo. Overall, our approach makes Shampoo-based methods more memory- and time-efficient.

</details>


### [258] [MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26343)
*Barsat Khadka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将电路发现（mechanistic interpretability中的子任务）重构为强化学习问题：一个PPO智能体在GPT-2 small的144个注意力头上执行离散动作（零消融），通过对比奖励（目标任务损失减去通用预测损失）来识别关键注意力头。该智能体在两个训练任务（induction、IOI）和一个未见任务（docstring completion）上均达到oracle水平，发现的头与已有文献中的因果非冗余头高度一致，且对未见任务通过best-of-five规划可恢复96%的oracle上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机械可解释性电路发现方法需要为每个新任务定制专门的分析流程（bespoke analytical pipeline），缺乏通用性和可迁移性。

Method: 将电路发现建模为强化学习问题：智能体以GPT-2 small的144个注意力头为离散动作空间，每个动作触发零消融（zero-ablation），使用对比奖励（contrastive reward）——目标任务的损失增加减去通用下一token预测的损失增加。采用单PPO策略在多任务向量化环境中训练，同时优化两个任务（induction和IOI）。

Result: 1) 单策略在训练任务（induction、IOI）上达到per-episode oracle水平；2) 在未见任务（docstring completion）上，best-of-five规划恢复96%的oracle上限；3) 智能体优先选中的头与文献中因果非冗余（causally non-redundant）的头完全一致，而文献中识别为冗余的头被智能体正确降权。

Conclusion: 强化学习结合因果干预是识别机械电路单头瓶颈的可行且可迁移的方法，与现有的path-patching方法互补。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has identified small sets of attention heads that implement specific behaviours in transformer language models, but recovering these circuits typically requires a bespoke analytical pipeline for each new task. We recast circuit discovery as a reinforcement-learning problem. An agent operates over the 144 attention heads of GPT-2 small as a discrete action space; each action triggers a zero-ablation and a contrastive reward that subtracts the ablation's damage to general next-token prediction from its damage to the target task. A single PPO policy, trained on two tasks (induction and IOI) in a vectorised multi-task environment, attains the per-episode oracle on both training tasks and on a held-out third task (docstring completion). Its preferred heads coincide with the canonical heads of established literature on precisely the axes those papers identify as causally non-redundant under single-head ablation; the categories they identify as redundant are correctly de-prioritised by the agent. On the held-out task, best-of-five planning recovers 96\% of the oracle ceiling with no task signal supplied at evaluation. These results indicate that reinforcement learning over causal interventions is a viable, transferable substrate for identifying the single-head bottlenecks of mechanistic circuits, complementary to existing path-patching approaches.

</details>


### [259] [When Correct Demonstrations Hurt: Rethinking the Role of Exemplars in In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26350)
*Chenghao Qiu,Chunli Peng,Yufeng Yang,Kuan-Hao Huang,Yi Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现了一个反直觉现象：在上下文学习中，即使示范示例是正确的，也可能降低模型性能。作者提出任务保持扰动框架，揭示正确性≠有用性，并形式化该失效模式为上下文证据偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常直观地认为ICL中正确的示范示例有助于模型学习，但作者观察到一些正确示例反而会降低ICL准确性，因此希望系统研究这种"正确性-有用性差距"及其成因。

Method: 提出任务保持扰动框架：仅改变示范示例的输入，同时保持该示例仍是同一任务的正确实例。涵盖两种类型：标签更新扰动（任务相关语义改变，重新计算目标）和标签保持扰动（原目标仍然有效）。形式化失效模式为"上下文证据偏移"——扰动改变模型用于上下文推断的证据混合。

Result: 在情感分类、逻辑推理和数学应用题上，任务保持扰动的示范会显著降低ICL性能，尤其对小模型、困难任务和高扰动比例更明显。

Conclusion: 鲁棒的ICL不仅需要评估示范是否正确，还需要评估它们如何影响上下文推断。正确性不等同于有用性。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is often motivated by the intuition that demonstrations help because they provide correct input-output examples. However, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: correctness does not guarantee exemplar utility, and some correct demonstrations can even reduce ICL accuracy. To study this correctness-utility gap, we introduce task-preserving perturbations, where only the exemplar input is changed, while the example remains a correct instance of the same task. Concretely, each perturbed exemplar is assigned the target induced by the task mapping. This framework covers both label-updating perturbations, where task-relevant semantics change and targets are recomputed, and stricter target-preserving perturbations, where the original target remains valid. We formalize the resulting failure mode as contextual evidence shift: task-preserving perturbations can change the effective mixture of evidence used by the model for contextual inference, thereby separating exemplar correctness from exemplar utility. Across sentiment classification, logical reasoning, and math word problems, we find that task-preserving perturbed demonstrations can substantially degrade ICL performance, especially for smaller models, harder tasks, and higher perturbation ratios. Our results show that robust ICL requires evaluating not only whether demonstrations are correct, but also how they influence contextual inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Chenghao-Qiu/Task-Preserving-ICL.

</details>


### [260] [Energy-Gated Attention and Wavelet Positional Encoding: Complementary Inductive Biases for Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26355)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出能量门控注意力（EGA）和莫列小波位置编码（MoPE）两种互补归纳偏置，分别解决标准注意力中缺乏的能量显著性（选择关注什么）和尺度选择性局部性（指定在何处操作）。两者组合在TinyShakespeare上产生超加性效果（+0.119验证损失改进），远超各自单独使用的效果（EGA:+0.092, MoPE:-0.032），证明了显著性与局部性是互补的归纳偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer注意力将所有token视为等显著、所有位置视为等局部，忽略了输入的 informational 结构。作者识别出标准注意力缺乏两种互补归纳偏置：能量显著性（哪些token集中信息能量）和尺度选择性局部性（不同频率下位置影响延伸多远）。

Method: 1) 能量门控注意力（EGA）：通过单个线性投影计算key token嵌入的 learned energy estimate，以此门控值聚合，选择关注什么。2) 莫列小波位置编码（MoPE）：用学习的Gaussian窗小波替代固定正弦编码，自适应地联合定位位置-频率局部化。

Result: 在TinyShakespeare上：EGA单独+0.092验证损失改进（优于标准注意力）；MoPE单独-0.032（低于基线）；两者组合+0.119，呈现超加性。消融实验证实结构化谱先验（Morlet小波门控、尺度初始化头、固定正弦PE）始终不如非约束学习对应物。

Conclusion: 显著性和局部性是互补的归纳偏置，各自解决对方无法单独填补的空白。两者组合的超加性是该工作的核心实证发现。实验限于小规模（≤6M参数），更大规模多种子验证是未来最重要方向。

Abstract: Standard transformer attention computes pairwise token similarity but treats all tokens as equally salient and all positions as equally local, regardless of the informational structure of the input. We identify two complementary inductive biases that standard attention lacks: energy salience (which tokens concentrate informational energy, learned end-to-end without explicit frequency decomposition) and scale-selective locality (how far positional influence extends at each frequency, implemented via Morlet wavelet encoding). We address both with two simple components. Energy-Gated Attention (EGA) gates value aggregation by a learned energy estimate of key token embeddings, computed via a single linear projection; it selects what to attend to. Morlet Positional Encoding (MoPE) replaces fixed sinusoidal encodings with learned Gaussian-windowed wavelets that adapt the joint position-frequency localization to the corpus; it specifies where attention operates at each scale. On TinyShakespeare, EGA alone achieves +0.092 validation loss improvement over standard attention (+0.103 over Phase 1-3 baseline); MoPE alone is -0.032 (below baseline as a standalone encoding); but their combination achieves +0.119 -- more than the sum of parts. This superadditivity, observed across two independent training runs, is the central empirical finding: salience and locality are complementary inductive biases, each addressing a gap the other cannot fill alone. Ablations confirm that structured spectral priors (Morlet wavelet gates, scale-initialized heads, fixed sinusoidal PE) consistently underperform their unconstrained learned counterparts, while complementary learned components interact superadditively. All experiments are at small scale (<=6M parameters, character-level benchmarks, single seed); larger-scale multi-seed validation is the most important direction for future work.

</details>


### [261] [Balancing Plasticity and Stability with Fast and Slow Successor Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26357)
*Raymond Chua,Doina Precup,Blake Richards*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度强化学习在持续渐进变化环境中的适应性问题，发现稳定性（如突触巩固）优于塑性（如参数重置），并且多时间尺度巩固预测表征（Successor Features）能有效应对环境逐渐漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实环境往往通过持续渐变而非突变方式演变，现有研究大多关注突变式非平稳性，忽略了渐变场景下稳定性-塑性困境的特殊性，因此需要构造渐变非平稳环境并系统分析稳定与适应机制对性能的影响。

Method: 修改3D Miniworld和MuJoCo环境以引入自然主义、持续的渐变非平稳性；对比稳定性方法（突触巩固）与塑性方法（参数重置）的性能；将神经启发突触巩固应用于Successor Features（SFs），并探索多时间尺度巩固策略。

Result: 稳定性方法优于塑性方法；对SFs施加突触巩固在两种渐变环境中均表现更优；多时间尺度的SFs巩固能捕捉环境渐变的互补方面，效果最佳。

Conclusion: 在持续渐变环境中，稳定性比塑性更为关键，多时间尺度巩固预测表征是一种有效应对策略。

Abstract: A hallmark of intelligence is the ability to adapt in non-stationary environments, yet deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often struggle in such settings. Prior studies introduce non-stationarity through abrupt shifts in features or dynamics, whereas real-world environments often evolve gradually through continual drift. This distinction has important implications for the "stability-plasticity dilemma" in RL, as abrupt task changes may demand more plasticity than naturalistic settings. To address this, we modify existing 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments to incorporate naturalistic, continual non-stationarity, and use them to examine how stability and adaptation affect performance under continuous environmental change. We find that methods favoring stability, such as synaptic consolidation, outperform approaches focused on plasticity, such as parameters resetting. Motivated by this result, and prior evidence that Successor Features (SFs) reduce interference, we investigate whether SFs are better consolidation targets than Q-values. Across both environments, applying neuro-inspired synaptic consolidation to SFs yields superior performance on continually changing settings. Moreover, consolidation is most effective when SFs are stabilized across multiple timescales, which capture complementary aspects of gradual environmental change. Together, these results suggest that stability is more critical in continual learning when changes are gradual, and that multi-timescale consolidation of predictive representations is an effective approach.

</details>


### [262] [Online Learning on Hidden-Convex Losses via Algorithmic Equivalence: Optimal Regret, Geometric Barrier, and Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26373)
*Anas Barakat,Andreas Kontogiannis,Vasilis Pollatos,Ioannis Panageas,Antonios Varvitsiotis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明在隐凸损失下，在线梯度下降(OGD)可实现O(√T)遗憾，匹配在线凸优化的最优最坏情况界；同时提出Hessian兼容性条件替代对角Jacobian条件，并给出单点bandit反馈下的O(T^{3/4})遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ghai, Lu和Hazan (2022)证明了隐凸损失下OGD可近似模拟在线镜像下降(OMD)，但仅给出O(T^{2/3})遗憾界，留下能否恢复最优的Θ(√T)遗憾的开放问题。本文旨在回答这一开放问题。

Method: 通过更精细的离散时间算法等价性论证，证明OGD在相同假设下实现O(√T)遗憾；用必要且充分的Hessian兼容性条件替换对角Jacobian充分条件；构造反例证明条件必要性；扩展至单点bandit反馈场景。

Result: OGD在隐凸损失下实现O(√T)遗憾，匹配最优最坏情况界；提出Hessian兼容性条件并证明其必要性与充分性；当条件不满足时，OGD遭受Ω(T)遗憾；单点bandit OGD实现O(T^{3/4})期望遗憾。

Conclusion: 隐凸损失下在线学习可达到与在线凸优化相同的最优遗憾界，且算法等价性所需的几何条件得到精确刻画。

Abstract: We study adversarial online learning with hidden-convex losses, i.e., nonconvex losses that become convex after a nonlinear reparameterization. Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) proved that, under geometric and smoothness assumptions, online gradient descent (OGD) on such nonconvex losses approximately simulates online mirror descent (OMD) on the underlying convex losses with a suitable regularizer, yielding $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret. They left open whether the optimal $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ regret from online convex optimization can be recovered in this hidden-convex setting. We answer this question affirmatively. More specifically, via a sharper discrete-time algorithmic equivalence argument, we prove that OGD achieves $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under the same assumptions, matching the optimal worst-case rate for adversarial online convex optimization. We also address another open question of Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) by clarifying the geometry required for this algorithmic equivalence. We replace the diagonal-Jacobian sufficient condition with a necessary-and-sufficient Hessian compatibility condition, thereby expanding the class of admissible reparameterizations. We complement our tight regret bound with a lower bound showing that the Hessian compatibility assumption is essential for OGD; when it fails, we construct a smooth reparameterization and an adversarial sequence of hidden-convex losses for which OGD suffers $Ω(T)$ regret. Finally, we extend our analysis to one-point bandit feedback and prove a $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ expected regret bound for bandit OGD with spherical smoothing, matching its classical rate on convex losses.

</details>


### [263] [Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26408)
*Valentina V. Kuskova,Dmitry Zaytsev,Michael Coppedge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文论证了非线性时间序列因果发现中广泛使用的标量边评分会严重丢失信息，并提出基于函数值因果影响的分析框架，通过NAVAR模型和ICE方法揭示标量评分无法区分的多种因果函数形态（单调、阈值、饱和、变号等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非线性时序因果发现方法几乎都使用标量边评分来总结因果关系，这掩盖了非线性自回归模型实际学到的是状态依赖的因果函数，其效应随机制、幅度和情境而变化。

Method: 形式化了可加、贡献可分解架构下的函数值因果影响，以NAVAR（神经可加向量自回归）为代表架构，提出基于个体条件期望（ICE）从训练模型中直接估计因果响应函数的实用框架。

Result: 合成实验表明标量评分无法区分的边可能具有完全不同的函数行为（单调、阈值、饱和、变号）；民主发展实证案例显示函数值分析揭示了评分中心方法系统性遗漏的特定机制和非对称因果结构。

Conclusion: 标量因果评分构成了严重的信息瓶颈，混淆了状态间变异和状态内残差噪声，函数值因果分析能揭示更丰富的因果结构信息。

Abstract: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

</details>


### [264] [When Does Deep RL Beat Calibrated Baselines? A Benchmark Study on Adaptive Resource Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26418)
*Guilin Zhang,Chuanyi Sun,Kai Zhao,Shahryar Sarkani,John Fossaceca*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过RLScale-Bench基准测试发现，精心调优的基于规则的自动缩放器在成本上优于六种主流深度强化学习算法，尽管DRL在突发流量场景下略有优势。研究指出，RL资源控制的瓶颈在于基线校准、奖励工程和评估协议，而非算法选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 质疑深度强化学习在自适应资源控制中的实际有效性，探究DRL算法在面对动态工作负载时是否真的优于传统基于规则的自动缩放器。

Method: 构建RLScale-Bench可复现基准测试，在Kubernetes水平Pod自动缩放场景下，将PPO、DQN、A2C、SAC、TD3、DDPG六种DRL算法与校准后的基于规则基线进行对比，涵盖六种工作负载模式和五个随机种子（共240次实验），评估成本和约束违反情况。

Result: (i) 校准后的规则控制器在所有六种工作负载上实现最低成本，但在突发和闪电流量上落后于最佳RL智能体；(ii) 离散动作算法在约束违反方面比连续动作算法优1-2个数量级；(iii) 没有单一算法在所有工作负载上占优，排名波动可达四位。

Conclusion: RL资源控制的瓶颈不在于算法选择，而在于基线校准、奖励工程和更现实的评估协议。

Abstract: A properly calibrated rule-based autoscaler can beat every one of six mainstream deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms on cost across every workload we test - so when, if ever, does DRL actually help? We study this in RLScale-Bench, a reproducible benchmark and evaluation protocol for DRL on adaptive resource control, where an agent allocates compute to a dynamic workload under cost and service-level constraints. We evaluate PPO, DQN, A2C, SAC, TD3, and DDPG under matched architectures, training budgets, and reward functions against a calibrated rule-based baseline across six workload patterns and five seeds (240 runs), instantiate the benchmark on Kubernetes Horizontal Pod Autoscaling, and probe distribution-shift generalization. Three findings challenge common assumptions: (i) the calibrated controller achieves the lowest cost on all six workloads, though it trails the best RL agents on bursty and flash traffic; (ii) discrete-action algorithms outperform continuous-action ones by one to two orders of magnitude in constraint violations due to action-space mismatch; and (iii) no single algorithm dominates across workloads, with rankings shifting by up to four positions. The bottleneck in RL-based resource control is not algorithm selection but baseline calibration, reward engineering, and realistic evaluation protocols.

</details>


### [265] [Amortized Factor Inference Networks for Posterior Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26419)
*Joohwan Ko,Justin Domke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AFIN，一种能泛化到不同先验、似然和维度的单推理网络，无需重新训练或微调，在测试时计算量比NUTS和VI方法少2-4个数量级，同时保持相当的推断精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有摊销推断方法只能服务于固定模型，扩展到未见过的模型需要重新训练或昂贵的测试时微调。本文探索是否可能构建一个统一的推断网络，能够跨不同先验、似然和维度泛化。

Method: 提出Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs)，一种编码-合并-解码架构的推断网络，使用与维度无关的模块，将模型规范及其观测数据映射为变分后验参数。

Result: 单个训练的AFIN在多种模型上达到了与NUTS和多种变分推断方法相当的后验精度，同时测试时计算量减少2-4个数量级。

Conclusion: 构建一个能跨变模型泛化的单一推断网络是可行的，为实现通用、高效的贝叶斯推断提供了新方向。

Abstract: Amortized inference promises fast test-time Bayesian inference, but existing methods are inherently tied to fixed models. Extending amortization to unseen models typically requires retraining or costly test-time finetuning. In this paper, we ask: is it possible to build a single inference network capable of generalizing across varying priors, likelihoods, and dimensionality? We introduce Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs), a family of encode-merge-decode inference networks built on dimension-independent modules that map a model specification and its observations to the parameters of a variational posterior. Experimentally, a single trained AFIN achieves posterior accuracy comparable to NUTS and several variational inference methods, while requiring 2 to 4 orders of magnitude less test-time compute. Code is available at https://github.com/joohwanko/AFINs.

</details>


### [266] [FM-fMRI: Event Conditioned Flow Matching for Rest-to-Task fMRI Time-Series Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26423)
*Peiyu Duan,Jiyao Wang,Nicha C. Dvornek,Junlin Yang,Ziqi Gao,Lawrence H. Staib,James S. Duncan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FM-fMRI，一种基于事件条件流匹配的模型，能从静息态fMRI和任务事件信息生成任务态fMRI的ROI时间序列，在多个评估指标上优于扩散模型、GAN和VAE等基线方法，并在自闭症分类下游任务中展示了实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务态fMRI能直接读取任务诱发的神经活动，但获取成本高、难以大规模采集；而静息态fMRI广泛易得。因此，从静息态fMRI合成任务态fMRI具有重要临床和科研价值，能在数据有限的场景下弥补任务态数据的稀缺性。

Method: 提出FM-fMRI，一种事件条件流匹配模型。该模型学习连续时间条件向量场，以受试者的静息态fMRI和任务事件信息为条件，生成任务态fMRI的ROI时间序列。支持基于ODE的快速采样，并能灵活适应异质事件调度。训练时不直接优化逐点重构，而是从时域结构、频域结构、个体和群体水平连接组一致性、分布对齐等多维度进行评估。

Result: 在公共HCP数据集和内部BioPoint自闭症队列上，FM-fMRI在频谱一致性、连接组一致性上达到最优，且分布匹配效果优于条件扩散模型、GAN和VAE基线。在BioPoint自闭症队列上，合成数据提升了下游自闭症分类性能。

Conclusion: FM-fMRI从静息态fMRI到任务态fMRI的合成效果优于现有生成方法，在数据有限的临床场景中具有实际应用价值，有望推动fMRI数据增强和临床诊断辅助。

Abstract: Task-based fMRI provides a direct readout of task-evoked neural dynamics, but it is expensive and difficult to acquire at scale, motivating rest-to-task synthesis from widely available resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI). We propose FM-fMRI, an event-conditioned flow-matching model that learns a continuous-time conditional vector field to generate task ROI time series from a subject's rsfMRI and the task event information. The formulation enables fast ODE-based sampling and flexible conditioning over heterogeneous event schedules. Rather than optimizing for pointwise reconstruction, we evaluated generated signals using complementary criteria that probe temporal and spectral structure, subject and group-level connectome consistency, and distributional alignment. On the public Human Connectome Project and internal BioPoint autism cohort, FM-fMRI achieves the strongest spectral and connectivity agreement and improved distribution-level matching over conditional diffusion, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and variational autoencoders (VAEs) baselines. Furthermore, we augment the BioPoint cohort by synthesizing task-fMRI ROI time series with our method, improving downstream autism classification and demonstrating practical utility in data-limited clinical settings. The code will be available on GitHub.

</details>


### [267] [Aperiodic and Low-Frequency Spectral Bias in Reconstruction based EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26434)
*Aditya Kommineni,Emily Zhou,Kleanthis Avramidis,Simon Bock Segaard,Jeppe Roden Münster,Andreas Peter Juhl Hansen,Takfarinas Medani,Tiantian Feng,Richard Leahy,Shrikanth Narayanan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 基于重建的EEG基础模型存在根本性缺陷：其嵌入偏向于捕获高功率的非周期性成分而低估了高频振荡成分，且在低资源场景下表现不如小型监督模型，因为嵌入更强调受试者身份而非任务相关信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示EEG基础模型在低资源场景下性能不如小型监督模型的原因，从机制层面解释这一失败模式。

Method: 通过可控的合成EEG输入进行机制分析，并在真实BCI数据集上使用线性探针评估嵌入表征。

Result: EEG基础模型嵌入偏向捕获非周期性成分，低估高频振荡成分；嵌入编码的受试者身份信息强于任务相关信息，强化了低频和非周期性成分偏差。

Conclusion: 重建目标驱动的EEG基础模型存在失败模式，未来需要引入显式针对高频振荡结构的辅助损失函数以提升模型性能和泛化能力。

Abstract: EEG foundation models, pre-trained on large-scale unlabelled EEG data, have emerged as a promising direction towards learning generalizable EEG representations. Despite showing positive results in data-rich regimes, they often fail to outperform significantly smaller supervised models in low-resource settings compared to fully supervised models. We provide a mechanistic account of this shortcoming, attributing it to a fundamental mismatch between reconstruction-based pretext tasks and the idiosyncratic spectral structure of EEG signals, which decompose into distinct high-power aperiodic and low-power oscillatory components. Using controlled, synthetically-generated EEG inputs, we demonstrate that EEG foundation model embeddings are biased to capture the aperiodic components of the EEG signal while under-representing oscillatory components, particularly at higher frequencies. Additionally, linear probe evaluations on real-world BCI datasets further reveal that embeddings encode subject identity more strongly than task-relevant information, thereby reinforcing the low-frequency and aperiodic component bias in foundation model embeddings trained primarily on reconstruction based objectives. Together, these findings elucidate a failure mode in reconstruction based EEG foundation models and motivate future work to incorporate auxiliary losses explicitly targeting high-frequency oscillatory structure as a path toward more capable and generalizable EEG representations.

</details>


### [268] [Continual Model-Based Reinforcement Learning with Hypernetworks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2009.11997)
*Yizhou Huang,Kevin Xie,Homanga Bharadhwaj,Florian Shkurti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HyperCRL提出了一种基于任务条件超网络的持续学习方法，用于机器人的终身模型强化学习，通过不回溯旧数据、仅存储最近固定大小的经验并使用固定容量超网络表示非平稳动态，在机器人 locomotion 和 manipulation 任务中表现出色。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MBRL和MPC方法假设动态模型是平稳的，并定期从头重新训练，训练时间随收集经验规模线性增长，这对于终身机器人学习来说速度太慢。

Method: 提出HyperCRL方法，使用任务条件超网络持续学习序列任务中的动态变化，具有三个特点：1) 动态学习不回溯旧数据，仅存储最近固定大小的经验；2) 使用固定容量超网络表示非平稳和任务感知的动态；3) 不依赖不断增长的coreset。

Result: HyperCRL在机器人 locomotion 和 manipulation 场景（如推物体和开门任务）中优于依赖固定容量网络的持续学习基线，与依赖不断增长coreset的基线相比也具有竞争力。

Conclusion: HyperCRL有效解决了终身机器人学习中动态模型训练效率低下的问题，为持续模型强化学习提供了一种可行的方案。

Abstract: Effective planning in model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) and model-predictive control (MPC) relies on the accuracy of the learned dynamics model. In many instances of MBRL and MPC, this model is assumed to be stationary and is periodically re-trained from scratch on state transition experience collected from the beginning of environment interactions. This implies that the time required to train the dynamics model - and the pause required between plan executions - grows linearly with the size of the collected experience. We argue that this is too slow for lifelong robot learning and propose HyperCRL, a method that continually learns the encountered dynamics in a sequence of tasks using task-conditional hypernetworks. Our method has three main attributes: first, it includes dynamics learning sessions that do not revisit training data from previous tasks, so it only needs to store the most recent fixed-size portion of the state transition experience; second, it uses fixed-capacity hypernetworks to represent non-stationary and task-aware dynamics; third, it outperforms existing continual learning alternatives that rely on fixed-capacity networks, and does competitively with baselines that remember an ever increasing coreset of past experience. We show that HyperCRL is effective in continual model-based reinforcement learning in robot locomotion and manipulation scenarios, such as tasks involving pushing and door opening. Our project website with videos is at this link https://rvl.cs.toronto.edu/blog/hypercrl

</details>


### [269] [DDGAD: Trajectory Dynamics for Diffusion-Based Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26446)
*Yuxin Yang,Limei Hu,Feng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DDGAD，一种基于扩散过程的图异常检测框架，通过节点表征轨迹的动力学特性区分正常与异常节点，并引入可靠性感知的共识细化机制缓解污染传播问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GCN方法存在污染传播问题，即异常节点通过消息传递污染邻居表征，导致检测性能下降。

Method: 提出DDGAD框架，利用扩散正则化与可靠性感知邻居共识的耦合效应，通过节点表征轨迹的稳定性区分正常与异常节点，并定义邻居不一致性、可靠性权重、动力学冲突能量三种互补异常信号。

Result: 在五个真实数据集上的实验验证了DDGAD的有效性。

Conclusion: 正常节点在耦合动力学下呈现一致稳定的表征轨迹，而异常节点因全局流形先验与局部污染消息传递的方向不一致性，表现出不稳定和冲突的动力学特征。

Abstract: Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify nodes or substructures whose behavior or attributes deviate significantly from the overall pattern in graph-structured data, with critical applications in financial risk control, social network analysis, and cybersecurity. However, existing GCN-based methods suffer from the fundamental problem of contamination propagation, where anomalous nodes pollute the representations of their neighbors through message passing, leading to degraded detection performance. In this paper, we propose DDGAD, a novel diffusion-based graph anomaly detection framework that leverages trajectory dynamics to distinguish normal and anomalous nodes. Our key insight is that normal nodes exhibit consistent and stable representation trajectories under the coupled effects of diffusion regularization and reliability-aware neighborhood consensus, while anomalous nodes exhibit unstable and conflicting dynamics due to the directional disagreement between the global manifold prior and locally contaminated message passing. To mitigate contamination propagation, we introduce a distributed reliability-aware consensus refinement mechanism and define three complementary anomaly signals: neighbor inconsistency, reliability weight, and dynamical conflict energy. We further provide a preliminary theoretical analysis on normal node stability under the coupled dynamics. These signals collectively characterize anomalous behaviors from the perspectives of local inconsistency, consensus reliability, and dynamical instability. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [270] [Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Safe Autonomous Driving Under Pedestrian Behavioral Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20255)
*Prakash Aryan,Kaushik Raghupathruni,Timo Kehrer,Sebastiano Panichella*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）联合训练自动驾驶汽车（SDC）和行人，以生成更真实的交互场景。实验表明，联合训练的SDC达到78%的目标完成率和14%的碰撞率，优于基于规则的基线模型。乱穿马路行为虽仅占穿越事件的13%，却导致了62%的碰撞，而联合训练相比单智能体RL减少了30%的碰撞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统基于脚本的行人模型无法捕捉真实过街行为的异质性和不确定性，特别是乱穿马路行为受潜在人格特质驱动且车辆不可观测，导致安全评估缺乏真实性。

Method: 使用多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）联合训练1个SDC和12个行人；行人底层移动采用脚本化Dijkstra路径规划，RL策略控制高层等待/通行决策；乱穿马路概率取决于每轮开始采样的隐藏人格特质。

Result: 联合训练的SDC目标完成率78%，碰撞率14%；最佳规则基线为35%/33%。SDC在靠近乱穿行人时速度比靠近使用人行横道的行人快2.65 m/s（0-3米范围内），表明车辆未预期乱穿行为。乱穿马路占穿越事件13%却导致62%碰撞；联合训练相比单智能体RL降低30%碰撞。

Conclusion: 多智能体联合训练能产生更真实的SDC-行人交互场景，可量化可预测与不可预测穿越行为之间的差距，为提升自动驾驶安全评估的真实性提供有效方法。

Abstract: Simulation-based testing of self-driving cars (SDCs) typically relies on scripted pedestrian models that do not capture the heterogeneity and uncertainty of real crossing behavior, limiting the realism of safety assessments, especially for jaywalking, which is governed by latent personality traits the vehicle cannot observe. We hypothesize that jointly training pedestrians and the SDC with multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) yields more realistic interaction scenarios than training against fixed pedestrian policies, and that the behavior gap between predictable and unpredictable crossings can be measured directly from trajectories. We co-train an SDC and 12 pedestrians using Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization (MAPPO): pedestrian locomotion follows scripted Dijkstra pathfinding while an RL policy controls high-level go/wait decisions, and jaywalking probability depends on a per-pedestrian trait sampled at episode start and hidden from the SDC. In 500-episode evaluations, the co-trained SDC reached 78% of goals with a 14% collision rate, versus 35%/33% for the best rule-based baseline. A speed differential metric shows the SDC traveled 2.65 m/s faster near jaywalkers than near crosswalk users at close range (0-3 m), indicating jaywalking encounters were not anticipated. Jaywalking was 13% of crossing events but 62% of collisions, and co-training reduced collisions by 30% relative to single-agent RL as pedestrians learned to wait when the SDC approached at speed.

</details>


### [271] [MuCon: Clipped Muon Updates for LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26459)
*Albert Yi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MuCon优化器通过奇异值裁剪（而非Muon的极分解）更新矩阵，本文研究其数学性质及SVD近似的数值困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索MuCon优化器中奇异值裁剪步骤能否在避免完整稠密SVD的情况下被高效近似，并分析数值稳定性问题。

Method: 给出了MuCon裁剪算子MClip_τ的两种精确恒等式（极/绝对值公式和标量根公式），推导出有理Newton滤波器用于裁剪半正定因子，并分析了阈值附近奇异值导致的数值病态性。

Result: 识别出两种公式共有的数值障碍：当奇异值接近裁剪阈值τ时，符号判定和有理求解变得病态；矩阵函数方法仅在搭配稳定的极/平方根原语或显式正则化时才有用。

Conclusion: MuCon的裁剪步骤无法在不引入额外数值稳定机制的情况下简单避免完整SVD，需要稳定的极分解/平方根本原或裁剪边界正则化来保证计算可靠性。

Abstract: Muon-style optimizers take a matrix-valued momentum or preconditioned update $B = U \operatorname{diag}(σ_1,\ldots,σ_r) V^\top$ and replace it with its canonical partial polar factor $\operatorname{Pol}(B) = U V^\top$. This maps every nonzero singular value to one. MuCon is the clipped-Muon variant studied here: it applies singular-value clipping to the same Muon matrix, $D^{\mathrm{MuCon}}\_τ(B) = \operatorname{MClip}\_τ(B) = U \operatorname{diag}\bigl(\min\{σ\_i,τ\}\bigr) V^\top, \qquad τ> 0$. Thus, $\operatorname{MClip}\_τ$ denotes the mathematical clipping operator, while MuCon denotes the optimizer primitive that substitutes this clipped direction for Muon's polar direction. The Muon/MuCon scaling parameterization used in this work is called $\text{SpectralP}$: it is the hidden-matrix scaling recipe under which polar Muon or clipped MuCon directions are applied. The map $\operatorname{MClip}\_τ$ is the Frobenius projection onto the spectral-norm ball $\{X : \|X\|_2 \le τ\}$: it leaves singular values at or below $τ$ unchanged and modifies only the violating singular directions. This paper asks when the MuCon clipping step can be approximated without a full dense SVD. We record two exact identities, a polar/absolute-value formula and a scalar-root formulation leading to a rational Newton filter for the clipped positive-semidefinite factor, and identify the numerical obstruction common to both: singular values near the threshold make sign decisions and rational solves ill-conditioned. Matrix-function methods are therefore useful only when paired with stable polar/square-root primitives or explicit regularization near the clipping boundary.

</details>


### [272] [Diffuse to Detect: Generative Diffusion Models for Unsupervised IC Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26468)
*Yuxuan Yin,Chen He,Todd Jacobs,Jialei He,Boxun Xu,Robert Jin,Peng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个结合扩散Transformer的无监督异常检测框架，用于16nm IC测试数据的潜在缺陷筛选，通过自编码器压缩、结构化token序列和噪声预测误差实现无标签异常检测，在极端类别不平衡下达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在缺陷筛选面临极低故障率、高维测试数据和缺乏标记异常样本的挑战，现有监督方法无法有效应对这些实际工业场景中的困难。

Method: 首先使用自编码器压缩原始测试数据，然后将其重塑为结构化token序列，并加入正弦位置编码和每设备晶圆位置嵌入。利用扩散Transformer的中等扩散步长上的噪声预测误差作为异常分数，无需任何标签或手动特征工程。

Result: 在工业16nm IC测试数据上，在极端类别不平衡条件下取得了最先进的性能，并通过潜在空间重建残差提供了可解释的故障定位。

Conclusion: 提出的无监督框架能够有效解决工业场景中低故障率、高维数据和无标签注释下的异常检测问题，同时具备快速晶圆级筛选能力和可解释性。

Abstract: Latent defect screening is challenged by extremely low failure rates, high-dimensional test data, and absence of labeled anomalies. We propose the first unsupervised anomaly detection framework incorporating a Diffusion Transformer. Raw test measurements are first compressed by an autoencoder, then reshaped into a structured token sequence enriched with sinusoidal and per-device wafer-position embeddings. Anomaly scores are derived from the noise-prediction error over mid-range diffusion timesteps, enabling fast wafer-scale screening without any labeled defects or manual feature engineering. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on industrial 16nm IC test data under extreme class imbalance, offering interpretable failure localization through latent-space reconstruction residuals.

</details>


### [273] [Variational Inference for Evidential Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26477)
*Jiawei Tang,Xinyan Du,Hui Liu,Junhui Hou,Yuheng Jia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对证据深度学习（EDL）中KL惩罚仅抑制负类证据导致证据过高、以及Dirichlet参数α=e+1缺乏理论保证两个问题，提出基于变分推断的证据深度学习框架（VI-EDL），通过推导ELBO防止证据过度增长，并建立了泛化界理论证明α=e+1的合理性，在多个数据集上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统EDL存在两个根本性缺陷：（1）KL散度惩罚项仅抑制负类证据，导致总体证据过高，削弱了模型量化不确定性的能力；（2）将Dirichlet参数设置为α=e+1缺乏理论保证。

Method: 从变分推断视角重新形式化证据学习，推导证据下界（ELBO）以约束证据过度增长；理论上建立了泛化界，揭示了预测不确定性、特征和网络复杂度如何影响该界，并证明了为何α=e+1能最小化泛化界。

Result: 在标准视觉数据集和医学数据集上，VI-EDL在分布外检测、噪声检测和自动驾驶场景中均达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: VI-EDL通过变分推断视角为EDL提供了数学上严谨的理论基础，有效解决了传统EDL的证据膨胀问题，提升了不确定性量化能力。

Abstract: While Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) achieve remarkable performance, their tendency to produce overconfident predictions. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) mitigates this by formulating predictions as a Dirichlet distribution over class probabilities to explicitly quantify epistemic uncertainty. However, we found that the conventional EDL suffers from two fundamental limitations: a Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty that only suppresses the evidence of negative classes, producing excessively high evidence therefore decreasing the model's ability to quantify uncertainty, and an absence in theoretical guarantee of setting Dirichlet parameter $α=e+1$. In this paper, we propose a mathematically principled framework, Variational Inference Evidential Deep Learning (VI-EDL). By reformulating evidential learning through the lens of variational inference, we derive an Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), which prevents the evidence from growing excessively. Theoretically, we rigorously establish a generalization bound and reveal how the predicted uncertainty, feature and network complexity affect this bound, and why setting $\boldsymbolα = \mathbf{e} + \mathbf{1}$ can minimize it. Extensive experiments on standard visual and medical datasets demonstrate that VI-EDL achieves state-of-the-art performance, showing excellent performance in out-of-distribution detection, noise detection and autonomous driving scenario. The code is available in https://github.com/seutjw/VI-EDL.

</details>


### [274] [Extra-Merge: Tracing the Rank-1 Subspace of Model Merging in Language Model Pre-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26484)
*Wenjie Zhou,Bohan Wang,Hongtao Zhang,Chenxi Jia,Wei Chen,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现LLM在后期预训练中，连续合并的checkpoint会坍缩到一个近似一维的线性流形（Rank-1 Subspace现象），并提出无需训练的Extra-Merge策略沿该子空间外推以降低损失，在GPT-2、LLaMA系列及Pythia-12B上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并虽被广泛使用，但其底层机制尚不清晰，亟需理论解释以指导更高效的合并策略。

Method: 通过分析后期预训练轨迹发现Rank-1 Subspace现象，理论归因于river-valley景观分析（平均操作作为几何低通滤波器），并提出Extra-Merge沿该子空间外推。

Result: 在GPT-2、LLaMA（124M-2B）上一致超越标准合并基线；在Pythia-12B下游任务上取得零样本准确率提升；有效泛化至Muon优化器。

Conclusion: 揭示了模型合并的几何本质，提供了一种无需额外训练即可提升LLM性能的轻量化方案。

Abstract: Model merging has emerged as a lightweight paradigm for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. In this work, we analyze late-stage pre-training trajectories and uncover a \textbf{Rank-1 Subspace} phenomenon: while raw optimization steps oscillate violently, consecutive \emph{merged} checkpoints collapse onto a stable, approximately one-dimensional linear manifold. We theoretically ground this observation in a \emph{river-valley} landscape analysis: averaging acts as a geometric low-pass filter that dampens high-curvature noise to reveal the optimal descent direction. Capitalizing on this insight, we propose \textbf{Extra-Merge}, a training-free strategy that extrapolates along this subspace to minimize loss without additional gradient updates. Extensive experiments across GPT-2 and LLaMA families (124M to 2B) demonstrate that Extra-Merge consistently outperforms standard merging baselines. Notably, it yields consistent zero-shot accuracy gains on Pythia-12B downstream tasks and generalizes effectively to the Muon optimizer \citep{jordan2024muon}.

</details>


### [275] [The Stability of Singular Distribution: A Spectral Perspective on the Two-Phase Dynamics of Language Model Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26489)
*Hongtao Zhang,Wenjie Zhou,Chenxi Jia,Wei Chen,Xueqi Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现大语言模型预训练中奇异值谱分布的稳定性(SoSD)现象与慢速下降阶段同步，并证明权重范数增长会触发SoSD阈值，此后损失下降速率受限于奇异值分布变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解大语言模型预训练中快速初始损失下降后进入漫长缓慢改进阶段的内在机制，从谱分析角度揭示这一两阶段现象的数学本质。

Method: 识别SoSD（奇异值分布稳定性）现象，通过多种架构(GPT-2, LLaMA)、学习率调度、权重衰减和优化器实验验证其普遍性，并在简化Transformer上进行理论分析。

Result: SoSD与慢速下降阶段在多种设置下广泛同步；证明权重范数增长必然导致早期SoSD阈值，此后损失下降速率受限于奇异值分布变化；发现WSD和Muon等策略通过调节SoSD尺度发挥作用。

Conclusion: SoSD为理解高效预训练动力学提供了新的谱视角，解释了预训练的两阶段行为，并为设计更高效的训练策略提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Large language model pre-training typically exhibits a two-phase trajectory: a fast initial loss drop followed by a prolonged slow improvement. We identify an underlying spectral phenomenon, Stability of Singular Distribution (SoSD), where the trace-normalized singular value spectrum stabilizes early, even as parameter matrices continue to evolve. We demonstrate that synchronization between SoSD and the slow-descent regime is widely observed across diverse architectures (GPT-2, LLaMA) and settings, including various schedules (Step-wise, WSD, Cosine Decay), weight decays, and optimizers (AdamW, Muon). By analyzing a simplified Transformer, we prove that growing weight norms inevitably precipitate an early SoSD threshold, after which the rate of loss decrease becomes theoretically bounded by the variation in the singular distribution. We further interpret strategies like WSD and Muon through their ability to modulate the SoSD scale, offering a spectral lens for understanding efficient pre-training dynamics.

</details>


### [276] [Beyond Pairwise Preferences: Listwise Reward-Aware Alignment for Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26491)
*Austin Wang,Jiaqi Han,Stefano Ermon,Yisong Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Diffusion LAIR，一种基于奖励感知的列表式偏好优化方法，通过将多张候选图像的奖励分数转化为中心化优势权重，并优化带有二次惩罚的隐式奖励加权回归目标，实现对扩散模型的高效对齐，在SD1.5和SDXL上超越现有成对偏好优化基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏好优化方法将监督信号简化为成对比较（胜者/败者），但训练数据中常包含同一提示下的多张候选图像，且连续奖励分数比单一的胜败标签包含更丰富的信息；成对化简限制了数据利用效率和模型性能。

Method: 对每个提示，将一组候选图像的奖励分数转化为中心化优势权重，优化隐式奖励（当前模型相对于固定参考模型的去噪损失改进）上的优势加权回归目标，并添加二次惩罚项正则化隐式奖励的幅度；该目标在隐式奖励空间中有有界闭式最优解，通过正则化强度控制偏好更新的幅度。

Result: 在SD1.5和SDXL上，Diffusion LAIR在文本到图像生成、组合生成和图像编辑基准上均优于现有的强偏好优化基线方法。

Conclusion: 列表式偏好优化（而非成对比较）结合连续奖励信号能够更有效地对齐扩散模型，所提正则化机制可确保训练稳定性与保守性更新。

Abstract: Preference optimization has emerged as an efficient alternative to online reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) for aligning text-to-image diffusion models. However, existing methods largely reduce supervision to binary pairwise comparisons. This pairwise reduction is limiting when training data naturally contains multiple candidate images for the same prompt, and when continuous reward scores can provide richer information than a single winner-loser label. To address these limitations, we propose Diffusion LAIR, a reward-aware listwise preference optimization method for diffusion models. For each prompt, LAIR converts reward scores across a group of candidate images into centered advantage weights, then optimizes an advantage-weighted regression objective on the implicit reward, defined as the denoising-loss improvement of the current model over a fixed reference model, with a quadratic penalty that regularizes the magnitude of the implicit reward. The resulting objective uses all candidates simultaneously rather than selecting pairs, and remains conservative by explicitly controlling the magnitude of the implicit reward. The LAIR objective admits a bounded closed-form optimum in implicit-reward space, clarifying how the regularization strength controls the magnitude of the preference update. Experiments show that Diffusion LAIR outperforms strong preference optimization baselines on SD1.5 and SDXL across text-to-image generation, compositional generation, and image editing benchmarks.

</details>


### [277] [Dense2MoE: Pushing the Pareto Frontier of On-Device LLMs via Unified Pruning and Upcycling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26496)
*Fengfa Li,Hongjin Ji,Yifeng Ding,Lei Ren,Chen Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Dense2MoE提出了一种通过层融合上循环（LF-UC）将密集语言模型高效转换为适用于设备端部署的MoE模型的新框架，通过修剪冗余层的注意力模块并将MLP重利用为MoE专家，在严格限制活跃参数的同时保持模型核心能力，优于现有压缩和上循环方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE模型训练成本过高，当前将密集模型上循环为MoE的方法存在参数冗余影响推理效率，而标准层剪枝虽减少冗余但损害模型精度。为解决这一矛盾，需要一种既能消除冗余又能保持性能的高效转换方法。

Method: 提出Dense2MoE框架，核心是Layer Fusion UpCycling (LF-UC)：基于硬件Roofline理论，从冗余层中剪枝带宽密集的注意力模块，同时将其MLP重新利用为MoE专家，通过选择性令牌路由严格限制活跃参数数量，以少量持续预训练实现转换。

Result: 广泛的实验表明，Dense2MoE显著推进了设备端推理延迟与模型精度的帕累托前沿，性能优于密集基线模型、当前最先进的压缩方法以及标准上循环方法。

Conclusion: Dense2MoE成功统一了剪枝和上循环两种技术路线，通过LF-UC机制有效克服了推理中的"内存墙"问题，为将公开可用的密集大语言模型高效转换为适合设备端部署的MoE模型提供了一条实用路径。

Abstract: The Mixture of Experts MoE architecture is highly promising for resource constrained on device deployments yet training these models from scratch incurs prohibitive costs Current methods attempt to alleviate this by upcycling dense models into MoEs however they often introduce parameter redundancy that degrades inference efficiency Alternatively standard layer pruning mitigates redundancy but inevitably compromises model accuracy To resolve this dilemma we propose Dense2MoE a novel framework that unifies pruning and upcycling through Layer Fusion UpCycling LF UC Guided by hardware Roofline theory Dense2MoE systematically overcomes the inference memory wall by pruning bandwidth heavy attention modules from redundant layers while repurposing their Multi Layer Perceptrons MLPs into MoE experts This structural innovation preserves the models core capabilities and strictly limits active parameters via selective token routing With a modest continual pre training budget Dense2MoE efficiently converts publicly available dense LLMs into on device ready MoE models Extensive experiments demonstrate that Dense2MoE significantly advances the Pareto frontier for on device inference latency versus model accuracy outperforming dense baselines state of the art compression and standard upcycling methods

</details>


### [278] [PRISM: Position-encoded Regressive Inverse Spectral Model for Multilayer Thin-Film Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26502)
*Runtian Wang,Renhao Xue,Baige Chen,Hao Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM是一种基于自回归Transformer的模型，用于多层薄膜光学涂层设计的逆问题，通过统一预测离散材料选择和连续厚度回归，在参数减少80%的情况下将MAE降低50%以上，44M参数版本达到SOTA（MAE=0.010），速度远超模拟退火方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多层薄膜光学涂层设计的逆问题是一个复杂的组合-连续联合优化挑战，传统的模拟退火等优化方法计算效率低下，亟需一种更高效的端到端解决方案。

Method: 提出PRISM架构：(1) 采用解码器-only自回归Transformer作为统一骨干网络；(2) 引入频谱前缀条件化（spectrum prefix conditioning），通过标准前缀令牌实现上下文目标注入；(3) 提出累积深度旋转位置编码（cumulative-depth Rotary Position Embeddings），将连续厚度直接编码到位置表示中，以保留物理堆叠的空间关系。

Result: PRISM-13M模型相比其他Transformer基线MAE降低50%以上，且仅使用五分之一参数；PRISM-44M变体在分布内验证集上达到SOTA（MAE=0.010），运行速度显著快于模拟退火。

Conclusion: PRISM为多层薄膜光学涂层逆设计提供了一种高效、准确的替代方案，以极低的计算成本实现了优于传统优化方法的性能。

Abstract: The inverse problem of multilayer thin-film optical coatings design represents a complex combinatorial-continuous optimization challenge. We present PRISM (Position-encoded Regressive Inverse Spectral Model), a unified decoder-only autoregressive transformer that streamlines this process by jointly predicting discrete material selection and continuous thickness regression within a single backbone. PRISM introduces two primary architectural innovations: (1) spectrum prefix conditioning, which utilizes standard prefix tokens for in-context target injection, and (2) cumulative-depth Rotary Position Embeddings, which encode continuous thickness directly into the positional representation to preserve the physical spatial relationships of the stack. Our benchmarks demonstrate that a PRISM-13M model reduces MAE by over 50\% compared to other transformer baselines while utilizing only one-fifth of the parameters. Furthermore, a 44M-parameter variant achieves state-of-the-art performance (MAE = 0.010) on our in-distribution validation benchmark and operates significantly faster than simulated annealing, offering a highly efficient alternative to classical optimization methods.

</details>


### [279] [SIKA-GP: Accelerating Gaussian Process Inference with Sparse Inducing Kernel Approximations for Bayesian Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26509)
*Wenyuan Zhao,Rui Tuo,Chao Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SIKA-GP通过基于二进有序模板基的稀疏诱导核近似，将高斯过程的计算复杂度降至O(log M)，支持高效GPU计算并可嵌入贝叶斯神经网络，在视觉和Transformer语言基准上实现快速准确的核学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高斯过程虽为不确定性估计提供了贝叶斯框架，但其计算复杂度严重限制了在大规模数据集上的可扩展性。

Method: 提出SIKA-GP方法，采用基于二进有序模板基的稀疏诱导核近似，构建紧凑且表达力强的核表示，仅需O(log M)复杂度依赖诱导点数量，支持张量化GPU计算，并可自然嵌入具有稀疏激活的贝叶斯神经网络。

Result: 在视觉和基于Transformer的语言基准上，该方法 consistently 提供快速且准确的GP模型，在训练和推理中均取得显著加速而不牺牲预测性能。

Conclusion: SIKA-GP为可扩展核学习提供了一条 principled 的路径，有效解决了深度架构和高维特征表示带来的可扩展性挑战。

Abstract: Gaussian processes (GPs) provide a principled Bayesian framework for uncertainty estimation, but their computational complexity severely limits scalability to large datasets. We propose SIKA-GP, which accelerates GP inference using sparse inducing kernel approximations based on a dyadic ordered template basis, incurring only ${O}(\log M)$ complexity dependence on the number of inducing points. Our approach constructs compact and expressive kernel representations from sparsely activated bases, enabling efficient tensorized GPU computation and seamless integration with modern large-scale models. SIKA-GP can be naturally embedded into Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) with sparse activations, yielding significant speedups in both training and inference without sacrificing predictive performance. The method naturally extends to deep feature learning, addressing the scalability challenges introduced by deep architectures and high-dimensional feature representations. Empirical results on vision and transformer-based language benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently delivers fast and accurate GP models, providing a principled path toward scalable kernel learning.

</details>


### [280] [Open-Weight LLM Fine-Tuning Defenses are Susceptible to Simple Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26526)
*Kevin Kuo,Chhavi Yadav,Virginia Smith*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现开源大模型的安全防护措施易受abliteration和prefilling两种低代价攻击，并提出abliteration-resistant tuning（ART）防御方法，将攻击成功率降低10%-20%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全防御假设新的有害行为只能通过微调习得，而非通过越狱诱导。但预训练模型已编码大量有害知识，因此需验证攻击者能否在不微调的情况下仅通过越狱突破安全防护。

Method: 1) 评估两种低代价攻击（abliteration和prefilling）对开源安全模型的攻击效果；2) 提出ART（abliteration-resistant tuning），在训练中融入abliteration目标，可叠加到现有防御之上。

Result: 在BeaverTails、HarmBench、AdvBench三个基准上，攻击成功率从低于10%提升至16%-96%；ART将abliteration、prefilling及组合攻击的成功率降低10%-20%。

Conclusion: 开源模型的安全攻击面比此前认知的更广，安全防御评估应纳入更多元化的攻击策略（不仅限于对抗性微调）。

Abstract: Recent defenses for safeguarding open-weight large language models (LLMs) are intended to prevent adversarial usage. Underlying these defenses is an assumption that new harmful behavior is learned through fine-tuning rather than elicited by jailbreaking the model. Yet, pretrained LLMs already encode substantial harmful knowledge across many domains, which raises an important question: can an adversary jailbreak safeguarded models, to achieve harmful usage without fine-tuning at all? In this paper, we show that open-weight safeguards are susceptible to simpler strategies that, despite being well known, have not been systematically evaluated against these safeguards. Specifically, we evaluate two low-cost attacks--abliteration and prefilling--that do not rely on gradient-based optimization. Across three harmfulness evaluation benchmarks (BeaverTails, HarmBench, and AdvBench), these attacks increase attack success rates against safeguarded open-weight models from below 10\% to a range of 16%-96%. To mitigate this vulnerability, we introduce abliteration-resistant tuning (ART), which incorporates an abliteration-based objective into training. ART can be layered onto existing defenses and reduces the success rates of abliteration, prefilling, and their combination by 10%-20%. These findings indicate that the attack surface for open-weight models is broader than previously characterized, and that evaluations of safeguarding defenses should incorporate a more diverse set of attack strategies beyond adversarial fine-tuning.

</details>


### [281] [Recursive Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26535)
*Jiahe Huang,Sihan Xu,Sharvaree Vadgama,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出递归流匹配（RecFM）框架，通过自一致性约束对齐不同离散尺度轨迹，在科学基准上实现高达20倍加速和15%以上均方误差降低，首次在1-4步生成中达到与多步求解器相当的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成模型在求解物理系统和建模复杂时空动力学时面临速度-保真度权衡，高物理精度往往伴随高计算成本。

Method: 提出Recursive Flow Matching (RecFM)框架，通过引入自一致性约束，强制对齐不同离散化尺度下的轨迹，减少离散化误差。

Result: 相比领先的扩散仿真器获得高达20倍加速，同时提升预测精度；相比普通流匹配降低超过15%的均方误差。

Conclusion: RecFM是首个在1-4步动态生成中达到与多步求解器可比精度的生成方法，为实时科学仿真提供了可扩展且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Generative models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving physics systems and modeling complex spatiotemporal dynamics. However, achieving high physical accuracy without incurring high computational cost remains a fundamental challenge, as existing approaches face a critical speed-fidelity trade-off. In this work, we introduce Recursive Flow Matching (RecFM), a generative framework for forecasting complex spatiotemporal dynamics. RecFM enforces self-consistency to align trajectories across discretization scales, reducing discretization errors and improving performance across metrics for physics-based tasks. To our knowledge, this is the first method to achieve high-fidelity one- and few-step (2-4 step) dynamic generation for scientific systems with performance comparable to state-of-the-art multi-step solvers. Across challenging scientific benchmarks, RecFM achieves up to a 20$\times$ speedup over leading diffusion-based emulators while improving predictive accuracy. Furthermore, RecFM reduces mean squared error by over 15% compared to vanilla flow matching, offering a scalable and efficient solution for real-time scientific emulation.

</details>


### [282] [Aligning Few-Step Generative Models by Amortizing Sample-based Variational Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26552)
*Jaewoo Lee,Hyeongyu Kang,Dohyun Kim,Kyuil Sim,Woocheol Shin,Minsu Kim,Taeyoung Yun,Jeongjae Lee,Sanghyeok Choi,Tabitha Edith Lee,Jongchul Ye,Jinkyoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FAV是一个通用的少步生成模型对齐框架，通过基于样本的变分推断（SVGD）将生成器与奖励倾斜分布对齐，无需似然、特定求解器或模型族限制，在机器人操作和图像生成两个领域均取得优异性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐框架通常依赖严格假设（如可计算似然、特定ODE/SDE求解器或特定模型族），缺乏一个通用的、仅需样本访问的对齐方法。

Method: 将对齐问题建模为从奖励倾斜分布中采样，使用Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）进行基于样本的变分推断，并通过不动点回归将粒子更新摊销到生成器参数中。

Result: 在机器人操作领域：56个离线RL任务和30个离线到在线RL任务上优于现有策略提取基线；在图像生成领域：成功微调GAN、漂移模型、一致性模型和流映射等多种少步生成模型，覆盖ImageNet-256到1024²文本到图像合成。

Conclusion: FAV提供了一个通用、灵活的少步生成模型对齐框架，仅需样本访问即可工作，在两个差异显著的领域均验证了其有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Aligning a few-step generative model is challenging, since existing alignment frameworks typically rely on restrictive assumptions: a tractable likelihood, a specific ODE/SDE solver, or a particular model family. We introduce FAV, Few-step Generative Models Alignment via Sample-based Variational Inference, a general alignment framework that requires only sample access to the generator and the reference distribution. We cast alignment as sampling from a reward-tilted distribution anchored to a reference distribution. We leverage Stein Variational Gradient Descent as a sample-based variational inference scheme and amortize its particle updates into the generator parameters via fixed-point regression. We evaluate FAV on two domains: robotics manipulation and image generator alignment. On generative policy alignment for robotic manipulation, FAV outperforms prevailing policy extraction baselines across 56 offline and 30 offline-to-online RL tasks. For image generator alignment, FAV fine-tunes diverse few-step backbones, including GAN, drifting model, consistency models, and flow maps, scaling from ImageNet-$256$ to 1024$^2$ text-to-image synthesis. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaewoopudding/FAV.

</details>


### [283] [Linear and Neural Dueling Bandits with Delayed Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26554)
*Xiangyi Wang,Pingchen Lu,Jie Mao,Mingze Kong,Zhi Hong,Zhiyong Wang,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对上下文对决赌博机在随机延迟反馈场景下的问题，提出了两种新算法（线性LDB-DF和神经NDB-DF），通过将逆概率加权（IPW）机制直接集成到损失函数中实现无偏估计，并在理论和实验上证明了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准上下文对决赌博机算法假设即时反馈，但现实场景（如提示优化）中反馈常存在延迟，且对决赌博机估计器缺乏闭式解，导致标准加权技术的简单适配会产生有偏估计。

Method: 1) 形式化定义了带有随机延迟反馈的上下文对决赌博机问题；2) 提出两种算法：线性LDB-DF和神经NDB-DF；3) 核心创新是设计了一种将逆概率加权（IPW）机制直接集成到损失函数中的新型估计器，实现对延迟或缺失反馈的无偏修正。

Result: 线性设定下达到O(d√T)的遗憾界，神经设定下达到次线性遗憾界；在模拟和真实数据集上的大量实验验证了算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作首次系统性地解决了上下文对决赌博机中随机延迟反馈的挑战，提出的IPW集成估计器为延迟反馈下的偏好学习提供了理论基础和实用算法。

Abstract: Contextual dueling bandits form a cornerstone of preference-based decision-making, with critical applications in
  recommender systems and large language model alignment. However, standard algorithms rely on the idealized assumption
  of immediate feedback, a condition frequently violated in real-world scenarios such as prompt optimization. This
  setting introduces a unique theoretical challenge: unlike linear bandits, dueling bandit estimators lack closed-form
  solutions, rendering naive adaptations of standard weighting techniques biased. To address this, we formalize the
  problem of Contextual Dueling Bandits with Stochastic Delayed Feedback and propose two novel algorithms: Linear
  (LDB-DF) and Neural (NDB-DF) Dueling Bandits with Delayed Feedback. Central to our approach is a novel estimator that
  integrates an Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) mechanism directly into the loss function, ensuring unbiased
  correction for delayed or missing feedback. We provide comprehensive theoretical analysis, establishing an
  O(d*sqrt(T)) regret bound for the linear setting and sub-linear guarantees for the neural setting. Extensive
  experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our propose.

</details>


### [284] [Auditing and Fixing Economic Validity in Tabular Foundation Models for Discrete Choice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26559)
*Yingshuo Wang,Xian Sun,Yanhang Li,Zhichao Fan,Zexin Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种两阶段适配器，将表格基础模型的预测嵌入效用最大化框架，在保持经济一致性的同时提升预测准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型在类别预测任务上准确率高，但其预测常违反经济逻辑（如提价导致需求上升、意愿支付估计为负），需要一种方法在保留其准确性的同时确保经济合理性。

Method: 两阶段适配器：第一阶段估计标准选择模型，参数受经济理论约束；第二阶段冻结这些参数，训练一个校正项来融入基础模型的预测信息。

Result: 在两个交通数据集上，适配器相比标准logit模型恢复了最高13个百分点的准确率，同时保持了完全的经济一致性，原始基础模型和传统蒸馏方法均无法实现。

Conclusion: 该方法成功融合了基础模型的准确性与经济理论的一致性，保证了价格-需求关系的单调性，并可提供解析计算的经济指标。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve strong accuracy on choice prediction tasks, but their predictions often violate the economic logic those tasks require: raising a price sometimes increases predicted demand, and implied willingness-to-pay estimates are frequently negative or implausible. We propose a two-stage adapter that embeds foundation model predictions within a utility-maximization framework. In the first stage, we estimate a standard choice model whose parameters are constrained to obey economic theory. In the second stage, we freeze those parameters and train a correction term that incorporates the foundation model's predictions as additional information.
