GCOS addresses a limitation of prior synthesis methods by generating virtual outliers in the hidden feature space that respect the learned manifold structure of in-distribution (ID) data. The synthesis proceeds in two stages: (i) a dominant-variance subspace extracted from the training features identifies geometrically informed, off-manifold directions; (ii) a conformally-inspired shell, defined by the empirical quantiles of a nonconformity score from a calibration set, adaptively controls the synthesis magnitude to produce boundary samples. The shell ensures that generated outliers are neither trivially detectable nor indistinguishable from in-distribution data, facilitating smoother learning of robust features. This is combined with a contrastive regularization objective that promotes separability of ID and OOD samples in a chosen score space, such as Mahalanobis or energy-based. Experiments demonstrate that GCOS outperforms state-of-the-art methods using standard energy-based inference on near-OOD benchmarks, defined as tasks where outliers share the same semantic domain as in-distribution data. As an exploratory extension, the framework naturally transitions to conformal OOD inference, which translates uncertainty scores into statistically valid p-values and enables thresholds with formal error guarantees, providing a pathway toward more predictable and reliable OOD detection.

</details>


### [433] [Grammar of the Wave: Towards Explainable Multivariate Time Series Event Detection via Neuro-Symbolic VLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11479)
*Sky Chenwei Wan,Yifei Y. Wang,Tianjun Hou,Xiqing Chang,Aymeric Jan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向时间序列事件检测的语言引导范式，设计ELT知识表示框架将文本描述转化为时序逻辑，并构建SELA神经符号VLM智能体实现零/少样本事件定位与可解释推理，在能源与气候领域基准上超越监督微调等方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列事件检测（TSED）中，事件常由自然语言定义且包含跨物理通道的时序逻辑结构，但密集的事件标注成本高昂，纯监督学习难以适用，亟需利用文本描述引导模型在少量或无标注数据下定位事件区间。

Method: 提出Event Logic Tree (ELT)将语言描述转化为信号基元上的结构化时序逻辑；基于ELT构建SELA，一种神经符号视觉语言模型智能体框架，通过迭代从信号可视化中识别基元并在ELT约束下组合，输出事件区间与树状可解释结构。

Result: 在能源与气候领域构建了包含专家知识与标注的真实世界基准。实验表明SELA在性能上超越监督微调及现有的零/少样本时间序列推理基线方法。

Conclusion: 语言引导的TSED范式结合ELT与SELA能有效解决标注稀缺问题，实现零样本事件定位与可解释推理，在领域基准上取得最优结果。

Abstract: Time Series Event Detection (TSED) aims to localize semantically meaningful events in time series data, with critical applications in high-stakes domains. Unlike statistical anomalies, events are often defined by natural-language descriptions with internal temporal-logic structures across multiple physical channels. However, in real-world settings, dense event annotations are expensive to obtain, making purely supervised learning difficult. We introduce Language-guided TSED, a setting where a model is given textual event descriptions and must ground them to intervals in multivariate signals with little or no labeled data. To address this problem, we propose Event Logic Tree (ELT), a knowledge representation framework that converts linguistic descriptions into structured temporal logic over signal primitives. Building on ELT, we present SELA, a neuro-symbolic VLM agent framework that iteratively grounds primitives from signal visualizations and composes them under ELT constraints, producing both event intervals and faithful tree-structured explanations. We further release a real-world benchmark across energy and climate domains with expert knowledge and annotations. Experiments show that SELA improves over supervised fine-tuning and existing zero/few-shot time series reasoning baselines.

</details>


### [434] [Disentangled Representation Learning through Unsupervised Symmetry Group Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.11790)
*Barthélémy Dang-Nhu,Louis Annabi,Sylvain Argentieri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需先验知识或严格假设的对称性解缠表征学习方法，通过具身智能体在无监督交互中自主发现动作空间的群结构，并证明了在最小假设下真实对称群分解的可识别性，最终在三种不同群分解环境中优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于对称性的解缠表征学习方法要么需要对称群结构的强先验知识，要么需要对子群性质做出严格限制性假设，这限制了方法的通用性和实用性。本文旨在去除这些约束，让智能体通过自主探索发现对称群结构。

Method: 1) 证明了在最小假设下真实对称群分解的可识别性；2) 提出一种从交互数据中发现群分解的算法；3) 提出一种无需特定子群假设即可学习线性对称解缠（LSBD）表征的算法。智能体通过无监督环境交互自主发现动作空间的群结构。

Result: 在三种具有不同群分解结构的环境中，所提方法均优于现有LSBD方法，验证了其有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该方法成功去除了对对称群先验知识和子群严格假设的依赖，通过自主探索实现了群结构发现和对称解缠表征学习，为更通用的解缠学习范式提供了理论基础和实践验证。

Abstract: Symmetry-based disentangled representation learning leverages the group structure of environment transformations to uncover the latent factors of variation. Prior approaches to symmetry-based disentanglement have required strong prior knowledge of the symmetry group's structure, or restrictive assumptions about the subgroup properties. In this work, we remove these constraints by proposing a method whereby an embodied agent autonomously discovers the group structure of its action space through unsupervised interaction with the environment. We prove the identifiability of the true symmetry group decomposition under minimal assumptions, and derive two algorithms: one for discovering the group decomposition from interaction data, and another for learning Linear Symmetry-Based Disentangled (LSBD) representations without assuming specific subgroup properties. Our method is validated on three environments exhibiting different group decompositions, where it outperforms existing LSBD approaches.

</details>


### [435] [FedTreeLoRA: Reconciling Statistical and Functional Heterogeneity in Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13282)
*Jieming Bian,Lei Wang,Letian Zhang,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FedTreeLoRA提出树状聚合结构，通过逐层动态构建聚合层次，在联邦LoRA微调中同时处理统计异质性和功能异质性，在NLU和NLG基准上超越SOTA方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦LoRA个性化方法仅处理客户端间的统计异质性（水平维度），却忽略了LLM不同层级间的功能异质性（垂直维度）。这两个维度正交但耦合，最优的参数共享深度取决于客户端相似度，现有方法无法解决这一问题。

Method: 提出FedTreeLoRA框架，采用树状聚合结构实现细粒度的逐层对齐。通过动态构建聚合层次，允许客户端在浅层（树干）共享广泛共识，在深层（树枝）逐步特化，从而在泛化与个性化之间取得平衡。

Result: 在NLU和NLG基准测试上，FedTreeLoRA显著优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 联邦LoRA微调需要同时考虑统计异质性和功能异质性，树状结构化聚合能有效解耦两者的耦合关系，实现更优的泛化-个性化权衡。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a standard for privacy-preserving LLM fine-tuning. However, existing personalized methods predominantly operated under a restrictive Flat-Model Assumption: they addressed client-side \textit{statistical heterogeneity} but treated the model as a monolithic block, ignoring the \textit{functional heterogeneity} across LLM layers. We argue that these two statistical (horizontal) and functional (vertical) dimensions, are \textit{orthogonal in source yet coupled in interaction}, implying that the optimal depth of parameter sharing is functionally dependent on client similarity. To address this, we propose \textbf{FedTreeLoRA}, a framework employing tree-structured aggregation for fine-grained, layer-wise alignment. By dynamically constructing an aggregation hierarchy, FedTreeLoRA allows clients to share broad consensus on shallow `trunks' while progressively specializing on deep `branches'. Experiments on NLU and NLG benchmarks demonstrate that FedTreeLoRA significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods by effectively reconciling generalization and personalization.

</details>


### [436] [Beyond Linearity in Attention Projections: The Case for Nonlinear Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13381)
*Marko Karbevski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用非线性残差结构 $Q(X)=X+f_θ(X)$ 替代 Transformer 中的 Query 投影 $W_Q$，其中 $f_θ$ 为瓶颈 MLP。实验表明该方法在 GPT-3 small 风格模型上优于基线（验证集 log-loss 降低 2.40%，困惑度降低 6.81%），且超过参数增加 12.5% 的对照模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有代数分析表明 Transformer 中 Query 投影 $W_Q$ 可设为单位矩阵而不损失性能，因为注意力仅通过 $XW_Q, XW_K, XW_V$ 依赖 $X$，基变换可被相邻层吸收。作者希望利用这一发现，用更灵活的非线性残差结构替代 $W_Q$，在保持恒等映射先验的同时引入额外表达能力。

Method: 将 $W_Q \in \R^{d \times d}$ 替换为 $Q(X) = X + f_θ(X)$，其中 $f_θ$ 是一个瓶颈 MLP，参数量为 $d^2 + O(d)$。恒等项 $X$ 将非线性锚定在已知良好的先验（即单位矩阵）上，瓶颈 MLP 提供可学习的非线性校正。

Result: 在 GPT-3 small 风格模型上，该方法相比基线验证集 log-loss 降低 2.40%，困惑度降低 6.81%，且优于参数量增加 12.5% 的对照模型。

Conclusion: 该残差 Query 投影方案在中等规模上表现优异，值得在更大规模和其他模态上进一步探索。

Abstract: Recent algebraic analysis shows that in decoder-only and encoder-only transformers, the Query projection $W_Q$ may be set to identity without noticeable performance deterioration. This is possible because attention depends on $X$ only through the products $XW_Q, XW_K, XW_V$, allowing basis transformations to be absorbed by adjacent layers and propagated through the network. We replace $W_Q \in \R^{d \times d}$ with a nonlinear residual of the form $Q(X) = X + f_θ(X)$, where $f_θ$ is a bottleneck MLP with $d^2 + O(d)$ parameters. The identity term anchors the nonlinearity to a known-good prior. Experiments on GPT-3 small style models show consistent improvement over the baseline ($2.40\%$ lower validation log-loss, $6.81\%$ lower perplexity), comfortably outperforming a model with 12.5\% more non-embedding parameters. These results motivate investigation at larger scales and across modalities.

</details>


### [437] [Flow Matching Policy Optimization with Mirror Descent and Entropy Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.17685)
*Ting Gao,Stavros Orfanoudakis,Nan Lin,Winnie Daamen,Serge Hoogendoorn,Elvin Isufi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FMER框架，利用基于ODE的流匹配替代基于SDE的扩散策略，解决了在线强化学习中的探索-利用权衡问题。该方法通过优势加权条件流匹配损失作为策略镜像梯度的无仿真替代，推导了tanh变换下的解析熵目标，并基于有效样本量动态调温，在稀疏奖励的FrankaKitchen环境中取得最优性能，同时在密集奖励的MuJoCo基准上保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线强化学习中，基于SDE的扩散策略存在两个关键局限：随机反向过程导致熵无法计算（需要启发式探索），且通过长去噪链计算策略梯度昂贵且不稳定。作者旨在通过ODE流匹配从根本上解决这些问题。

Method: 1) 理论证明优势加权条件流匹配损失可作为策略镜像梯度的无仿真替代，避免通过ODE求解器反向传播；2) 推导tanh变换下修正密度失真的解析熵目标，实现原则性最大熵优化；3) 基于有效样本量动态调节镜像下降温度，确保鲁棒的信任区域。

Result: 在稀疏奖励的FrankaKitchen环境中取得最优性能，在密集奖励的标准MuJoCo基准上保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 基于ODE的流匹配策略相比基于SDE的扩散策略，在保持表达力的同时，实现了更稳定的训练和更有效的探索，为在线RL中应用生成式策略提供了新范式。

Abstract: Balancing policy expressiveness with the exploration-exploitation trade-off is a core challenge in online Reinforcement Learning (RL). While Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE)-based diffusion policies can represent complex, multimodal action distributions, they suffer from two critical limitations: their stochastic reverse processes render entropy intractable (necessitating heuristic exploration), and computing policy gradients through long denoising chains is expensive and unstable. In this work, we show that ODE-based flow matching inherently resolves these issues by enabling both simulation-free policy optimization and tractable entropy computation. Building on this, we introduce Flow Matching Policy Optimization with Mirror Descent and Entropy Constraints (FMER). Our framework exploits this insight in three ways. First, we theoretically establish that minimizing an advantage-weighted conditional flow matching loss acts as a simulation-free surrogate for policy mirror descent. This steers the velocity field toward high-value regions while entirely avoiding backpropagation through the ODE solver. Second, we derive an analytic entropy objective that corrects for the density distortion caused by the $\tanh$ transformation (mapping an unbounded latent space to bounded actions), thereby facilitating principled maximum-entropy optimization. Finally, we dynamically tune the mirror descent temperature based on the effective sample size to enforce a robust trust region during training. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that FMER achieves superior performance on the challenging sparse-reward FrankaKitchen environment, while maintaining competitive results across standard dense-reward MuJoCo benchmarks.

</details>


### [438] [Diet Your LLM: Dimension-wise Global Pruning of LLMs via Merging Task-specific Importance Score](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23985)
*Jimyung Hong,Jaehyung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DIET是一种无需训练的LLM结构化剪枝方法，通过跨任务的重要性分数融合进行维度级全局剪枝，在Gemma-2模型上以20%稀疏度实现了相比此前最优方法近10%的平均准确率提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法存在关键权衡：任务无关方法无法适应特定任务需求，而任务感知方法需要昂贵的训练来学习任务适应性。因此需要一种无需训练、兼具任务感知能力和细粒度剪枝的方法。

Method: DIET首先使用每任务仅100个样本计算激活幅度分布来刻画任务层面的维度重要性，然后通过多数投票机制融合多个任务的重要性分数，生成单一的全局剪枝掩码，实现无需预计算或额外训练的维度级结构化剪枝。

Result: 在Gemma-2 2B和9B模型的七个零样本基准上，DIET在20%稀疏度下相比此前最优结构化剪枝方法提升了近10%的平均准确率，且该优势在不同稀疏度和模型规模下保持稳定。

Conclusion: DIET定位为一种实用且鲁棒的结构化LLM剪枝方案，以训练免费、细粒度、任务感知等特性有效解决了现有方法的权衡困境。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, but their massive scale poses significant challenges for practical deployment. Structured pruning offers a promising solution by removing entire dimensions or layers, yet existing methods face critical trade-offs: task-agnostic approaches cannot adapt to task-specific requirements, while task-aware methods require costly training to learn task adaptability. We propose DIET (Dimension-wise global pruning of LLMs via merging Task-wise importance scores), a training-free structured pruning method that combines dimension-level granularity with task-aware selection. DIET profiles activation magnitudes across tasks using only 100 samples per task, then applies majority voting to construct a single global mask. DIET does not require large costs from pre-computation or training. Experiments on seven zero-shot benchmarks using Gemma-2 2B and 9B models demonstrate the effectiveness of DIET; for example, at 20% sparsity on Gemma-2 2B, DIET achieves near 10% average accuracy improvement, compared to previous state-of-the-art structured pruning methods. This advantage persists across various sparsity levels and model scales, positioning DIET as a practical and robust choice for structured LLM pruning.

</details>


### [439] [Understanding the Challenges in Iterative Generative Optimization with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23994)
*Allen Nie,Xavier Daull,Zhiyi Kuang,Abhinav Akkiraju,Anish Chaudhuri,Max Piasevoli,Ryan Rong,YuCheng Yuan,Prerit Choudhary,Shannon Xiao,Rasool Fakoor,Adith Swaminathan,Ching-An Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 生成式优化使用LLM迭代改进工件，但实践中仅有9%的智能体采用自动优化，其脆弱性源于工程师必须做出隐藏设计选择。本文通过三个案例研究发现起点工件、信用归因时域和批处理策略等设计决策决定优化成败，并指出缺乏跨领域的通用学习循环设置方法是生产化的主要障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式优化虽前景广阔，但实践中存在脆弱性，仅有9%的智能体采用自动优化，原因是工程师必须做出影响成败的"隐藏"设计选择（可编辑内容、学习证据等），而这些选择在先前工作中很少被明确讨论。

Method: 通过三个案例研究（MLAgentBench、Atari、BigBench Extra Hard）系统性调查三个关键因素：起点工件（决定可达解空间）、信用归因时域（截断轨迹仍可改进Atari智能体）、批处理策略（更大mini-batch不会单调提升BBEH泛化性能）。

Result: 不同起点工件决定MLAgentBench中哪些解可达；截断轨迹仍可改进Atari智能体；更大minibatch不会单调提升BBEH泛化性能。

Conclusion: 缺乏跨领域的通用学习循环设置方法是生成式优化生产化和广泛采用的主要障碍，并为此类设计选择提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Generative optimization uses large language models (LLMs) to iteratively improve artifacts (such as code, workflows or prompts) using execution feedback. It is a promising approach to building self-improving agents, yet in practice remains brittle: despite active research, only 9% of surveyed agents used any automated optimization. We argue that this brittleness arises because, to set up a learning loop, an engineer must make ``hidden'' design choices: What can the optimizer edit and what is the "right" learning evidence to provide at each update? We investigate three factors that affect most applications: the starting artifact, the credit horizon for execution traces, and batching trials and errors into learning evidence. Through case studies in MLAgentBench, Atari, and BigBench Extra Hard, we find that these design decisions can determine whether generative optimization succeeds, yet they are rarely made explicit in prior work. Different starting artifacts determine which solutions are reachable in MLAgentBench, truncated traces can still improve Atari agents, and larger minibatches do not monotonically improve generalization on BBEH. We conclude that the lack of a simple, universal way to set up learning loops across domains is a major hurdle for productionization and adoption. We provide practical guidance for making these choices.

</details>


### [440] [Where Hindsight Credit Can Reside: A Signed-Capacity View of Token Updates in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11056)
*Yuhang He,Haodong Wu,Siyi Liu,Hongyu Ge,Hange Zhou,Keyi Wu,Zhuo Zheng,Qihong Lin,Zixin Zhong,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析RLVR中基于事后视角的token级信用分配机制，提出四象限分解揭示熵与奖励极性对更新的联合作用，并设计HAPO方法进行容量引导的Advantage重分配以提升推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR中稀疏的最终奖励使得token级别的信用分配困难，现有方法缺少对token级事后信用分配机制的深入理解。

Method: 通过条件互信息(CMI)将token级信用定义为从行为策略到事后后验的奖励条件偏移；提出四象限分解，依据奖励极性与token熵将更新分离；设计HAPO，一种保号修改的GRPO方法，实现容量引导的优势重分配。

Result: 持续推理增益集中在有符号的高熵象限；低熵更新快速饱和；HAPO在数学推理基准上达到具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: token熵限制了事后信用的上限，但熵仅指示容量而非更新方向；结合奖励极性与熵的四象限分解能有效指导token级更新；HAPO通过保号修改可提升RLVR性能。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning ability of Large Language Models (LLMs), but sparse outcome rewards make token-level credit assignment difficult.
  We study token-level credit as a reward-conditioned shift from the behavior policy to a hindsight posterior.
  In autoregressive RLVR, this shift can be expressed through Conditional Mutual Information (CMI), which shows that token entropy upper-bounds possible hindsight credit.
  Entropy, however, indicates capacity rather than update direction, so we introduce the Four Quadrant Decomposition to separate updates by reward polarity and token entropy.
  Controlled interventions show that these two factors jointly shape token updates.
  Sustained reasoning gains concentrate in signed high-entropy quadrants, whereas low-entropy updates saturate quickly.
  Based on this analysis, we propose Hindsight-Aware Policy Optimization (HAPO), a sign-preserving modification to GRPO that performs capacity-guided advantage reallocation.
  Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks in two model settings show that HAPO achieves competitive performance among entropy-aware baselines.

</details>


### [441] [Dynamic Adversarial Fine-Tuning Reorganizes Refusal Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27019)
*Wenhao Lan,Shan Li,Xinhua Lai,Meiqi Wu,Junbin Yang,Haihua Shen,Yijun Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究安全对齐语言模型在动态对抗微调（R2D2）下拒绝控制载体的几何变化，发现R2D2早期能完全阻断攻击但牺牲实用性，后期恢复实用性却重新打开攻击漏洞，且拒绝控制载体从浅层迁移到深层，有效秩始终接近1.24，表明这是一种沿鲁棒性-实用性边界的几何重组而非维度扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 安全对齐的语言模型需要拒绝有害请求但避免过度拒绝，动态对抗微调如何改变拒绝控制的低维载体（KL约束方向或子空间）尚不清楚，需要揭示其几何变化机制。

Method: 使用7B骨干模型，在SFT和R2D2条件下，结合HarmBench、StrongREJECT、XSTest评估与五锚点几何测量、因果干预和稀疏自适应压力测试进行系统分析。

Result: R2D2早期检查点将攻击成功率降至零但XSTest拒绝最大且实用性失败；后期恢复实用性但攻击成功率回升（GCG攻击从0.415升至0.613）。拒绝控制载体从后期层迁移到早期层，有效秩≈1.24，SFT主角漂移更大。

Conclusion: R2D2的鲁棒性变化本质是沿鲁棒性-实用性边界的几何重组，而非维度扩展或漂移幅度变化，且未建立自适应鲁棒性。

Abstract: Safety-aligned language models must refuse harmful requests without broad over-refusal, but it remains unclear how dynamic adversarial fine-tuning changes refusal-control carriers: Kullback--Leibler (KL)-constrained directions or small subspaces that causally modulate refusal without large safe-prompt distribution shifts. We study a 7B backbone under supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Robust Refusal Dynamic Defense (R2D2), aligning HarmBench, StrongREJECT, and XSTest evaluations with five-anchor geometry measurements, causal interventions, and sparse adaptive stress tests. R2D2 drives fixed-source HarmBench attack success to zero at early checkpoints; however, these checkpoints also exhibit maximal XSTest refusal and fail a benign-utility audit. Later checkpoints partially recover utility-facing behavior while reopening attack success, with adaptive GCG attack success rate rising to 0.415 at step 250 and 0.613 at step 500. Internally, R2D2 preserves a late-layer admissible refusal-control carrier through step 100 and then relocates the best admissible carrier to an early layer; SFT relocates earlier yet remains less robust. Effective rank stays near 1.24, and SFT shows larger principal-angle drift, arguing against both dimensional expansion and drift magnitude as sufficient explanations. Causal interventions support a low-dimensional but utility-coupled carrier. These results support a geometry-reorganization account of R2D2 along a robustness--utility frontier, without establishing adaptive robustness.

</details>


### [442] [BrainDINO: A Brain MRI Foundation Model for Generalizable Clinical Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27277)
*Yizhou Wu,Shansong Wang,Yuheng Li,Mojtaba Safari,Mingzhe Hu,Chih-Wei Chang,Harini Veeraraghavan,Xiaofeng Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BrainDINO，一种基于自蒸馏的脑部MRI基础模型，在约660万张无标注轴向切片上训练，通过冻结编码器加轻量任务头的方式，可泛化至肿瘤分割、神经退行性疾病分类、脑龄估计、卒中后时间预测、分子状态预测、MRI序列分类和生存建模等多种任务，在标签稀缺场景下优势尤为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大多数基于学习的脑MRI方法为任务特化模型，需要大量标注数据，缺乏能够在多种脑MRI任务间泛化的统一表征，因此需要一种大规模、自监督、可迁移的基础模型。

Method: 在来自20个数据集、约660万张无标注轴向切片上，采用自蒸馏（self-distillation）方式训练BrainDINO模型；下游任务时冻结编码器，仅训练轻量任务头，无需体素级预训练或全网络微调。

Result: BrainDINO在肿瘤分割、神经退行性和神经发育疾病分类、脑龄估计、卒中后时间预测、分子状态预测、MRI序列分类、生存建模等任务上一致达到或超过自然图像和MRI专用自监督基线方法，在标签稀缺时优势尤为突出；表征分析显示其具有解剖有组织和病理敏感的特征结构。

Conclusion: 大规模切片级自监督学习能够生成统一的脑MRI表征，支持多种神经影像任务，无需体素级预训练或全网络微调，为鲁棒且数据高效的脑影像分析建立了可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Brain MRI underpins a wide range of neuroscientific and clinical applications, yet most learning-based methods remain task-specific and require substantial labeled data. Here we show that a single self-supervised representation can generalize across heterogeneous brain MRI endpoints. We trained BrainDINO, a self-distilled foundation model, on approximately 6.6 million unlabeled axial slices from 20 datasets encompassing broad variation in population, disease, and acquisition setting. Using a frozen encoder with lightweight task heads, BrainDINO supported transfer across tumor segmentation, neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental conditions classification, brain age estimation, post-stroke temporal prediction, molecular status prediction, MRI sequence classification, and survival modeling. Across tasks and supervision regimes, BrainDINO consistently equaled or exceeded natural-image and MRI-specific self-supervised baselines, with particularly strong advantages under label scarcity. Representation analyses further showed anatomically organized and pathology-sensitive feature structure in the absence of task-specific supervision. Our findings indicate that large-scale slice-wise self-supervised learning can yield a unified brain MRI representation that supports diverse neuroimaging tasks without volumetric pretraining or full-network fine-tuning, establishing a scalable foundation for robust and data-efficient brain imaging analysis. Code is available at https://github.com/mclwu22/BrainDINO

</details>


### [443] [Skipping the Zeros in Diffusion Models for Sparse Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01817)
*Phil Sidney Ostheimer,Mayank Nagda,Andriy Balinskyy,Gabriel Vicente Rodrigues,Jean Radig,Carl Herrmann,Stephan Mandt,Marius Kloft,Sophie Fellenz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SED是一种针对稀疏连续数据设计的扩散模型，通过仅对非零值建模来保留稀疏性，在训练和推理中跳过零值，从而在保持或提升生成质量的同时实现计算节省。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统扩散模型在处理稀疏连续数据时存在局限：无法建模代表信号刻意缺失的精确零值，会抹除稀疏模式并对大量零条目进行不必要的计算。

Method: SED仅对非零值进行建模，在训练和推理过程中跳过零值，从而保留数据的稀疏结构。

Result: 在物理和生物学基准测试中，SED达到或超越了传统扩散模型及领域专用基线方法；视觉实验直观展示了密集扩散模型的局限性以及SED的优势。

Conclusion: SED能够利用稀疏性实现计算节省，同时保持或提升生成质量，有效解决了传统扩散模型在处理稀疏连续数据时的根本缺陷。

Abstract: Diffusion models (DMs) excel on dense continuous data, but are not designed for sparse continuous data. They do not model exact zeros that represent the deliberate absence of a signal. As a result, they erase sparsity patterns and perform unnecessary computation on mostly zero entries. With Sparsity-Exploiting Diffusion (SED), we model only non-zero values, preserving sparsity. SED delivers computational savings while maintaining or improving generation quality by skipping zeros during training and inference. Across physics and biology benchmarks, SED matches or surpasses conventional DMs and domain-specific baselines, while vision experiments provide intuitive insights into the limitations of dense DMs and the benefits of SED.

</details>


### [444] [Grokking or Glitching? How Low-Precision Drives Slingshot Loss Spikes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.06152)
*Liu Hanqing,Jianjun Cao,Yuanze Li,Zijian Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明深度神经网络在无正则化长期训练中出现的周期性损失尖峰（Slingshot Mechanism）源于浮点运算精度限制。当训练进入高置信阶段，正确类logit与其他logit的差值超过吸收误差阈值时，反向传播中正确类的梯度被精确舍入为零，破坏了跨类别的梯度零和约束，导致分类器层参数更新出现系统性漂移。这种漂移与特征形成正反馈循环，使全局分类器均值和特征均值呈指数增长，称为数值特征膨胀（NFI）。该机制解释了Slingshot尖峰前的快速范数增长、梯度重新出现及损失尖峰。部分吸收虽不产生可见尖峰，但仍会破坏零和约束并驱动参数范数快速增长。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将Slingshot Mechanism归因于内在优化动力学，但其触发机制尚不清楚。本文旨在揭示该现象的数学根源，为理解浮点精度限制如何影响深度学习训练中的异常行为提供可检验的解释。

Method: 通过理论分析证明，在高置信度训练阶段，正确类logit与其他logit的差值超过浮点数吸收误差阈值后，反向传播中正确类梯度被精确舍入为零，而错误类梯度非零。由此产生的梯度零和约束破坏导致分类器参数更新漂移，进而形成与特征之间的正反馈循环，实现全局均值的指数增长（NFI）。

Result: NFI机制解释了Slingshot尖峰前的快速范数增长、梯度重新出现和损失尖峰的完整过程。同时发现NFI不等同于可见损失尖峰：在更实际的任务中，部分吸收可能不产生可见尖峰，但仍会破坏零和约束并驱动参数范数快速增长。

Conclusion: 重新将Slingshot解释为有限精度训练下的数值动力学现象，为晚期训练中异常参数增长和logit发散提供了可检验的解释。

Abstract: Deep neural networks exhibit periodic loss spikes during unregularized long-term training, a phenomenon known as the "Slingshot Mechanism." Existing work usually attributes this to intrinsic optimization dynamics, but its triggering mechanism remains unclear. This paper proves that this phenomenon is a result of floating-point arithmetic precision limits. As training enters a high-confidence stage, the difference between the correct-class logit and the other logits may exceed the absorption-error threshold. Then during backpropagation, the gradient of the correct class is rounded exactly to zero, while the gradients of the incorrect classes remain nonzero. This breaks the zero-sum constraint of gradients across classes and introduces a systematic drift in the parameter update of the classifier layer. We prove that this drift forms a positive feedback loop with the feature, causing the global classifier mean and the global feature mean to grow exponentially. We call this mechanism Numerical Feature Inflation (NFI). This mechanism explains the rapid norm growth before a Slingshot spike, the subsequent reappearance of gradients, and the resulting loss spike. We further show that NFI is not equivalent to an observed loss spike: in more practical tasks, partial absorption may not produce visible spikes, but it can still break the zero-sum constraint and drive rapid growth of parameter norms. Our results reinterpret Slingshot as a numerical dynamic of finite-precision training, and provide a testable explanation for abnormal parameter growth and logit divergence in late-stage training.

</details>


### [445] [CUDABeaver: Benchmarking LLM-Based Automated CUDA Debugging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.08455)
*Shiyang Li,Haoyang Chen,Mattia Fazzini,Caiwen Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CUDABEAVER是一个针对CUDA调试的基准测试，包含213个真实失败任务，评估LLM修复器能否真正修复代码而非退化为低性能程序。通过引入协议条件度量pass@k(M,C,A)，发现性能要求严格时，修复器成功率可下降高达40个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-based CUDA编程评估忽视了一个关键问题：模型可能通过"退化式修复"（简化代码、抛弃优化结构）通过正确性测试，生成更安全但更慢的程序。需要更严格评估LLM修复CUDA代码的真实能力。

Method: 构建CUDABEAVER基准测试，包含213个来自LLM生成过程中的真实失败CUDA工作空间。每个任务提供损坏代码、构建/测试命令、原始错误证据和可编辑文件。提出pass@k(M,C,A)协议条件度量，将修复器M、语料库C和协议A三个轴显式化，按失败类别、调试轨迹、停滞模式和性能保持度报告结果。

Result: 在213个任务和7个前沿LLM上的实验表明：协议感知评估能更真实反映CUDA调试能力。当性能损失容忍度高时，修复器表现较强；但严格的性能要求可显著降低测量成功率，分数变化高达40个百分点。

Conclusion: 当前对LLM CUDA编程能力的评估被高估了，因其未考虑退化式修复问题。CUDABEAVER结合协议条件度量提供了更严格的评估框架，揭示了高性能要求下LLM修复能力的真实瓶颈。

Abstract: Debugging CUDA programs has long been challenging because failures often arise from subtle interactions among hardware behavior, compiler decisions, memory hierarchy, and asynchronous execution. More importantly, with the rapid expansion of GPU usage across scientific computing, machine learning, graphics, and systems workloads, CUDA debugging has become more challenging than ever. Current evaluations of LLM-based CUDA programming largely miss this setting: a model can pass correctness tests with repair by degeneration, simplifying the CUDA code into a safer but slower program that abandons the original optimization structure. We introduce CUDABEAVER, a benchmark for CUDA debugging from real failing workspaces produced during LLM-based CUDA generation. Each task provides the broken candidate, native build/test commands, raw error evidence, and a single editable file. CUDABEAVER evaluates whether a fixer truly repairs the failing CUDA code or merely finds a slower test-passing replacement, reporting results by failure category, debugging trajectory, stagnation mode, and performance preservation. We further propose pass@k(M,C,A), a protocol-conditional CUDA debugging metric by making the fixer M, corpus C, and protocol axes Aexplicit. Using this metric across 213 tasks and seven frontier LLMs, we show that protocol-aware evaluation gives a more faithful view of CUDA debugging ability: when performance-loss tolerance is high, fixers appear much stronger, but even a minor stricter performance requirement can sharply reduce measured success, shifting scores by up to 40 percentage points.

</details>


### [446] [Test-Time Compute for Dense Retrieval: Agentic Program Generation with Frozen Embedding Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11374)
*Han Xiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，额外的测试时计算（test-time compute）不仅能提升大型推理模型，也能显著改善小型嵌入模型。通过一个无参数的代理程序搜索循环，在冻结编码器上探索144个候选程序，发现了12个帕累托最优程序，其成本比率从1.2到14.7不等。这些程序独立重新发现了Rocchio伪相关反馈、ColBERT风格的句子级MaxSim、倒数秩融合（RRF）和Fisher线性判别等方法。所有前沿程序在所有14个MMTEB检索任务上均优于冻结基线的nDCG@10，且无需修改即可迁移到未见过的编码器家族和19个保留检索任务上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"测试时计算仅对大型推理模型有效"的普遍认知，探索在冻结的小型嵌入模型上通过额外推理计算提升检索性能的可能性，且无需重新训练或引入外部模型。

Method: 采用代理程序搜索循环（agentic program-search loop），在冻结编码器API上探索144个候选程序，通过帕累托优化筛选出12个最优程序。这些程序仅依赖无参数的算法组件（如Rocchio反馈、MaxSim、RRF、Fisher判别）进行推理时的计算增强。

Result: 在14个MMTEB检索任务上，所有前沿程序均提升nDCG@10；跨11个未见过的编码器家族和19个保留任务，68%的模型-任务对至少有一个前沿程序优于余弦基线；成本比率从1.2到14.7不等，提供灵活的性能-成本权衡。

Conclusion: 测试时计算是提升小型嵌入模型检索性能的有效且通用的策略，无需重新训练即可跨编码器家族和任务迁移，为低资源场景下的检索增强提供了实用方案。

Abstract: Test-time compute is widely believed to benefit only large reasoning models. We show it also helps small embedding models. Since modern embedding models are distilled from LLM backbones, a frozen encoder should benefit from extra inference compute without retraining. An agentic program-search loop explores 144 candidate programs over a frozen encoder API and produces twelve Pareto-optimal programs spanning cost ratios from $c=1.2$ to $14.7$ over the single-pass baseline. The search independently rediscovers Rocchio pseudo-relevance feedback, ColBERT-style MaxSim at sentence granularity, reciprocal rank fusion, and the Fisher linear discriminant, all without trainable parameters or external models. Every frontier program improves nDCG@10 over the frozen baseline across all 14 MMTEB retrieval tasks spanning legal, financial, long-document, and general domains. The programs transfer without modification to unseen encoder families and nineteen held-out retrieval tasks, with 68% of model-task pairs admitting at least one frontier program that improves over the cosine baseline.

</details>


### [447] [MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13779)
*Mind Lab,:,Song Cao,Vic Cao,Andrew Chen,Kaijie Chen,Cleon Cheng,Steven Chiang,Kaixuan Fan,Hera Feng,Huan Feng,Arthur Fu,Jun Gao,Hongquan Gu,Aaron Guan,Nolan Ho,Mutian Hong,Hailee Hou,Peixuan Hua,Charles Huang,Miles Jiang,Nora Jiang,Yuyi Jiang,Qiuyu Jin,Fancy Kong,Andrew Lei,Kyrie Lei,Alexy Li,Lucian Li,Ray Li,Theo Li,Zhihui Li,Jiayi Lin,Kairus Liu,Kieran Liu,Logan Liu,Xiang Liu,Irvine Lu,Maeve Luo,Runze Lv,Pony Ma,Verity Niu,Anson Qiu,Vincent Wang,Rio Yang,Maxwell Yao,Carrie Ye,Regis Ye,Wenlin Ye,Josh Ying,Danney Zeng,Yuhan Zhan,Anya Zhang,Di Zhang,Ruijia Zhang,Sueky Zhang,Ya Zhang,Wei Zhao,Ada Zhou,Changhai Zhou,Yuhua Zhou,Xinyue Zhu,Murphy Zhuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MinT是一个针对LoRA后训练和在线服务的托管基础设施系统，支持在共享基础模型上管理和服务百万级LoRA策略目录，通过Scale Up、Scale Down、Scale Out三个维度优化，实现了超过1T参数规模的训练与服务，以及18.3x的步骤缩短和8.5-8.7x的引擎加载提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在大量训练策略基于少量昂贵基础模型部署的场景下，传统方法需要为每个策略物化为完整检查点，资源开销巨大。需要一种基础设施来高效管理LoRA适配器的全生命周期（训练、导出、评估、服务、回滚），避免重复加载基础模型。

Method: MinT通过三个维度实现扩展：Scale Up将LoRA RL扩展到前沿规模的稠密和MoE架构（包括MLA和DSA注意力路径），验证超过1T总参数；Scale Down仅移动导出的LoRA适配器（rank-1下可小于基础模型1%），实现18.3x（4B稠密）和2.85x（30B MoE）的步骤缩短，并通过多策略GRPO并发缩短1.77x和1.45x壁钟时间；Scale Out分离持久化策略寻址与CPU/GPU工作集，支持10^6规模可寻址目录和千级适配器活动波，通过打包MoE LoRA张量提升8.5-8.7x引擎加载。

Result: 在4B稠密模型上实现18.3x步骤缩短，30B MoE模型上2.85x；多策略GRPO并发减少壁钟时间1.77x和1.45x且不提高峰值内存；单引擎扫描通过100K策略，打包MoE LoRA张量提升引擎加载8.5-8.7x；系统在超过1T总参数上得到验证。

Conclusion: MinT成功管理了百万级LoRA策略目录，同时能够在共享的1T级基础模型上训练和服务选定的适配器版本，为大规模LoRA后训练和服务提供了高效的基础设施方案。

Abstract: We present MindLab Toolkit (MinT), a managed infrastructure system for Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) post-training and online serving. MinT targets a setting where many trained policies are produced over a small number of expensive base-model deployments. Instead of materializing each policy as a merged full checkpoint, MinT keeps the base model resident and moves exported LoRA adapter revisions through rollout, update, export, evaluation, serving, and rollback, hiding distributed training, serving, scheduling, and data movement behind a service interface. MinT scales this path along three axes. Scale Up extends LoRA RL to frontier-scale dense and MoE architectures, including MLA and DSA attention paths, with training and serving validated beyond 1T total parameters. Scale Down moves only the exported LoRA adapter, which can be under 1% of base-model size in rank-1 settings; adapter-only handoff reduces the measured step by 18.3x on a 4B dense model and 2.85x on a 30B MoE, while concurrent multi-policy GRPO shortens wall time by 1.77x and 1.45x without raising peak memory. Scale Out separates durable policy addressability from CPU/GPU working sets: a tensor-parallel deployment supports 10^6-scale addressable catalogs (measured single-engine sweeps through 100K) and thousand-adapter active waves at cluster scale, with cold loading treated as scheduled service work and packed MoE LoRA tensors improving live engine loading by 8.5-8.7x. MinT thus manages million-scale LoRA policy catalogs while training and serving selected adapter revisions over shared 1T-class base models.

</details>


### [448] [Identifiable Token Correspondence for World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16457)
*Youngin Kim,Ray Sun,Inho Kim,Bumsoo Park,Hyun Oh Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出可识别令牌对应关系（ITC），一种用于基于令牌的Transformer世界模型的解码步骤，通过将下一帧预测建模为结构化分配问题（包含潜在令牌对应变量），解决了长期 rollout 中的时间不一致性问题（对象重复、消失、变形）。ITC 无需改变架构和训练过程，在4个基准测试上达到SOTA，Craftax-classic上奖励达72.5%和35.6%，显著超越先前最优的67.4%和27.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于令牌的Transformer世界模型在视觉强化学习中表现出色，但在长程 rollout 中常出现时间不一致问题（对象重复、消失、变形），原因是现有方法将下一帧预测纯粹视为令牌生成问题，未考虑令牌在时间上的持续性。

Method: 提出 Identifiable Token Correspondence (ITC)，一种解码步骤。将下一帧预测形式化为结构化分配问题，引入潜在令牌对应变量：每个下一帧令牌要么复制自上一帧，要么生成新令牌。ITC 不改变 Transformer 架构和训练流程，可直接叠加在现有骨干模型上。

Result: 在4个具有挑战性的基准测试上达到SOTA。在Craftax-classic基准上，提出的方法实现了72.5%的回报率和35.6%的得分，显著超越先前最优的67.4%和27.9%。

Conclusion: ITC 通过引入令牌对应机制有效解决了世界模型的时间不一致性问题，是一种轻量级、可插拔的改进方案，显著提升了长程 rollout 的预测质量。

Abstract: Token-based transformer world models have shown strong performance in visual reinforcement learning, but often suffer from temporal inconsistency in long-horizon rollouts, including object duplication, disappearance, and transmutation. A key reason is that most existing approaches treat next-frame prediction purely as a token generation problem, without considering the persistence of tokens across time. We introduce Identifiable Token Correspondence (ITC), a decoding step for token-based transformer world models that formulates next-frame prediction as a structured assignment problem with latent token correspondence variables: each next-frame token is explained either by copying a token from the previous frame or by generating a new one. ITC leaves the transformer architecture and training procedure unchanged and can be added on top of existing backbones. Our experiments show state-of-the-art performance on 4 challenging benchmarks. The proposed method achieves a return of 72.5% and a score of 35.6% on the Craftax-classic benchmark, significantly surpassing the previous best of 67.4% and 27.9%. We release our source code on https://github.com/snu-mllab/Identifiable-Token-Correspondence.

</details>


### [449] [AMARIS: A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18592)
*Peilin Wu,Xinlu Zhang,Kun Wan,Wentian Zhao,Gang Wu,Xinya Du,Zhiyu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AMARIS是一种基于记忆增强的评估标准改进系统，通过持久化存储训练过程中的纵向证据来指导强化学习中评估标准的更新，在多个基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自适应评估标准方法仅基于当前批次或实例级别的局部证据更新标准，忽略了训练过程中产生的诊断信息，难以追踪重复失败、评估先前的标准修改效果或在旧标准饱和后提升标准。

Method: AMARIS将rollout分析、步骤级摘要和标准更新记录存储在持久化评估记忆中，检索近期和语义相关的历史信息来修订评估标准，并异步运行在正常RL循环旁以减少阻塞延迟。

Result: 在科学、医学、指令跟随和创意写作任务上，AMARIS在全局和实例级评估标准设置下均优于静态、局部适应和消融记忆的基线方法，在GPQA-Diamond上提升+2.8分，在IFBench上提升+2.2分。

Conclusion: 记忆机制减少了评估标准的振荡性修改，支持从早期失败修正到后期课程进阶的过渡，异步设计降低了同步更新带来的阻塞延迟。

Abstract: Rubric-based reward shaping provides interpretable and editable reward signals for fine-tuning LLMs via reinforcement learning (RL), but existing adaptive rubric methods typically update criteria from local evidence such as the current batch or instance-level comparisons. This local view discards diagnostic information produced during training, making it difficult to track recurring failures, evaluate previous rubric edits, or raise standards once earlier criteria become saturated. We introduce AMARIS, A Memory-Augmented Rubric Improvement System that grounds rubric updates in longitudinal training evidence. AMARIS stores rollout analyses, step-level summaries, and rubric update records in a persistent evaluation memory, then retrieves recent and semantically relevant history to revise rubrics. We evaluate AMARIS across science, medicine, instruction following, and creative writing under both global and instance-specific rubric settings. AMARIS improves over static, local-adaptive, and memory-ablated baselines, such as +2.8 points on GPQA-Diamond and +2.2 points on IFBench over the strongest baselines, while analysis shows that memory reduces oscillatory rubric edits and supports a progression from early failure correction to later curriculum advancement. AMARIS runs asynchronously alongside the normal RL loop, reducing blocking latency relative to synchronous rubric updates.

</details>


### [450] [SPHERICAL KV: Angle-Domain Attention and Rate-Distortion Retention for Efficient Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18856)
*Anay Chauhan,Gurucharan Marthi Krishna Kumar,Arion Das,Amit Dhanda,Vinija Jain,Aman Chadha,Amitava Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Spherical KV 提出了一种基于球形参数化和率失真优化的长上下文推理方法，通过角度域注意力（ADA）和率失真保留（RDR）两个组件，在不重建稠密键向量的情况下直接计算注意力分数，并联合优化令牌/头的保留决策与精度层级，从而在降低KV缓存内存占用的同时保持解码效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存随上下文长度线性增长，解码受限于HBM带宽而非计算，现有方法（驱逐、窗口、量化、卸载）虽减少了内存占用，但压缩后的状态仍需在解码时重建为稠密向量，未能充分解决关键路径上的HBM带宽瓶颈。

Method: 提出Spherical KV方法，包含两个组件：(i) 角度域注意力（ADA），将键存储为球形参数化（标量半径+紧凑角度编码），直接从中计算注意力logits，无需重建稠密键；(ii) 率失真保留（RDR），在固定预算下联合选择每个令牌和注意力头的保留/丢弃决策及精度层级，生成层级同质化的页面，支持轻量元数据和合并读取。

Result: ADA保留了分页、块局部、融合友好的解码路径，直接减少现实服务场景中的HBM流量；RDR通过率失真优化在固定预算下实现KV内存压缩，两者结合在降低KV驻留的同时保持解码效率。

Conclusion: Spherical KV 提供了一种面向部署的长上下文推理机制，通过将KV分配建模为基于注意力几何的率失真问题，有效缓解了HBM带宽瓶颈，为未来长上下文推理系统的优化提供了新方向。

Abstract: Long-context inference is increasingly constrained by the KV cache: resident memory grows with context length, and decoding becomes limited by repeated High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) streaming rather than arithmetic. Existing methods such as eviction, windowing, quantization, and offloading reduce footprint, but often leave the critical-path bottleneck only partially addressed, especially when compressed states must still be reconstructed into dense vectors during decoding.
  We present Spherical KV, a long-context inference method that treats KV allocation as a rate-distortion problem grounded in attention geometry for efficient decoding. The method is built on two ideas: (i) represent directional information cheaply in the decode hot loop, and (ii) allocate retention and precision according to estimated future utility. Its first component, Angle-Domain Attention (ADA), stores keys in a spherical parameterization consisting of a scalar radius and compact angle codes, and computes attention logits directly from these codes without reconstructing dense keys. This preserves a paged, block-local, fusion-friendly decode path and directly targets HBM traffic in realistic serving settings. Its second component, Rate-Distortion Retention (RDR), jointly chooses keep/drop decisions and precision tiers per token and head under a fixed budget, producing tier-homogeneous pages with lightweight metadata and coalesced reads. Together, ADA and RDR provide a deployment-oriented mechanism for reducing KV residency while preserving decode efficiency.

</details>


### [451] [PDEInvBench: A Comprehensive Dataset and Design Space Exploration of Neural Networks for PDE Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25353)
*Divyam Goel,Nithin Chalapathi,Sanjeev Raja,Aditi S. Krishnapriyan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了PDEInvBench，一个专门用于偏微分方程反问题（从观测解场估计物理参数）的综合性基准数据集，并系统探索了神经网络在该问题上的设计空间，包括优化过程、问题表示和规模缩放三个关键维度，实验揭示了若干实用见解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法在PDE上的基准主要集中在正问题（从参数到解场），缺乏针对反问题（从解场到参数）的全面研究和基准数据集。

Method: 构建了包含时变和时不变PDE数值模拟的综合数据集PDEInvBench，涵盖多种物理行为；从三个维度系统探索神经网络设计空间：1) 优化过程（监督、自监督、测试时训练），2) 问题表示（不同归纳偏置的架构和条件策略），3) 模型与数据规模的缩放。

Result: 1) 两阶段训练（先监督预训练，再基于PDE残差测试时微调）效果最佳；2) 将PDE导数作为输入特征能持续提升精度；3) 增加训练数据中初始条件的多样性比扩大PDE参数范围带来更大的性能提升。

Conclusion: PDEInvBench填补了PDE反问题缺乏综合基准的空白，提供的系统性实验结论可为后续神经网络方法设计提供指导。

Abstract: Inverse problems in partial differential equations (PDEs) involve estimating the physical parameters of a system from observed spatiotemporal solution fields. Neural networks are well-suited for PDE parameter estimation due to their capability to model function-to-function space transformations. While existing benchmarks of machine learning methods for PDEs primarily focus on the forward problem, there are no similar comprehensive studies and benchmark datasets on PDE inverse problems, i.e., mapping solution fields to underlying physical parameters. We fill this gap by introducing PDEInvBench, a comprehensive benchmark dataset consisting of numerical simulations for both time-dependent and time-independent PDEs across a wide range of physical behaviors and parameters. Our dataset includes evaluation splits that assess performance in both in-distribution and various out-of-distribution settings. Using our benchmark dataset, we comprehensively explore the design space of neural networks for PDE inverse problems along three key dimensions: (1) optimization procedures, analyzing the role of supervised, self-supervised, and test-time training objectives on performance, (2) problem representations, where we study the value of architectural choices with different inductive biases and various conditioning strategies, and (3) scaling, which we perform with respect to both model and data size. Our experiments reveal several practical insights: 1) neural networks perform best with a two-stage training procedure: initial supervision with PDE parameters followed by test-time fine-tuning using the PDE residual, 2) incorporating PDE derivatives as input features consistently improves accuracy, and 3) increasing the diversity of initial conditions in the training data yields greater performance gains than expanding the range of PDE parameters. We make our dataset and codebase publicly available.

</details>


### [452] [FLUIDSPLAT: Reconstructing Physical Fields from Sparse Sensors via Gaussian Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18866)
*Huaxi Huang,Meng Li,Zhengqing Gao,Xi Zhou,Xiaoshui Huang,Xiao Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLUIDSPLAT 是一种受3D高斯泼溅启发、用于稀疏传感器重构连续流场的方法。它预测K个各向异性高斯基元形成可解释的中间表示，理论证明了逼近率与观测数量间的方差瓶颈，并引入状态条件残差解码器来突破该瓶颈。在2D/3D四个基准上相比强基线实现11-28%误差降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于神经网络的流场重构方法将传感器读数编码为隐式潜码，空间可解释性差，且缺乏表示容量随观测数量扩展的形式化理论指导。

Method: 受3D高斯泼溅启发，FLUIDSPLAT预测K个各向异性高斯基元形成partition-of-unity空间显式中间表示；理论分析证明了高斯基元估计器的逼近率；为平衡偏差与方差，引入状态条件残差解码器。

Result: 在cylinder flow、AirfRANS、FlowBench LDC-3D、PhySense-Car 3D四个基准上，相比多个强基线实现11-28%的误差降低。

Conclusion: FLUIDSPLAT通过可解释的高斯基元表示和理论指导的残差解码器设计，在稀疏传感器流场重构任务上取得了显著的性能提升，揭示了稀疏感知下表示容量的方差瓶颈。

Abstract: Reconstructing continuous flow fields from sparse surface-mounted sensors is central to aerodynamic design, flow control, and digital-twin instrumentation. Existing neural methods for this task typically encode sensor readings into implicit latent codes with little spatial interpretability and limited formal guidance on how representational capacity should scale with observation count. Inspired by 3D Gaussian Splatting, we introduce FLUIDSPLAT, a sensor-conditioned model that predicts K anisotropic Gaussian primitives forming a partition-of-unity scaffold, a spatially explicit and interpretable intermediate representation of the flow. For an idealized Gaussian primitive estimator, we prove an $O(K^{-s/d})$ approximation rate for fields with Sobolev smoothness $s$; incorporating $N$ noisy observations yields a squared-risk decomposition with bias $O(K^{-2s/d})$ and variance $O(σ^{2}K/N)$.Balancing the two yields $K^{*}\!\sim\!(N/σ^{2})^{d/(2s+d)}$: primitive count cannot grow freely under sparse sensing, revealing a variance bottleneck that motivates complementing the scaffold with a state-conditioned residual decoder. Across four benchmarks spanning 2D and 3D, FLUIDSPLAT achieves 11-28% error reduction over several strong baselines on cylinder flow, AirfRANS, FlowBench LDC-3D, and PhySense-Car 3D benchmarks.

</details>


### [453] [Your Neighbors Know: Leveraging Local Neighborhoods for Backdoor Detection in Decentralized Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.19969)
*Sayan Biswas,Antoine Boutet,Davide Frey,Romaric Gaudel,Rachid Guerraoui,Maxime Jacovella,Anne-Marie Kermarrec,Dimitri Lerévérend,François Taïani,Martijn de Vos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Argus是一个去中心化学习环境中的后门攻击检测框架，通过节点间协作共享触发器并使用结构相似性度量区分真实后门与数据异构性导致的误报，首次提供了DL特定后门检测机制的理论收敛保证，在三个标准数据集上攻击成功率最高降低90个百分点，模型效用与全知神谕相差5个百分点以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化学习（DL）因其协作性质易于受到后门攻击，而现有防御方法往往忽视了去中心化学习的约束条件，后门攻击在DL中尚未得到充分研究。

Method: Argus框架让诚实节点局部分析接收到的模型更新以识别潜在后门触发器，节点间通过邻居共享触发器，使用结构相似性度量分离真实后门与数据异构性导致的误报；误报在不同参与者间表现不一致而真实后门呈现一致模式；未通过协作测试的模型更新被拒绝，持续发送恶意更新的发送者最终被驱逐。

Result: 在三个标准数据集上对比三种最先进基线，Argus攻击成功率最高降低90个百分点，模型效用与全知神谕相差5个百分点以内，且数据异构性越强Argus相对基线的效果越优。

Conclusion: Argus是首个为DL特定后门检测机制提供理论收敛保证的框架，在高概率过滤可疑模型更新的情况下仍能保持与标准DL相当的收敛速率。

Abstract: Decentralized learning (DL) is an emerging machine learning paradigm where nodes collaboratively train models without a central server. However, the collaborative nature of DL makes it vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where a model is taught to behave normally on standard inputs while executing hidden, malicious actions when encountering data with specific triggers. Backdoor attacks in DL remain understudied and existing defenses often overlook DL constraints. We introduce Argus, a novel backdoor detection framework native to DL that requires neither a central coordinator nor prior knowledge of the trigger. In Argus, honest nodes locally analyze received model updates to identify potential backdoor triggers. Nodes then collectively share their triggers with their neighbors and use a structural similarity metric to separate true backdoors from false alarms induced by data heterogeneity. A key insight is that false positive triggers exhibit inconsistencies across participants while true positive ones show consistent patterns. Model updates that fail this collaborative test are rejected, and persistently malicious senders are eventually evicted. We provide the first theoretical convergence guarantees for a DL-specific backdoor detection mechanism, showing that filtering out suspicious model updates with high probability preserves a convergence rate comparable to standard DL. We implement and evaluate Argus on three standard datasets and against three state-of-the-art baselines. Across settings, Argus reduces attack success rates by up to 90 points compared to no defense, while preserving model utility within 5 percentage points of an omniscient oracle. Furthermore, the effectiveness of Argus compared to baselines improves as data heterogeneity increases.

</details>


### [454] [Weasel: Out-of-Domain Generalization for Web Agents via Importance-Diversity Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20291)
*Fatemeh Pesaran Zadeh,Seyeon Choi,Xing Han Lù,Siva Reddy,Gunhee Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Weasel方法，通过轨迹选择（平衡重要性与多样性）、目标中心AXTree剪枝和风格一致推理链替换，实现Web智能体的高效离线训练，在多个基准上取得9.7-12.5倍训练加速并提升跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于微调的Web智能体存在两个问题：(1) 在特定轨迹和领域上微调后难以泛化到域外场景；(2) 离线训练因噪声轨迹、冗余数据及长AXTree状态而导致计算效率低下。

Method: (1) 轨迹选择：在固定预算下通过贪心算法优化一个同时考虑单步重要性和状态/网站/交互模式多样性的目标函数来选取子集；(2) 目标中心AXTree剪枝：仅保留围绕ground-truth动作目标的内容；(3) 风格匹配推理链替换：用模型自身生成的风格一致推理链替代专家轨迹，以适应推理型模型。

Result: 在AgentTrek和NNetNav训练集上，用Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma3-4B和Qwen3-8B在WebArena、WorkArena、MiniWob上评估，Weasel在提升域外性能的同时实现约9.7-12.5倍训练加速。

Conclusion: Weasel通过智能轨迹选择、结构剪枝和风格对齐，有效兼顾了Web智能体离线训练的效率与跨域泛化能力。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled web agents that follow natural language goals through multi-step browser interactions. However, agents fine-tuned on specific trajectories and domain often struggle to generalize out of domain, and offline training can be compute-inefficient due to noisy, redundant trajectories and long accessibility-tree (AXTree) states. To address both issues, we propose Weasel, a trajectory selection method for offline training of web agents. Weasel selects a fixed-budget subset of trajectory steps by optimizing an objective that balances unary importance with pairwise diversity over states, websites, and interaction patterns, solving efficiently with a greedy algorithm. We further improve efficiency with target-centered AXTree pruning that keeps only content around the ground-truth action target, and we mitigate style mismatch for reasoning-native models by replacing expert traces with model-generated, style-consistent rationales. Across AgentTrek and NNetNav training datasets, evaluations in WebArena, WorkArena, and MiniWob, and experiments with Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma3-4B, and Qwen3-8B, Weasel improves out-of-domain performance while reducing training cost, producing roughly 9.7-12.5$\times$ training speedups over standard fine-tuning. We make the code available at https://github.com/fatemehpesaran310/weasel.

</details>


### [455] [Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20612)
*Ziye Chen,Hongbin Lin,Xinyue Xu,Jie Li,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出马特罗什卡概念瓶颈模型（MCBM），通过嵌套层次化概念组织，在单一模型中实现自适应概念粒度推理，将专家干预成本从线性降至对数级别 O(log K)，同时保证性能单调提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统概念瓶颈模型在实际部署中面临测试时干预成本高昂的问题，要么使用单一静态概念集导致专家需穷举标注，要么训练多个模型适配不同概念预算造成计算和维护负担。

Method: 受马特罗什卡表示学习启发，基于最大相关性和最小冗余度原则将概念组织成嵌套层次结构，单一模型支持多粒度推理而无需重新训练。

Result: 理论上将预期干预成本从线性降至对数级 O(log K)并保证性能单调提升；实验上匹配独立训练模型的性能，同时实现动态高效的专家交互。

Conclusion: MCBM通过统一架构有效解决了CBM中概念粒度与干预成本之间的权衡问题，为可解释深度学习的实际部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) have emerged as a prominent paradigm for interpretable deep learning, learning by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts. However, their practical deployment is hindered by the high cost of test-time intervention, as correcting model errors typically requires human experts to manually inspect and verify a large set of predicted concepts. Existing approaches suffer from a fundamental structural limitation: they either adopt a single static concept set, forcing experts to exhaustively annotate concepts and incurring prohibitive intervention costs, or train multiple models tailored to different concept budgets, resulting in substantial computational and maintenance overhead. To address this challenge, we propose the Matryoshka Concept Bottleneck Model (MCBM), a unified architecture that enables adaptive concept utilization within a single model. Inspired by Matryoshka Representation Learning, MCBM organizes concepts into a nested hierarchy based on maximum relevance and minimum redundancy, allowing inference at multiple levels of conceptual granularity without retraining. Theoretically, we show that MCBM reduces the expected intervention costs from linear to logarithmic order, $O(\log K)$, while guaranteeing monotonic performance improvement. Empirically, extensive experiments demonstrate that MCBM matches the performance of independently trained models while enabling dynamic and efficient expert interaction.

</details>


### [456] [A Sharper Picture of Generalization in Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.20988)
*Paul Lintilhac,Sair Shaikh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从傅里叶谱视角研究Transformer在布尔域上的泛化行为，利用PAC-Bayes理论证明了傅里叶谱稀疏且集中在低阶分量的目标函数存在锐度较低的平坦极小值，从而得到非平凡的泛化边界。研究揭示了思维链(Chain-of-Thought)如何通过降低目标函数谱的阶数来改善泛化，并通过可解释性分析验证了理论构造的合理性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作（Edelman et al., 2022; Trauger & Tosh, 2024）主要基于Rademacher复杂度推导Transformer的泛化界，但该方法可能不够紧致。作者希望探索能否通过PAC-Bayes理论得到更好的泛化边界，并解释思维链为何能提升Transformer在布尔域上的泛化能力。

Method: 1) 证明稀疏度不超过上下文长度的任意布尔函数都存在平坦极小值（低锐度）；2) 利用PAC-Bayes边界对理想化的低锐度学习器进行推导，得到非平凡泛化界；3) 通过性质测试（property testing）高效估计边界中的复杂度参数；4) 进行实验评估和机械可解释性研究验证理论构造的合理性。

Result: 发现稀疏且集中在低阶分量的傅里叶谱能够支持低锐度构造，从而获得好的泛化性质；思维链通过将高阶目标函数分解为低阶步骤改善了泛化；复杂度参数可通过性质测试高效估计。

Conclusion: 从傅里叶谱和PAC-Bayes理论角度为Transformer的泛化行为提供了新的理论理解，为思维链的有效性提供了形式化解释，并通过实验验证了理论构造在真实Transformer中的合理性。

Abstract: We study transformers' generalization behavior on boolean domains from the perspective of the Fourier spectra of their target functions. In contrast to prior work (Edelman et al., 2022; Trauger & Tosh, 2024), which derived generalization bounds from Rademacher complexity, we investigate the feasibility of obtaining generalization bounds via PAC-Bayes theory. We show that sparse spectra concentrated on low-degree components enable low-sharpness constructions with good generalization properties. Our idea is to show the existence of flat minima implementing any boolean function of sparsity no greater than the context length, and then apply a PAC-Bayes bound to an idealized low-sharpness learner, resulting in a non-vacuous generalization bound. We use this to give a formal account of why chain-of-thought improves generalization for high-degree target functions, and show that the complexity parameters in our bound can be efficiently estimated via property testing. We evaluate predictions empirically and conduct a mechanistic interpretability study to support the realism of our theoretical construction in real transformers.

</details>


### [457] [$\textit{BlockFormer}$ : Transformer-based inference from interaction maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.21617)
*Eloïse Touron,Pedro L. C. Rodrigues,Julyan Arbel,Nelle Varoquaux,Michael Arbel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer架构的数据驱动方法，利用共享结构和自定义模拟器生成合成数据进行训练，解决从交互图谱（如Hi-C）中推断参数（如着丝粒定位）的通用逆问题，在多种物种中准确恢复了着丝粒的基因组位置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从交互图谱（如Hi-C技术生成的染色质构象捕获数据）中推断参数可被视为通用逆问题，但存在实体数量和大小可变性的挑战。现有方法难以处理这种变异性，因此需要一种能利用图谱间共享结构（如局部模式的全局对齐）且能处理实际数据变异性的数据驱动方法。

Method: 采用Transformer架构处理实体数量和大小的变异性；设计自定义模拟器生成大量计算成本低廉的合成数据用于训练；将方法应用于着丝粒定位问题。

Result: 该方法在多种基因组大小不同的物种中准确恢复了着丝粒的基因组位置。

Conclusion: 所提出的数据驱动方法有效解决了从交互图谱进行参数推断的通用逆问题，尤其对着丝粒定位任务表现优异，具有跨物种的泛化能力。

Abstract: Inference from interaction maps, such as centromere identification from genome-wide chromosome conformation capture techniques -- notably Hi-C -- can be formulated as a generic inverse problem: infer a set of parameters given a map summarizing pairwise interactions between entities through blocks of variable numbers and sizes. In this work, we introduce a data-driven approach that leverages shared structure between these maps, such as global alignment between localized patterns, while handling the variability in number and size of entities arising in real-world data. Our approach relies on a transformer architecture capable of handling such variability and a custom simulator to generate abundant, yet computationally cheap synthetic data for training. Applied to the problem of centromere localization, the method accurately recovers their genomic positions across a wide range of species of various genome sizes.

</details>


### [458] [One LR Doesn't Fit All: Heavy-Tail Guided Layerwise Learning Rates for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22297)
*Di He,Songjun Tu,Keyu Wang,Lu Yin,Shiwei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Layerwise Learning Rate (LLR)，一种基于Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR)理论的自适应逐层学习率方案，为Transformer不同层分配不同学习率——弱重尾层用大学习率加速训练，强重尾层用小学习率促进收敛。在LLaMA到GPT-nano、AdamW到Muon、60M到3B参数规模及高达100B训练token的实验上，LLR实现最高1.5倍训练加速，并将1B和3B模型的零样本准确率分别从47.09%提升至49.02%、从48.58%提升至50.61%，且调参开销极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前深度学习中所有层使用统一学习率的做法忽略了Transformer各层之间的结构异质性，限制了LLM的性能潜力，因此需要一种能根据各层特性自适应配置学习率的方法。

Method: 基于HT-SR理论，通过计算权重相关矩阵的经验谱密度(ESD)量化各层的重尾程度，弱重尾层分配较大学习率以加速训练，强重尾层分配较小学习率以促进平衡训练。

Result: 在多种架构、优化器和模型规模（60M~3B参数，100B token）上，LLR实现最高1.5倍训练加速；1B模型零样本准确率从47.09%提升至49.02%，3B模型从48.58%提升至50.61%。

Conclusion: LLR是一种高效、低调参开销的逐层学习率方案，能从统一学习率基线直接迁移最优设置，显著提升训练效率和模型泛化能力。

Abstract: Learning rate configuration is a fundamental aspect of modern deep learning. The prevailing practice of applying a uniform learning rate across all layers overlooks the structural heterogeneity of Transformers, potentially limiting their effectiveness as the backbone of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this paper, we introduce Layerwise Learning Rate (LLR), an adaptive scheme that assigns distinct learning rates to individual Transformer layers. Our method is grounded in Heavy-Tailed Self-Regularization (HT-SR) theory, which characterizes the empirical spectral density (ESD) of weight correlation matrices to quantify heavy-tailedness. Layers with weaker heavy-tailedness are assigned larger learning rates to accelerate training, while layers with stronger heavy-tailedness receive smaller learning rates. By tailoring learning rates in this manner, LLR promotes more balanced training across layers, leading to faster convergence and improved generalization. Extensive experiments across architectures ranging from LLaMA to GPT-nano, optimizers including AdamW and Muon, and model scales from 60M to 3B parameters with up to 100B training tokens demonstrate the effectiveness of LLR. LLR achieves up to 1.5x training speedup and consistently outperforms uniform-learning-rate baselines. In particular, it improves the average zero-shot accuracy of 1B models from 47.09% to 49.02%, and that of 3B models from 48.58% to 50.61%. A key advantage of LLR is its low tuning overhead: it can transfer nearly optimal learning-rate settings directly from the uniform baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/hed-ucas/Layer-wise-Learning-Rate.

</details>


### [459] [BioFormer: Rethinking Cross-Subject Generalization via Spectral Structural Alignment in Biomedical Time-Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22468)
*Guikang Du,Haoran Li,Xinyu Liu,Zhibo Zhang,Xiaoli Gong,Jin Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对生物医学时间序列中跨主体泛化问题，提出频谱漂移视角刻画主体特异性变异，并设计BioFormer模型，通过频带对齐模块（FBAM）和样本条件层归一化抑制变异，在六个数据集上F1分数提升6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法隐式抑制主体特异性变异，缺乏显式建模，本文从频谱漂移角度显式刻画该变异以提升跨主体泛化能力。

Method: 提出BioFormer，核心包括：1) 频带对齐模块(FBAM)，从频谱分布生成带级调制因子，自适应调整幅度和相位对齐频谱结构；2) 样本条件层归一化(SCLN)，从信号内在统计量推断归一化参数，不依赖主体身份。

Result: 在六个数据集上超越12个基线方法，F1分数绝对提升6%。

Conclusion: 显式建模频谱漂移可有效抑制主体特异性变异，BioFormer在跨主体生物医学时间序列任务上取得显著性能提升。

Abstract: Cross-subject generalization in biomedical time-series refers to training on data from some subjects and testing on unseen subjects.The key challenge is to suppress subject specific variability in BTS representations.Most existing methods implicitly suppress the variability through model building or subject adversarial learning, but rarely model it explicitly.We introduce spectral drift as a new perspective to characterize subject specific variability.Specifically, BTS signals under the same label often share consistent oscillatory structure, yet exhibit subject-dependent magnitude or phase shifts in specific frequency components, which we interpret as subject-specific variability. Building on this insight, we propose BioFormer.At its core is a Frequency-Band Alignment Module(FBAM) that generates band-wise modulation factors from the spectral distribution and adaptively adjusts amplitude and phase to align spectral structure, thereby mitigating variability.We further pair FBAM with Sample Conditional Layer Normalization, which infers normalization parameters from intrinsic signal statistics rather than subject identity, stabilizing cross-subject representations.Extensive experiments on six datasets demonstrate that BioFormer outperforms 12 baselines, yielding absolute F1-score improvements of 6%.

</details>


### [460] [Neural Flow Operators can Approximate any Operator: Abstract Frameworks and Universal Approximations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22557)
*Shuang Chen,Juncai He,Xue-Cheng Tai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个抽象的神经流框架，涵盖具有组合与分离结构的两种连续深度模型，适用于有限维函数和无限维算子逼近，证明了良定性和普适逼近性质（包括首个无穷维空间间流模型的普适逼近结果），并通过时间离散化统一了残差架构与普通架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为神经网络和神经算子提供一个统一的连续深度（流）框架，填补流模型在无穷维空间间普适逼近理论方面的空白。

Method: 提出具有组合结构和分离结构的两种神经流模型；通过时间离散化，组合结构恢复ResNet型架构，分离结构（基于分裂离散化）得到普通架构；覆盖全连接或卷积线性层的神经网络与神经算子。

Result: 证明了所提神经流的良定性和普适逼近性质，包括首个无穷维空间间的流模型普适逼近结果；还获得了卷积神经流模型的普适逼近结果。

Conclusion: 该框架以流模型为统一视角，连接了残差架构与普通架构，为神经网络和神经算子的设计提供了理论基础。

Abstract: We introduce an abstract neural flow framework for neural networks and neural operators. The framework contains two continuous-depth models, namely neural flows with composition and separation structures, and covers both finite-dimensional function approximation and infinite-dimensional operator approximation. We prove well-posedness and universal approximation properties for the corresponding neural flows, including, to the best of our knowledge, the first universal approximation result for flow-based models between infinite-dimensional spaces. We also obtain universal approximation results for convolutional neural flow models. Through suitable time discretizations, the composition structure recovers ResNet-type architectures, while the separation structure, via a splitting-based discretization, yields plain architectures. This gives a unified flow-based route to both residual and plain architectures for neural networks and neural operators with fully connected or convolutional linear layers.

</details>


### [461] [CogAdapt: Transferring Clinical ECG Foundation Models to Wearable Cognitive Load Assessment via Lead Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22774)
*Amir Mousavi,Erfan Nourbakhsh,Mohammad Sadegh Sirjani,Mimi Xie,Rocky Slavin,Leslie Neely,John Davis,John Quarles*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CogAdapt框架，通过LeadBridge适配器将3导联可穿戴信号转换为12导联表示，并结合ProFine渐进微调策略，将临床ECG基础模型迁移至可穿戴认知负荷评估，在跨被试验证中显著优于从头训练的基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时认知负荷评估对人机交互至关重要，但面临标注数据有限和跨被试泛化能力差的挑战。现有ECG基础模型虽在临床数据上预训练得到丰富表征，但由于传感器配置不匹配和任务差异，无法直接应用于可穿戴设备。

Method: 提出CogAdapt框架，包含两个核心组件：1) LeadBridge——可学习适配器，将3导联可穿戴信号转换为解剖学一致的12导联表示；2) ProFine——渐进微调策略，逐步解冻编码器层并防止灾难性遗忘。

Result: 在CLARE和CL-Drive两个公开数据集上进行留一被试交叉验证，CogAdapt的macro-F1分数分别达到0.626和0.768，显著优于从头训练的基线模型。

Conclusion: 结果表明，基础模型自适应方法有望实现基于可穿戴传感器的、与受试者无关的认知负荷评估。

Abstract: Real-time cognitive load assessment is essential for adaptive human-computer interaction but remains challenging due to limited labeled data and poor cross-subject generalization. Recent ECG foundation models pre-trained on millions of clinical recordings offer rich representations, but cannot be directly applied to wearable devices due to sensor configuration mismatch and task differences. In this paper, we propose CogAdapt, a framework that adapts clinical ECG foundation models to wearable cognitive load assessment. CogAdapt introduces LeadBridge, a learnable adapter that transforms 3-lead wearable signals into anatomically consistent 12-lead representations, and ProFine, a progressive fine-tuning strategy that gradually unfreezes encoder layers while preventing catastrophic forgetting. Evaluations on two public datasets (CLARE and CL-Drive) under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation show that CogAdapt substantially outperforms baselines trained from scratch, achieving macro-F1 scores of 0.626 and 0.768. These results demonstrate the promise of foundation model adaptation for subject-independent cognitive load assessment from wearable sensors.

</details>


### [462] [Iterative Refinement Neural Operators are Learned Fixed-Point Solvers: A Principled Approach to Spectral Bias Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24041)
*Xiaotian Liu,Shuyuan Shang,Xiaopeng Wang,Pu Ren,Yaoqing Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出迭代细化神经算子（IRNO），通过在预训练算子后添加可学习的细化模块并迭代应用，逐步修正高频误差，显著提升神经算子对高频细节的建模能力，在湍流等物理系统上实现高达56.05%的误差降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子采用单次前向推理，难以捕获高频细节（即频谱偏差问题），限制了其在复杂物理系统建模中的精度。

Method: IRNO在预训练算子基础上引入一个可学习的细化模块，通过固定点迭代进行连续残差修正，类似经典数值求解器的迭代细化策略；同时提出渐进式频谱损失函数，在训练过程中逐步增加对高频分量的惩罚。

Result: 在湍流等物理系统上误差降低高达56.05%；在Active Matter任务中，归一化误差在低频降至27.72-36.10%，中频降至5.07-6.68%，高频降至1.48-2.04%，且超出训练迭代次数后仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: IRNO通过迭代细化机制有效缓解了神经算子的频谱偏差，理论保证收敛性，实验证明其在多频段上的显著精度提升和泛化稳定性。

Abstract: Neural operators serve as fast, data-driven surrogates for scientific modeling but typically rely on a monolithic, single-pass inference procedure that struggles to resolve high-frequency details, a limitation known as spectral bias. We introduce the Iterative Refinement Neural Operator (IRNO), which augments pre-trained operators with a learned refinement module iteratively applied via fixed-point iteration. IRNO decomposes the prediction into a coarse initialization followed by successive residual corrections, paralleling classical numerical solvers. Under local assumptions, we establish contraction of the induced operator, ensuring convergence to a unique fixed point. To explicitly target high-frequency errors, we propose a progressive spectral loss that adaptively increases penalty on high-frequency components over refinement steps during training. Across physical systems, IRNO consistently lowers error, with up to 56.05% improvement on turbulent flow. On Active Matter, spectral analysis reveals that, relative to base operator, the normalized error ratios decrease to 27.72-36.10% in low-, 5.07-6.68% in mid-, and 1.48-2.04% in high-frequencies, remaining stable beyond the trained iteration count. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaotianliu-dartmouth/Iterative_Refinement_Neural_Operator

</details>


### [463] [Hidden-State Privacy Has an Empty Middle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24042)
*Alexander Okezue Bell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过对1536种高斯发布协方差的测试，发现没有一种能在单层隐藏状态隐私中同时实现中等效用和中等隐私。本文证明了Fisher球下界：所有满秩高斯发布在O(1) Fisher效用下都存在方向使得马氏信号随隐藏宽度线性增长，排除了高斯类中的均匀安全性。对角逆Fisher发布是唯一的最优对角机制，但处于隐私/效用边界而非中间地带。广义特征机制在自适应马氏攻击下崩溃，而完整轨迹序列逆变器在Σ_diag下恢复率为0%。从头训练的分离记忆Transformer在马氏增益上达到20-33，相比同预算GPT基线保持6-24倍优势。这些结果将隐藏状态发布从高斯类内的机制设计重新框定为架构或发布协同设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高斯发布机制在隐藏状态隐私保护中无法同时实现中等效用和中等隐私，存在"空中间"现象，需要理论解释和新的解决路径。

Method: 通过大规模经验测试（1536种协方差）和理论证明（Fisher球下界），分析对角逆Fisher机制的极小极大最优性，测试广义特征机制和完整轨迹序列逆变器，并设计分离记忆Transformer架构进行实验验证。

Result: 所有满秩高斯发布都存在安全漏洞；对角逆Fisher虽是最优对角机制但处于边界；广义特征机制在自适应攻击下从13倍Pareto改善降至100% top-1攻击成功率；序列逆变器在Σ_diag下恢复率为0%；分离记忆Transformer在马氏增益上达到20-33，相比GPT基线保持6-24倍优势。

Conclusion: 高斯机制设计类内无法实现隐藏状态的安全均匀发布，需要从机制设计转向架构与发布的协同设计。

Abstract: Of $1{,}536$ Gaussian release covariances we tested for single-layer hidden-state privacy, zero achieve both moderate utility and moderate privacy against an adaptive retrieval attacker. We prove a complementary Fisher-ball lower bound: every full-rank Gaussian release at $O(1)$ Fisher utility admits a direction whose Mahalanobis signal grows linearly in hidden width, ruling out uniform Gaussian safety in the class and matching the empirical empty middle. The diagonal inverse-Fisher release $Σ^\star_{\mathrm{diag}}(\mathcal{K}) = (2\mathcal{K}/d)\,\mathrm{diag}(1/F_{ii})$ is the unique minimax-optimal diagonal mechanism at first-order KL budget $\mathcal{K}$ and the only release with worst-attacker top-1 $\le 0.001$ at every point of a 32 model-layer grid, but it sits on a privacy/utility edge rather than filling the middle. A generalized-eigen mechanism reaching $13\times$ Pareto reduction under Euclidean retrieval collapses to $100\%$ top-1 under the adaptive Mahalanobis attacker, and a full-trajectory sequence inverter recovers $94\%$ of clean GPT-2 prefixes but $0\%$ under $Σ_{\mathrm{diag}}$. A split-memory transformer trained from scratch reaches $G_{\mathrm{Mah}} \in [20, 33]$ at 90M and maintains a $6$--$24\times$ advantage over same-budget GPT baselines from 30M to 1B at a fixed-token language-modeling loss penalty; pretrained models top out at 9.3. These results reframe hidden-state release from mechanism-design within the Gaussian class to architecture or release co-design.

</details>


### [464] [Not All Transitions Matter: Evidence from PPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24071)
*Ajhesh Basnet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现强化学习中on-policy采样因因果链导致梯度重复，提出在PPO训练时随机丢弃25%的transition即可打破冗余、稳定训练，无需改动算法核心，在五个环境中验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy强化学习中，相邻transition因因果链存在重叠信息，导致梯度信号高度重复、训练不稳定，而奖励曲线难以反映这一问题。作者试图通过简单方法消除冗余。

Method: 在rollout后、更新前，随机丢弃固定比例（最优25%）的transition，保留奖励信号完整性，其余PPO算法保持不变。

Result: 在CartPole-v1、Acrobot-v1、LunarLander-v2、HalfCheetah-v5和Hopper-v5五个环境中，该方法在奖励指标上与标准PPO持平，但在KL散度、策略熵和价值估计上展现出更一致的训练动态。

Conclusion: 随机丢弃特定比例transition是一种极简但有效的训练稳定化手段，能够在不修改核心算法、不增加组件的前提下，通过打破梯度重复结构来提升PPO训练的一致性和稳定性。

Abstract: Training a reinforcement learning agent on-policy means collecting fresh experience at every update, and that experience comes with a hidden problem. Each state in a rollout is the direct output of the previous one, causally chained together by the agent's own actions. Because of this, consecutive transitions are never truly independent. They carry overlapping information, and the gradient signal the network receives ends up far more repetitive than the batch size suggests. The same directions get reinforced over and over, the value network struggles to keep up as the policy shifts, and training becomes quietly unstable in ways that reward curves alone rarely reveal.
  This paper asks whether that redundancy can simply be removed. We show that randomly dropping a fixed fraction of transitions from the rollout, at the right stage so the reward signal stays intact, is enough to break the repetitive gradient structure and stabilize training. The change is minimal: one sampling step, no new components, no modification to the core algorithm, and it works with any PPO implementation. Across five environments of increasing difficulty, CartPole-v1, Acrobot-v1, LunarLander-v2, HalfCheetah-v5, and Hopper-v5, the method matches vanilla PPO on reward while producing more consistent training dynamics across KL divergence, policy entropy, and value estimates. Dropping 25% of transitions turns out to be the sweet spot: enough to disrupt the redundancy, not enough to thin the batch.

</details>


### [465] [Rethinking Weak Supervision in Anomaly Detection: A Comprehensive Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26068)
*Xu Yao,Siyuan Zhou,Zhenbo Wu,Chaochuan Hou,Shuang Liang,Shiping Wang,Hailiang Huang,Songqiao Han,Minqi Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WSADBench是首个统一评估弱监督异常检测中不完全、不精确和不准确三种监督场景的基准，通过70万+实验评估36种算法，揭示了各弱监督场景间的强相关性、专用WSAD算法仅在极端标签稀缺时占优、无标签数据效用有限、模型对标签噪声具有非对称敏感性等关键发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有弱监督异常检测的三个主要方向（不完全、不精确、不准确监督）彼此隔离，缺乏统一框架来评估它们是否面临独特挑战或共享基本机制。

Method: 构建了WSADBench基准，通过系统变化标签数量、粒度和质量，在4种模态上建立了标准化评估协议，评估了从专用WSAD方法到高级表格基础模型的36种算法，进行了超过70万次实验。

Result: (i)弱监督场景间存在强内在关联；(ii)专用WSAD算法仅在极端标签稀缺时表现优异，随监督增强或被OOD场景中迅速被基础模型和通用分类方法超越；(iii)无标签数据效用不一致，相比标签精炼增益有限；(iv)模型对不同类型的标签噪声具有非对称敏感性。

Conclusion: WSADBench为弱监督异常检测提供了统一评估框架，揭示了当前研究方向的局限性，并开源了代码和数据集以促进未来研究。

Abstract: Weakly supervised anomaly detection (WSAD) has developed in three primary directions: incomplete, inexact, and inaccurate supervision. However, these directions remain isolated, lacking a unified framework to assess whether they address unique challenges or share fundamental mechanics. This paper introduces WSADBench, the first benchmark that unifies evaluation across distinct weakly supervised scenarios, benchmarking diverse approaches from specialized WSAD methods to advanced tabular foundation models. WSADBench establishes standardized protocols to evaluate 36 algorithms across 4 modalities by systematically varying label quantity, granularity, and quality, revealing the performance boundaries of various methods. Based on over 700K experiments, WSADBench reveals four critical insights: (i) Strong intrinsic correlations exist between these weak supervision scenarios, challenging the isolation of current research directions. (ii) Specialized WSAD algorithms excel only in extreme label-scarcity regimes but are quickly dominated by tabular foundation models and general classification methods as supervision increases or in OOD scenarios. (iii) Unlabeled data shows inconsistent utility across settings, with marginal gains compared to label refinement. (iv) Models exhibit asymmetric sensitivity to different types of label noise. We release WSADBench as an open-source benchmark with code and datasets to facilitate future WSAD research: https://github.com/SUFE-AILAB/WSADBench.

</details>


### [466] [Global Convergence of Wasserstein Policy Gradient for Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26078)
*Zhaoyu Zhu,Rui Gao,Shuang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为Wasserstein策略梯度（WPG）方法建立了全局收敛性理论，通过利用熵正则化强化学习中的Bellman结构，证明了Bellman递归能够诱导出有利的Polyak-Lojasiewicz型几何，从而支持WPG的全局收敛，并获得了直到离散化偏差的几何收缩速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WPG方法在连续控制问题中表现出色，但其全局收敛性质尚不明确。标准Langevin分析无法直接应用，因为RL目标通过Bellman递归而非静态凸泛函依赖于策略，且Langevin漂移由需沿策略迭代控制的软Q函数决定。

Method: 作者利用熵正则化RL的Bellman结构：软Bellman残差相对于Gibbs策略具有逐状态的KL表示；Bellman压缩将残差与全局最优性间隙联系起来；Bellman预解恒等式将价值改进与相对Fisher信息连接。结合演化Gibbs族的均匀对数Sobolev不等式，推导出分布式的Polyak-Łojasiewicz条件，并通过控制正则性和均匀边界来约束离散化误差。

Result: 建立了WPG的全局收敛性，获得了直到离散化偏差的几何收缩速率。

Conclusion: 尽管熵正则化RL在通常的平坦意义上不是凸的，但Bellman递归诱导出有利的PL型几何，足以支持WPG的全局收敛。

Abstract: Wasserstein policy gradient (WPG) is a policy optimization method for reinforcement learning (RL) that exploits the optimal-transport geometry of action distributions. For the entropy-regularized RL objective, WPG evolves each state-conditional policy by transporting it along the action gradient of the soft Q-function together with a Langevin-type diffusion. Despite its appeal for continuous-control problems, its global convergence properties remain poorly understood. Standard Langevin analyses do not directly apply, because the RL objective depends on the policy through the Bellman recursion rather than through a static convex functional, and the Langevin drift is determined by the soft Q-function, whose regularity must be controlled along the policy iterates.
  In this paper, we develop a global convergence theory for WPG by exploiting the Bellman structure of entropy-regularized RL. We show that the role usually played by convexity can be replaced by a Bellman-based argument: the soft Bellman residual admits a statewise KL representation with respect to a Gibbs policy; Bellman contraction relates this residual to the global optimality gap; and a Bellman resolvent identity connects value improvement to relative Fisher information. Combined with a uniform log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) for the evolving Gibbs family, these ingredients yield a distributional Polyak--Łojasiewicz condition. We further establish the regularity and uniform bounds needed to control the discretization error, thereby obtaining geometric contraction up to a discretization bias. Conceptually, our analysis shows that although entropy-regularized RL is not convex in the usual flat sense, the Bellman recursion induces a favorable Polyak--Lojasiewicz-type (PL) geometry that supports global convergence of WPG.

</details>

### [467] [Random neural networks match observed dimensionality of neural population recordings and motivate stronger experimental tests](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26551)
*Zehui Zhao,Michael J Pasek,Ilya M Nemenman*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文检验了随机连接神经网络能否解释神经群体记录中的低维活动特性。通过将有限测量时间和行为上下文变异性纳入动力平均场理论模型，发现当考虑这些因素时，实验测得的维度与随机模型预测一致；但当前记录时长不足以用维度区分不同连接结构；此外，不同行为条件下神经流形的方向相似性比维度对网络结构更敏感。结果为设计实验推断群体活动背后的连接结构提供了定量指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管随机连接神经网络长期被用作研究神经群体集体动力学的理论工具，但缺乏与实验数据的定量比较。近年技术进展使得解析神经元群体范围的关联性成为可能，而随机神经网络等最小模型预测了其一般结构，但两者是否定量吻合尚未得到检验。

Method: 基于动力平均场理论（DMFT）的最新发展，构建最小结构随机神经网络模型，并引入两个实验相关特征：有限测量时间和行为上下文变异性，分析群体活动的维度及其与网络结构的关系。

Result: 1）纳入有限测量时间和行为变异性后，大规模记录中测得的维度与随机模型预测值一致；2）当前记录时长下，维度不足以区分不同连接结构；3）预测的维度随外部输入强度呈非单调变化；4）不同行为上下文下神经流形的方向相似性比维度对网络结构更敏感。

Conclusion: 随机神经网络模型在考虑实验约束后能够定量解释神经群体记录的维度特性，但维度本身区分连接结构的能力有限；方向相似性可作为更敏感的结构探针。研究为设计实验以推断群体活动背后的连接结构提供了定量指导。

Abstract: Randomly connected neural networks have long served as a theoretical tool for studying collective dynamics in neural populations, yet quantitative comparisons to experiments remain limited. Recent technological advances have made it possible to resolve population-wide correlations across neurons, and minimal models such as random neural networks predict their generic structure. Whether the two agree quantitatively remains untested. In this work, we examine whether a minimally structured random neural network can account for the low dimensionality of activity in neural population recordings by building on recent developments in Dynamical Mean-Field Theory and incorporating two additional experimentally relevant features into the model: finite measurement time and variability across behavioral contexts. We show that, when these factors are included, the dimensionality measured from large-scale recordings is consistent with the values predicted by random models. However, current recording durations make it difficult to use dimensionality to discriminate among connectivity structures. We further show that analytically predicted dimensionality varies non-monotonically with external input strength, and that the orientation similarity between neural manifolds recorded under different behavioral contexts can be more sensitive to network structure than dimensionality is. Together, these results provide quantitative guidance for experimental design to infer the connectivity structure underlying population activity.

</details>


### [468] [The Sensation Modulating Network:Haltability as the architectural ground for object-directed phenomenology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26856)
*G. Nagarjuna,Durgaprasad Karnam*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出感觉调制网络（SMN）模型，将认知主体构想为整个身体，通过拮抗动力学组织，以协调4E认知与认知主义之间的分歧。该模型通过可停止性、双信号属性和四级行动模式层次结构，论证了递归源于可调节动力学，具身性源于拮抗基底，无需额外模块即可实现意向指向性和语法生成性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 认知科学目前分裂为认知主义（能解释递归和语言但无法将形式符号扎根于意义）与4E具身认知进路（将认知扎根于身体但很少具体说明身体的架构细节以支持生成性）。作者认为这一僵局源于对具身主体架构的不完整描述，因此需要提出一个完整的架构来调和二者。

Method: 提出感觉调制网络（SMN）模型，将认知主体构想为整个身体，在每一个解剖尺度上通过拮抗动力学组织，由感觉调制器（通过同一基底感知和行动的单元）构建，配对为协调行动区，通过全身广播网络进行路由。模型包含三个关键承诺：可停止性（拮抗性可供性被征募到共激活平衡中）、双信号属性（自我/世界区分成为接线的结构特征）、四级行动模式层次结构（基底→可停止→可协商→可交易）。

Result: SMN模型调和了认知主义与4E认知之争：递归存在于可协商行动模式的可调节动力学中，具身性存在于支持它们的拮抗基底中。附录中给出了一个初步的形式化框架、八个预测的寄存器（七个可检验，一个假设性）以及参考模拟。
