Conclusion: SMN模型通过将递归定位为可协商行动模式的可调节动力学、将具身性定位为其拮抗基底，为认知科学的核心分歧提供了架构层面的解决方案。该模型表明，无需在身体之上添加额外模块，仅通过身体自身的拮抗组织架构，即可实现从自主规律性到公共约定化的完整轨迹，并为语法支撑的生成性提供了架构条件。

Abstract: Cognitive science remains split between cognitivism - which accounts for recursion and language but cannot ground formal symbols in meaning - and 4E approaches - which ground cognition in the body but rarely specify the body's architecture in enough detail to support generativity. We argue the impasse stems from an incomplete account of the embodied agent's architecture, and propose one: the Sensation Modulating Network (SMN), the cognitive agent conceived as the whole body, organized at every anatomical scale by opponent dynamics, built from Sensation Modulators that sense and act through one substrate, paired into Coordinated Action Zones routed by a body-wide broadcast network. Three commitments give the SMN its purchase. Haltability - the recruitment of antagonistic affordance into co-activated equilibrium - provides the architectural locus that object-directed phenomenology, in Husserl's sense, requires: opponency enables co-activation, co-activation enables halt, halt enables attention, attention enables intentional directedness, with no module added on top. The dual-signal property of self-modulatable action patterns (SMAPs) makes the self/world distinction a structural feature of the wiring rather than a category the agent applies. And a four-level action-pattern hierarchy - Basal, Haltable, Negotiable, Transactional - gives a single trajectory from autonomic regularity to public conventionalization, locating the conditions for grammar-grounded generativity as architectural transitions. The SMN reconciles the cognitivism-4E debate: recursion lives in the modifiable dynamics of Negotiable Action Patterns, embodiment in the opponent substrate that supports them. A tentative formalism and eight predicted registers (seven testable, one hypothetical), with reference simulations, are given in an appendix.

</details>


### [469] [MoDAl: Self-Supervised Neural Modality Discovery via Decorrelation for Speech Neuroprosthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.00025)
*Yuanhao Chen,Peter Chin*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: MoDAl框架通过对比对齐与去相关损失的相互作用，从多脑区（包括Broca区）发现互补神经模态，在Brain-to-Text Benchmark '24上将词错误率从26.3%降至21.6%，并揭示了区域44编码句法结构信息的功能特化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有言语神经假体主要从运动皮层解码，忽略了如Broca区（44区）等可能编码互补语言学信息的脑区，限制了解码性能。

Method: 提出MoDAl框架：通过对比损失将多个并行脑编码器与预训练LLM的文本嵌入对齐，同时通过去相关损失防止编码器产生冗余表示，迫使发现多样化的神经语言学模态。

Result: 在Brain-to-Text Benchmark '24上，WER从26.3%降至21.6%；引入44区信号的增益完全来自去相关机制；分析显示44区编码器捕捉句子长度、语法语态、wh-词等句法结构属性。

Conclusion: 对比对齐会诱导传递性模态融合，去相关损失可有效对抗该趋势以发现互补模态；多脑区联合解码与去相关机制结合能显著提升解码性能，且学到的模态与神经语言学对Broca区功能的理解一致。

Abstract: Speech neuroprosthesis systems decode intended speech from neural activity in the absence of audible output, offering a path to restoring communication for individuals with speech-impairing conditions. Current approaches decode predominantly from motor cortical areas, discarding others -- such as area 44, part of Broca's area -- that may encode complementary linguistic information. We introduce MoDAl (Modality Decorrelation and Alignment), a framework that discovers complementary neural modalities through the interplay of two objectives in a shared projection space. A contrastive loss aligns each of several parallel brain encoders with the text embeddings of a pretrained large language model (LLM), while a decorrelation loss prevents the encoders from coalescing to duplicative representations. We prove that these objectives are in productive tension: Contrastive alignment induces transitive modality coalescence, which decorrelation must counteract for the framework to discover diverse neurolinguistic modalities. On the Brain-to-Text Benchmark '24, MoDAl reduces word error rate (WER) from 26.3% to 21.6% compared to the previous best end-to-end method, with the gain from incorporating previously discarded area 44 signals arising entirely from the decorrelation mechanism. Analysis of the discovered modalities reveals functional specialization: Encoders receiving area 44 input capture structural and syntactic properties (sentence length, grammatical voice, wh-words), consistent with the neurolinguistic understanding of Broca's area.

</details>


### [470] [Contextual Role Modulates Object Representational Geometry in the Human Brain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23111)
*Julien Dirani,Shankar Chawla,Leila Wehbe,Bradford Z. Mahon*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 该研究结合功能磁共振成像与自然观影范式，发现人脑对同一物体在不同情境（被动场景元素 vs. 目标导向动作靶子）下的神经表征存在双重分离：靶子物体激活顶叶动作网络（缘上回/中央后回），表征几何按动作可供性组织；被动物体激活枕颞视觉网络，按语义维度组织；视觉表征结构保持情境不变性，表明灵活性与不变性在同一表征系统的不同层级运作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究人脑如何在同一物体随情境角色（被动场景元素 vs. 动作目标）变化时，动态重映射其神经表征，揭示情境依赖的表征灵活性与不变性机制。

Method: 结合功能磁共振成像（fMRI）与自然主义电影观看范式，比较同一物体作为被动场景元素与作为目标导向动作靶子时的神经表征模式，分析不同脑区的表征几何结构。

Result: 靶子物体激活顶叶动作网络（缘上回、中央后回），表征按动作可供性和手姿势可供性维度组织；被动物体激活枕颞视觉网络，表征按语义维度组织；视觉表征结构在情境间保持不变；情境特异性脑区外则保持情境不变性。

Conclusion: 人脑能够根据物体在自然场景中的即时情境相关性的变化，动态重映射物体的表征几何结构，灵活性与不变性在同一表征系统的不同层级共存。

Abstract: The human brain represents objects in a way that is both invariant across instances and flexible enough to support different contexts and tasks. Yet it remains unknown how object representations are dynamically remapped as the same object shifts across contextual roles. Here we combined fMRI with naturalistic movie viewing to investigate how the same objects are represented when they are passive elements in the scene versus the targets of goal-directed actions. When objects were action targets, they engaged a parietal action network centered in the supramarginal and postcentral gyri, while passive objects recruited a distributed occipito-temporal network involved in visual object recognition. Within the networks most strongly encoding objects in their respective contexts, representational geometry showed a double dissociation: target object representations were organized by action affordance and hand posture affordance dimensions, while passive object representations aligned with semantic dimensions. In addition, visual representational structure was invariant to context. Outside those context-specific brain networks, representational content retained context-invariance, indicating that flexibility and invariance operate at different levels of the same representational system. Together, these findings demonstrate neural remapping of object representational geometries in a manner that depends on moment-to-moment changes in the contextual relevance of objects within a naturalistic scene.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [471] [The Environmental Costs of Surveillance Capitalism: A Case Study of Social Media Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26314)
*Nils Bonfils,Christoph Becker*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出概念框架量化监控资本主义（surveillance capitalism）的材料基础设施所产生的环境成本，通过对比X/Twitter与Mastodon的网络流量案例，发现企业社交媒体的额外资源消耗（"企业开销"）可作为监控资本主义活动的代理指标，并据此建立了可归因于非用户体验营利性活动的CO2e排放下限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究ICT日益增长的碳排放中有多少可归因于监控资本主义的材料基础设施，为量化其环境成本奠定基础。

Method: 提出概念框架与研究路径，将监控过程与其物质基础设施关联；通过X/Twitter（商业平台）与Mastodon（去中心化非商业替代方案）的比较案例研究，分析监控资本主义流程在网络流量中的占比。

Result: 发现"企业开销"（corporate overhead）的存在，即企业社交媒体实践导致的超额资源消耗；X的企业开销可用于建立非用户体验营利活动所排放CO2e的下限。

Conclusion: 监控资本主义的材料基础设施是ICT碳排放的重要来源，通过对比商业与非商业平台可量化其环境成本，企业开销指标可作为评估监控资本主义环境影响的起点。

Abstract: The business model of surveillance capitalism, premised on the extraction of behavioral data and its predictive potential for profit, relies on extensive material infrastructure. Such profit is typically driven by practices such as telemetry, user tracking, data analytics, secondary data uses, increased user engagement, and AI model training, as well as large-scale data storage systems that retain personal information for sale or reuse. This paper is motivated by the question: how much of the rising carbon impact of ICT can be attributed to this material infrastructure? Such an inquiry provides a foundation for quantifying the environmental costs of surveillance capitalism by proposing a conceptual framework and research direction that link processes of surveillance with their underlying material realities. To demonstrate the applicability of this framework, we examine the proportion of network traffic caused by surveillance capitalism processes through a comparative case study of a corporate social media platform, X/formerly Twitter, and a decentralized, non-commercial alternative, Mastodon. Our findings highlight the existence of corporate overhead: excess resource consumption driven by corporate social media practices, which is used as an initial proxy for the activities of surveillance capitalism. Our findings further demonstrate how the corporate overhead of X can be used to establish a lower bound in CO2e emissions attributable to for-profit activities that do not contribute to the user experience.

</details>


### [472] [Examining the Challenges of Intellectual Property in AI-Generated Productions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26590)
*Ali Mazhar,Mohammad Zare,Marjan Veysi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了AI自主生成作品在缺乏人类创作者情况下的知识产权归属问题，比较研究了伊朗、欧盟、英国和美国的法律框架，发现伊朗现行法律存在重大监管空白，建议通过修订现有法律或定义新型知识产权来解决AI生成作品的保护问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统能够自主生成艺术、文学、音乐甚至发明成果，传统以人类创作者为核心的知识产权制度面临前所未有的挑战，尤其是在缺乏人类创作者时，作品的道德权利和经济权利归属不明确，亟需法律层面的澄清与保护。

Method: 本文采用文献综述与比较法研究相结合的方法，首先回顾了该领域的理论基础和现有文献，然后对伊朗法律框架（1969年《作者、作曲家和艺术家权利保护法》及《专利和商标注册法》）与欧盟、英国、美国的法律制度进行了比较分析，最后评估了现有法律观点及执行挑战。

Result: 研究发现伊朗现行法律框架在AI生成作品的知识产权保护方面存在重大监管空白；各国法律体系对AI生成作品的保护尚未形成统一解决方案。

Conclusion: 为平衡促进创新与保护人类创造力，必须修订现有法律并引入新方法，例如为AI生成作品定义特定的知识产权权利，或指定相关人类代理人作为权利归属主体。

Abstract: With the advancement of artificial intelligence systems capable of autonomously generating artistic, literary, musical works, and even inventions without direct human intervention, the intellectual property (IP) regime faces unprecedented questions and challenges. The most critical issue concerns the ownership of moral and economic rights in the absence of a human creator, and how such outputs can be granted legal protection. This paper first reviews the theoretical foundations and existing literature in this domain, then comparatively examines Iranian legal frameworks such as the 1969 Law for the Protection of Authors, Composers, and Artists Rights and the Patent and Trademark Registration Law-alongside other legal systems, including the European Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States. Furthermore, existing legal perspectives on the intellectual property of AI-generated works and the related enforcement challenges are analyzed. The findings reveal significant regulatory gaps within the current Iranian legal framework. To balance the promotion of innovation with the preservation of human creativity, revising existing laws and introducing novel approaches such as defining a specific intellectual property right for AI-generated works or designating ownership among associated human agents appears to be essential.

</details>


### [473] [Generative artificial intelligence and the marginalization of minoritized knowledges in higher education: the case of disability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26769)
*Fatiha Tali-Otmani*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 生成式人工智能通过训练数据集（以英语和西方为中心）强化了认知殖民性，导致非霸权认识论被边缘化，并以残疾人群体的双重边缘化为例，探讨研究者与机器混合能否保留认知多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 揭示生成式人工智能并非价值中立的技术，而是通过其训练数据和架构设计，系统性地边缘化非西方、非主流的认知方式，尤其是对残疾人群体造成双重排斥。

Method: 采用跨学科理论框架，融合教育科学、批判技术研究与残疾研究，分析生成式AI的训练数据集特征及其对认知多样性的影响。

Result: 训练数据集的盎格鲁-西方中心导向强化了认知殖民性；技术架构将残疾人局限于刻板印象或排除在设计过程之外，形成双重边缘化。

Conclusion: 算法修正作为一种纯粹的姑息策略存在结构性局限，研究者与机器的混合可能为保留认知多样性提供路径，但需正视这些结构性约束。

Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence redefines higher education by restructuring the processes through which scientific knowledge is produced and validated. These systems are not neutral; they actively contribute to the marginalization of non-hegemonic epistemologies. This research draws upon educational sciences, critical technology studies, and disability studies to demonstrate that training datasets, which remain predominantly Anglophone and Western-centric, reinforce epistemic coloniality. The situation of persons with disabilities provides a particularly clear illustration of this phenomenon. Technological architectures frequently confine these individuals to reductive stereotypes or exclude them from the design process, leading to a double marginalization. This article examines whether a hybridization between the researcher and the machine might preserve epistemic plurality, while acknowledging the structural limitations inherent in algorithmic correction when used as a purely palliative strategy.

</details>


### [474] [Implementation of Big Data Analytics for Diabetes Management: Needs Assessment in the Rwanda Healthcare System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26786)
*Silas Majyambere,Tony Lindgren,Workneh Y. Ayele,Celestin Twizere*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究评估了卢旺达医疗系统采用大数据分析（BDA）管理糖尿病的准备情况。通过为期五天、25位关键利益相关者参与的工作坊，研究揭示了BDA应用的潜力与挑战，并提出了一个基于可解释机器学习模型的实用BDA框架，以支持糖尿病管理策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 糖尿病若不能及早诊断和管理，会导致严重的健康问题。大数据分析和机器学习虽能分析大规模健康数据并支持早期检测和更好的治疗决策，但在常规临床实践中应用仍然有限。因此，需要评估特定医疗系统（如卢旺达）采用BDA的 readiness。

Method: 举办为期五天的工作坊，邀请25位关键利益相关者（包括临床医生、数据管理人员、政策制定者、医学研究人员、营养师和技术提供商），评估卢旺达医疗系统采用大数据分析管理糖尿病的准备情况，并识别现有差距。

Result: 研究揭示了BDA实施的潜力和主要挑战。基于这些结果，提出了一个实用的BDA框架，利用可解释的机器学习模型支持糖尿病管理策略。

Conclusion: 随着卢旺达持续扩展电子病历和健康信息系统，新的机遇出现以改善预测、监测和临床决策。该研究提出的可解释机器学习框架为卢旺达糖尿病管理中的BDA应用提供了实践路径。

Abstract: Diabetes is a chronic metabolic disease that can lead to serious health problems if not diagnosed and managed early. Big Data Analytics (BDA) and machine learning offer practical tools for analyzing large health datasets and supporting early detection and better treatment decisions. However, their use in routine clinical practice is still limited. This study examines the readiness of Rwanda's healthcare system to adopt big data analytics for diabetes management. As the country continues to expand its use of electronic medical records and health information systems, new opportunities arise for improving prediction, monitoring, and clinical decision-making. A five-day workshop involving 25 key stakeholders, including clinicians, data managers, policymakers, medical researchers, nutritionists, and technology providers, was conducted to assess preparedness and identify existing gaps. The findings highlight both the potential and the main challenges of BDA implementation. Based on these results, the paper proposes a practical BDA framework to support diabetes management strategies using explainable machine learning models.

</details>


### [475] [How Students (Mis)understand Conditionals and Loops -- A Taxonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26966)
*Dimitri Eckert,Christian Kautz*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过扩展分类法设计流程（ETDP），基于先前研究和实证数据，构建了一个细粒度分类法，专门用于分类初学编程者在阅读和理解控制流结构（选择与迭代）时遇到的困难，旨在为计算教育研究提供统一的理论框架和教学策略支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解学生在编程中的困难是一个复杂挑战，现有研究缺乏统一的、细粒度的分类体系来系统化地描述初学编程者在控制流结构（选择与迭代）方面的阅读和理解困难。

Method: 采用扩展分类法设计流程（ETDP）的迭代方法论，结合先前研究和来自测验、访谈的实证数据，构建了细粒度分类法。

Result: 形成了对条件语句和循环中常见学生误解的详细分析，明确了不同学生困难之间的清晰区分。

Conclusion: 该分类法为计算教育研究者提供了统一的框架来分类和分析学生错误，深化理论洞察并指导教学策略；未来工作将应用于新学生数据并评估其可用性。

Abstract: Understanding student difficulties in programming is a complex challenge due to the wide range of topics and the abundant varieties of misconceptions and errors. This paper presents the design and development of a fine-grained taxonomy that categorizes novice programmers' difficulties specifically related to reading and understanding the control flow constructs selection and iteration. Building upon prior research and our own empirical data from quizzes and interviews with students, the taxonomy is constructed through the iterative methodology of the Extended Taxonomy Design Process (ETDP). Key contributions include clear distinctions between different student difficulties and a detailed analysis of common student misunderstandings concerning conditional statements and loops. The taxonomy aims to aid computing education researchers by providing a harmonized framework to classify and analyze student errors, fostering deeper theoretical insights and informing pedagogical strategies. Future work will involve applying the taxonomy to novel student data and evaluating its usability among educators and researchers.

</details>


### [476] [Building an Atlas of Social Experiments to Link Studies, Reconcile Conflicts, and Bridge Gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27153)
*Jiawei Zhang,Honglin Bao,Pengda Wang,Alex Yan,Xiao Liu,James A. Evans*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: ExAtlas是一个将实验档案转化为结构化地图的框架，通过组合局部相近研究的效应来链接、调和冲突或提出桥梁实验，在保持局部平滑假设下，能够高准确率恢复效应方向，并为理论生成提供有价值的信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社会与行为科学每年进行大量实验，但研究发现很少能凝聚成连贯的知识地图，导致已知、冲突和缺失的知识难以系统化。

Method: ExAtlas框架：给定目标研究，搜索在治疗和结果空间中局部相近的已有研究，通过组合它们的观测效应来预测目标效应。若组合成功且一致则链接；若组合成功但不一致则调和冲突并提出候选调节变量或更高层理论；若组合失败则提出桥梁实验。方法基于治疗-效应曲面的局部平滑性假设并提供了误差界。

Result: 在经认证为局部支持的留出目标上，ExAtlas在98.6%的情况下正确恢复了效应方向。人类评估表明其提出的桥梁实验合理且具有连接性，冲突解释对理论生成有用。

Conclusion: 社会实验档案中蕴含的潜在结构远超当前实践所能提取的量，明确化这些结构可以指导未来的理论构建和实验设计。

Abstract: Social and behavioral science runs thousands of experiments each year, yet their findings rarely accumulate into a coherent map of what is known, what conflicts, and what remains missing. We introduce ExAtlas, a framework for turning an archive of experiments into an atlas: a structured map in which studies link, conflict, or leave bridgeable gaps. Given a target study, ExAtlas searches for prior studies that are locally close in treatment and outcome space and asks whether their observed effects can be composed to predict the target effect. This yields three cases. If the composition succeeds and agrees with the observed result, ExAtlas links the target to consistent prior evidence. If composition succeeds but disagrees, ExAtlas reconciles the conflict and proposes candidate moderators or higher-level theories that could explain it. If composition fails, ExAtlas proposes bridge experiments to close the gap. We provide an error bound for composition under local smoothness of the treatment-effect surface. On held-out targets certified as locally supported, ExAtlas recovers effect direction in 98.6% of cases. Human evaluations further suggest that its proposed bridge experiments are plausible and exhibit connectedness, and that its conflict explanations are useful for theory generation. These results suggest that the archive of social experiments contains more latent structure than current practice extracts -- and that making this structure explicit can guide both future theory and future experimentation.

</details>


### [477] [Faults and Pitfalls in Implementing the Right to be Forgotten](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27171)
*Chen Sun,Nikolas Guggenberger,Supreeth Shastri*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文针对"被遗忘权"(RTBF)在实际计算实现中的挑战，提出了一种两阶段方法来弥合法律与计算之间的鸿沟，该方法可完全避免GDPR第6年中80%的RTBF违规，并发现了六个已成为RTBF反模式的传统计算与数据管理实践，最后在Elasticsearch中实现了RTBF能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管RTBF在法律层面定义明确（GDPR仅用417字描述），但计算社区在实践中实现该权利面临巨大挑战——GDPR前五年内发生了205起RTBF违规事件（平均每9天一起）。因此，需要从计算视角识别支持RTBF的不确定性和风险，并提出可行的解决方案。

Method: 提出一种两阶段方法，桥接法律与计算之间的内在二分法。该方法通过识别RTBF支持中的不确定性和风险，设计了从法律要求到计算实现的技术映射路径。

Result: 该方法可完全避免GDPR第6年中80%的RTBF违规事件；发现了六个长期存在的计算与数据管理实践已成为RTBF的反模式；成功将RTBF能力引入Elasticsearch开源搜索引擎。

Conclusion: 通过两阶段方法有效弥合了法律与计算之间的鸿沟，显著降低了RTBF违规风险，并揭示出需要重新审视传统计算实践以适应数据隐私权利的法律要求。

Abstract: Right to be Forgotten (RTBF) in one of the oldest and prominent of the legal data rights. While its legal intention is straight forward (for example, the GDPR describes it in just 417 words), the computing community has found it challenging to implement this in practice. For example, regulators have issued 205 RTBF violations in the first five years of GDPR i.e., an RTBF failure once every 9 days, on average. In this work, we identify the uncertainties and risks in supporting RTBF from a computing perspective. Then, to mitigate these challenges, we propose a two-phase approach that bridges an intrinsic dichotomy between law and computing. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our technique by showing how it could have fully avoided 80% of RTBF violations that occurred in the year-6 of GDPR. We also discover six long-standing practices of computing and data management that have become anti-patterns for RTBF. Finally, to ground our research, we introduce RTBF capability into Elasticsearch, a popular open-source search engine.

</details>


### [478] [Queue & AI: When Faster Tasks Slow Down the Workflow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27202)
*Silvia Bartolucci,Pierpaolo Vivo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文通过排队论模型揭示了生成式AI在任务密集型工作流中的"方差楔子"效应：虽然AI能降低平均任务完成时间，但未检测到的错误会导致下游返工成本激增，在拥堵条件下人类审查意愿反而下降，从而损害系统整体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常用平均处理时间等均值指标衡量AI的生产力增益，但这些指标可能掩盖AI在工作流中的负面影响。当任务积累并竞争稀缺的人类注意力时，AI辅助会产生一种"欺骗性生产力特征"——平均速度提升但系统级性能恶化，需要更精确的评估框架。

Method: 构建排队论模型，形式化AI辅助工作流中的任务处理机制。分析了两种任务处理模式（全AI辅助与全人工）之间的相变，推导出两个核心分析结论：拥堵条件下审查阈值的变化，以及AI稳定过载工作流的临界条件。

Result: (1) 在拥堵条件下，审查者会理性提高检查AI输出的风险阈值，即在最需要仔细审查时反而降低审查力度；(2) AI辅助稳定过载工作流需要同时满足两个条件：AI处理任务比例超过临界阈值，且审查与预期返工所需的人类注意力低于纯人工完成所需注意力——这一要求远比"生成更快草稿"更为严格。

Conclusion: AI部署的评估不应仅看平均任务速度，还需考量其对拥堵、返工和负载下人类监督鲁棒性的整体影响。均值指标可能误导政策制定和管理决策，需要更系统的评估方法。

Abstract: Quantifying the workplace productivity effects of Generative Artificial Intelligence is now central to economics, management, and public policy. The deployment of AI tools in customer service, writing, software development, and consulting operations has been reported to generate large per-task productivity gains, typically measured as tasks completed per worker-hour or reductions in mean handle time. We argue that such mean-based metrics can misrepresent AI's effects in workflows where tasks accumulate and compete for scarce human attention. AI assistance can generate a deceptive productivity signature: average completion times fall because AI tools typically supply a fast first draft, yet workflow-level performance deteriorates when a subset of AI errors escapes review and returns as costly downstream rework. We call this divergence between mean task speed and system-level delay the variance wedge. Depending on the operational parameters, the most time-efficient way to complete a workflow may undergo a transition between two task-processing regimes, a fully AI-assisted and a fully manual one. We formalize the mechanism as a queueing model and derive two main implications analytically. First, under congestion, reviewers rationally raise the risk threshold for checking AI outputs, reducing scrutiny precisely when it would matter the most. Second, AI assistance can stabilize an overloaded workflow only when (i) the fraction of tasks handled by AI exceeds a critical threshold, and (ii) the human attention required for review and expected rework is lower than the attention for manual completion, a requirement substantially more stringent than faster draft generation. These results suggest that AI deployment should be evaluated not only by average task speed, but by its overall effects on congestion, rework, and the robustness of human oversight under load.

</details>


### [479] [Algorithmic Monocultures in Hiring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27371)
*Rishi Bommasani,Sarah H. Bana,Kathleen A. Creel,Dan Jurafsky,Percy Liang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究分析了同一算法供应商的招聘算法对300万申请人的400万份申请进行处理时产生的种族差异和结果同质性问题。发现亚裔和黑人申请人分别有14.74%和25.87%的申请投向了对其不利的职位；4%申请10个职位的申请人被所有职位拒绝，高于随机预期。利用算法的确定性可复制性，研究还表明申请人需要广泛投递才能确保申请被人工审核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究算法同质化（Algorithmic Monoculture）是否导致相同的个人和种族群体在招聘筛选中系统性被拒。

Method: 获取并分析来自同一算法供应商的300万申请人、400万份申请的招聘数据，利用算法的确定性可复制性模拟申请人投递所有职位的结果。

Result: 亚裔和黑人申请人分别有14.74%和25.87%的申请面向对其不利的职位；4%申请10个职位的申请人被所有职位拒绝，高于随机预期。

Conclusion: 算法同质化导致招聘结果中的种族差异和结果同质性，申请人需要广泛投递才能确保申请被人工审核。

Abstract: Many employers screen job applicants with algorithms built by the same few algorithm vendors. We hypothesize that algorithmic monoculture leads to the same individuals and members of the same racial groups facing rejection. We acquire and analyze a novel dataset of 3 million applicants submitting 4 million applications where all the applications are screened by algorithms built by the same vendor. We find clear racial disparities in applicant outcomes. Of all applications submitted by Asian and Black applicants, 14.74% and 25.87% are submitted to positions that adversely impact Asian and Black applicants, respectively, according to U.S. employment discrimination standards. Individuals also receive homogeneous outcomes: 4% of all applicants who apply to 10 positions are recommended for rejection from all positions, a rate higher than expected by chance. To better understand this homogeneity, we leverage the deterministic replicability of hiring algorithms to generate the outcomes applicants would have received if they applied to all positions. We show that applicants would need to apply widely in order to ensure their applications are considered by a human

</details>


### [480] [Authorship Attribution in the Era of LLMs: Problems, Methodologies, and Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.08946)
*Baixiang Huang,Canyu Chen,Kai Shu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了LLM时代作者归属研究的最新进展，将相关研究归纳为四类问题：人类文本归属、LLM生成文本检测、LLM生成文本归属、人机协同文本归属，并讨论了泛化性与可解释性等挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的快速发展模糊了人与机器文本的界限，传统作者归属方法面临严峻挑战；准确归属作者对维护数字内容完整性、改进取证调查、减少虚假信息和抄袭风险至关重要。

Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，将现有研究归纳为四类代表性问题，并评估各方法的优势与局限，识别关键开放问题与未来研究方向。

Result: 梳理了四类问题的研究现状，指出了泛化性（跨领域泛化能力）和可解释性（提供透明可理解的决策依据）是两个核心挑战。

Conclusion: 本文为LLM时代的作者归属研究提供了系统性的路线图，明确了当前方法的优缺点和未来研究方向，对该领域的研究者和从业者具有重要参考价值。

Abstract: Accurate attribution of authorship is crucial for maintaining the integrity of digital content, improving forensic investigations, and mitigating the risks of misinformation and plagiarism. Addressing the imperative need for proper authorship attribution is essential to uphold the credibility and accountability of authentic authorship. The rapid advancements of Large Language Models (LLMs) have blurred the lines between human and machine authorship, posing significant challenges for traditional methods. We present a comprehensive literature review that examines the latest research on authorship attribution in the era of LLMs. This survey systematically explores the landscape of this field by categorizing four representative problems: (1) Human-written Text Attribution; (2) LLM-generated Text Detection; (3) LLM-generated Text Attribution; and (4) Human-LLM Co-authored Text Attribution. We also discuss the challenges related to ensuring the generalization and explainability of authorship attribution methods. Generalization requires the ability to generalize across various domains, while explainability emphasizes providing transparent and understandable insights into the decisions made by these models. By evaluating the strengths and limitations of existing methods and benchmarks, we identify key open problems and future research directions in this field. This literature review serves as a roadmap for researchers and practitioners interested in understanding the state of the art in this rapidly evolving field.

</details>


### [481] [Intelligent Environmental Empathy (IEE): A new power and platform to fostering green obligation for climate peace and justice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.21536)
*Saleh Afroogh,Ali Mostafavi,Junfeng Jiao*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出智能环境共情（IEE）作为大数据时代气候和平与正义的新驱动力，针对自上而下的政府间合作失败，构建了基于环境共情与去中心化AI平台的自下而上操作模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自上而下的政府间气候合作（如UNEP）未能解决环境问题与裂缝，全球范围内缺乏共情和环境动机是失败根源。需要新的自下而上方法实现气候和平与正义。

Method: 提出智能环境共情（IEE）模型，结合环境共情（作为绿色义务驱动）与去中心化AI平台（作为反搭便车操作机制），首先影响公民和中层决策者（城市规划师、地方行政人员），最终影响全球决策者。

Result: 从四个层面阐释气候不正义根源（目的论起源、价值论起源、成因、社会认知成因），并论证IEE模型如何在操作层面推动气候和平与正义。

Conclusion: 自上而下的威权合作模式因缺乏共情而失效，IEE通过自下而上的共情驱动与AI赋能，为气候正义提供新的可行路径。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose Intelligent Environmental Empathy (IEE) as a new driver for climate peace and justice, as an emerging issue in the age of big data. We first show that the authoritarian top-down intergovernmental cooperation, through international organizations (e.g., UNEP) for climate justice, could not overcome environmental issues and crevices so far. We elaborate on four grounds of climate injustice (i.e., teleological origin, axiological origin, formation cause, and social epistemic cause), and explain how the lack of empathy and environmental motivation on a global scale causes the failure of all the authoritarian top-down intergovernmental cooperation. Addressing all these issues requires a new button-up approach to climate peace and justice. Secondly, focusing on the intersection of AI, environmental empathy, and climate justice, we propose a model of Intelligent Environmental Empathy (IEE) for climate peace and justice at the operational level. IEE is empowered by the new power of environmental empathy (as a driver of green obligation for climate justice) and putative decentralized platform of AI (as an operative system against free riders), which Initially, impact citizens and some middle-class decision makers, such as city planners and local administrators, but will eventually affect global decision-makers as well.

</details>


### [482] [Fixed Points and Stochastic Meritocracies: A Long-Term Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.07478)
*Gaurab Pokharel,Diptangshu Sen,Sanmay Das,Juba Ziani*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究了择优选拔项目（如大学招生）中反馈循环导致的群体公平性问题。通过构建代际模型，分析了在无内生差异的两群体中：对称效益下长期差距会周期性消长，但短期波动明显且优势消散时间随项目重要性增加；纯随机性可在小群体中产生显著差距；引入微小不对称性会导致差距随机产生并永久固化。研究精确刻画了差距持续或消失的条件，特别是名额稀缺性和项目有效性的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究择优选拔项目（如大学招生）中，因反馈循环效应（即选拔本身会赋予额外优势）所导致的群体公平性问题，特别是在群体间无内生差异的情况下，初始条件对称时公平性如何演变，以及微小不对称性如何导致永久性差距。

Method: 构建了新颖的代际模型进行理论分析，并辅以更丰富模型下的广泛模拟。模型聚焦于项目名额稀缺性和有效性两个关键参数，分析了对称效益、随机波动以及微小不对称性三种情境下的长期与短期公平性动态。

Result: 对称效益下长期平均差距消失但短期周期性波动；优势消散时间随项目重要性增加而延长；小群体中纯随机性可产生显著差距；引入微小不对称性导致差距随机产生并永久固化。

Conclusion: 研究精确刻画了选拔项目中公平性差距持续或消失的条件，对算法公平干预的设计与实施具有重要指导意义。

Abstract: We study group fairness in the context of feedback loops induced by meritocratic selection into programs that themselves confer additional advantage, like college admissions. We introduce a stylized, yet novel inter-generational model for the setting and analyze it in situations where there are no underlying differences between two populations. When the benefit of the program (or the harm of not getting into it) is completely symmetric, we show that disparities between the two populations will vanish on average in the long term, although in the short term disparities will continue to arise and dissipate cyclically. Further, the time an accumulated advantage takes to dissipate can be significant, and increases as a function of the relative importance of the program in conveying benefits. Interestingly, significant disparities can arise purely due to randomness even from completely symmetric initial conditions, especially when populations are small. The introduction of even a slight asymmetry, where the group that has accumulated an advantage becomes slightly preferred, leads to a completely different outcome. In these instances, starting from completely symmetric initial conditions, disparities between groups arise stochastically and then persist over time, yielding a permanent advantage for one group. Our analysis precisely characterizes conditions under which disparities persist or diminish, with a particular focus on the role of the scarcity of available spots in the program and its effectiveness. We also present extensive simulations in a richer model that further support our theoretical results in the simpler, stylized model. Our findings are relevant for the design and implementation of algorithmic fairness interventions in similar selection processes.

</details>


### [483] [A Technical Policy Blueprint for Trustworthy Decentralized AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.11878)
*Hasan Kassem,Orion Banks,Omar Benjelloun,Sergen Cansiz,Brandon Edwards,Patrick Foley,Inken Hagestedt,Taeho Jung,Peter Kairouz,Marco Lorenzi,Peter Mattson,Prakash Moorthy,Ann K Novakowski,Michael O'Connor,Bruno Rodrigues,Holger Roth,Micah Sheller,Dimitris Stripelis,Renato Umeton,Marc Vesin,Wenbin Zhang,Mic Bowman,Alexandros Karargyris*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种技术政策蓝图，通过将治理需求编码为策略即代码对象，并将策略验证与策略执行分离，实现透明、可扩展且可验证的去中心化AI系统治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化AI系统（如联邦学习）在资产隐私保护方面具有巨大潜力，但现有治理方法依赖特定基础设施的专有策略，阻碍了资产互操作性和系统间的信任，亟需透明、可扩展且可验证的治理机制。

Method: 提出技术政策蓝图，将治理需求编码为策略即代码对象；架构中策略引擎负责验证证据（身份、签名、支付、可信硬件证明等）并颁发能力包，资产守护者（数据、模型、计算守护者等）仅基于能力包执行访问或计算，实现策略验证与策略执行的解耦。

Result: 通过解耦策略处理与能力包，治理可以在不重新配置AI基础设施的情况下进行演化，实现了透明、可审计且抗变化的治理方案。

Conclusion: 这种将策略验证与执行分离的架构设计，为去中心化AI系统中的资产互操作性和跨系统信任提供了可行的治理路径，具有透明性、可审计性和对变化的弹性。

Abstract: Decentralized AI systems, such as federated learning, can play a critical role in further unlocking AI asset marketplaces (e.g., healthcare data marketplaces) thanks to increased asset privacy protection. Unlocking this big potential necessitates governance mechanisms that are transparent, scalable, and verifiable. However current governance approaches rely on bespoke, infrastructure-specific policies that hinder asset interoperability and trust among systems. We are proposing a Technical Policy Blueprint that encodes governance requirements as policy-as-code objects and separates asset policy verification from asset policy enforcement. In this architecture the Policy Engine verifies evidence (e.g., identities, signatures, payments, trusted-hardware attestations) and issues capability packages. Asset Guardians (e.g. data guardians, model guardians, computation guardians, etc.) enforce access or execution solely based on these capability packages. This core concept of decoupling policy processing from capabilities enables governance to evolve without reconfiguring AI infrastructure, thus creating an approach that is transparent, auditable, and resilient to change.

</details>


### [484] [Ethical Fairness without Demographics in Human-Centered AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.13373)
*Shaily Roy,Harshit Sharma,Daniel A. Adler,Srijan Sen,Tanzeem Choudhury,Asif Salekin*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Flare框架，一种不依赖人口统计或异质属性的公平学习方法，通过Fisher信息引导的潜在子群学习与无害正则化，在普适移动感知系统中提升伦理公平性。该方法利用优化几何（特别是Fisher信息）正则化曲率，在不需敏感属性的情况下揭示模型行为的潜在差异，并通过无害优化提升子群性能。文中还引入BHE指标套件（善行-伤害规避-公平），超越统计奇偶性衡量伦理公平。在多个移动生理、行为和临床感知数据集上，Flare在伦理公平性上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在普适医疗和移动健康系统中，高精度模型必须跨不同人群、情境和设备公平运作。然而，传统公平方法依赖训练时的人口统计或异质属性，这类属性常不可得、隐私敏感、受监管或不宜收集。基于奇偶性的公平还可能因牺牲子群表现而违反伦理原则。

Method: Flare框架：1) 利用Fisher信息（优化几何）正则化损失曲率，在不需人口统计属性的情况下发现潜在子群性能差异；2) 整合表征、损失和曲率信号识别隐藏性能分层；3) 通过协作但无害优化（do-no-harm regularization）精细化子群表现，同时保持伦理平衡；4) 提出BHE指标套件（善行-伤害规避-公平）超越统计奇偶性。

Result: 在EDA、OhioT1DM、IHS和Percept-R等多个移动生理、行为和临床感知数据集上，Flare在伦理公平性上优于现有SOTA基线。消融、可解释性和损失景观分析表明，性能提升源于更平坦的优化几何、更简单的决策规则以及无害潜在子群自适应。运行时分析支持其在资源受限感知部署中的实用性。

Conclusion: Flare为普适感知系统提供了一种不依赖敏感属性的伦理公平学习范式，通过优化几何正则化实现"不伤害"原则，在多数据集上验证了其有效性。

Abstract: In ubiquitous and mobile health systems, computational models infer human states from wearable, behavioral, and physiological sensing data. In these settings, high accuracy alone is insufficient; models must act ethically and equitably across diverse people, contexts, and devices. However, fairness methods that rely on demographic or heterogeneous attributes during training are difficult to enforce because such attributes are often unavailable, privacy-sensitive, regulated, or undesirable to collect. Conventional parity-based fairness can also violate ethical principles by trading off subgroup performance. To address this challenge, we present Flare, Fisher-guided LAtent-subgroup learning with do-no-harm REgularization, a demographic- and heterogeneous-attribute-agnostic framework that aligns human-centered fairness with ethical principles for ubiquitous and mobile sensing. Flare leverages optimization geometry, particularly Fisher Information, to regularize curvature and uncover latent disparities in model behavior without demographic or heterogeneous attributes. By integrating representation, loss, and curvature signals, it identifies hidden performance strata and refines them through collaborative but do-no-harm optimization, enhancing subgroup performance while preserving ethical balance. We also introduce BHE (Beneficence-Harm Avoidance-Equity), a metric suite that operationalizes ethical fairness beyond statistical parity. Across mobile physiological, behavioral, and clinical sensing datasets, including EDA, OhioT1DM, IHS, and Percept-R, Flare improves ethical fairness over state-of-the-art baselines. Ablation, interpretability, and loss-landscape analyses show that these gains arise from flatter optimization geometry, simpler decision rules, and do-no-harm latent-subgroup adaptation. Runtime analysis supports the practicality of Flare for resource-constrained sensing deployments.

</details>


### [485] [Auditing the Reliability of Multimodal Generative Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00944)
*Erfan Samieyan Sahneh,Luca Maria Aiello*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对Gemini 2.5 Pro多模态搜索系统进行了大规模审计，分析了11,943个声称-视频对，发现3.7%-18.7%的视频引证声称实际上不被所引来源支持，主要失败模式并非直接矛盾，而是不可验证的细节和夸大声称，表明系统在引用视频作为证据的同时注入了未基于事实的参数化知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型越来越多地作为生成式搜索系统使用，通过引用特定视频作为证据来增强其输出的权威性，但这些引用是否真正支持所生成声称的可信度尚未得到充分研究。

Method: 对Gemini 2.5 Pro系统进行大规模审计，涵盖医疗、经济和通用领域11,943个声称-视频对；使用三个独立LLM裁判进行自动验证（87.7%评分者间一致性），并经过人工标注验证；采用逻辑回归进行探索性事后分析。

Result: 3.7%-18.7%的视频引证声称不被所引来源支持；主要失败模式为不可验证的特定性和夸大声称；偏离源词汇（β=-1.6至-3.1, p<0.01）和与视频转录语义相似度低（β=-2.1至-11.6, p<0.01）的声称更可能不被支持。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了当前基于视频的生成式搜索的可信度特征，指出了系统所投射的信心与其输出保真度之间的差距，强调了引证可靠性问题的严重性。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) increasingly function as generative search systems that retrieve and synthesize answers from multimedia content, including YouTube videos. Although these systems project authority by citing specific videos as evidence, the extent to which these citations genuinely substantiate the generated claims remains underexplored. We present a large-scale audit of the Gemini 2.5 Pro multimodal search system, analyzing 11,943 claim-video pairs generated across Medical, Economic, and General domains. Through automated verification using three independent LLM judges (87.7\% inter-rater agreement), validated against human annotations, we find that depending on the judge's strictness, between 3.7\% and 18.7\% of video-grounded claims are not supported by their cited sources. The dominant failure modes are not outright contradictions but rather unverifiable specificities and overstated claims, suggesting the system injects precise but ungrounded details from parametric knowledge while citing videos as evidence. Exploratory post-hoc analysis via logistic regression reveals properties associated with these failures: claims departing from source vocabulary ($β= -1.6$ to $-3.1$, $p < 0.01$) and claims with low semantic similarity to the video transcript ($β= -2.1$ to $-11.6$, $p < 0.01$) are significantly more likely to be unsupported. These findings characterize the current trustworthiness of video-based generative search and highlight the gap between the confidence these systems project and the fidelity of their outputs. The dataset is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/icwsm-gemini-audit-04DF .

</details>


### [486] [The ATOM Report: Measuring the Open Language Model Ecosystem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07190)
*Nathan Lambert,Florian Brand*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 该论文对2025年开源大语言模型生态系统进行了全面分析，发现中国模型（如Qwen、DeepSeek）在2025年夏季超越美国模型（如Llama），并持续扩大领先优势。研究基于Hugging Face下载量、衍生模型数量、推理市场份额和性能指标等多维度数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源大语言模型生态系统对研究人员、创业者和政策制定者至关重要，但缺乏对其发展现状和主导力量变迁的系统性量化分析。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供关于约1500个主流开源模型的全面采用快照。

Method: 选取约1500个来自Alibaba Qwen、DeepSeek、Meta Llama等组织的开源主线模型，综合Hugging Face下载量、模型衍生数量、推理市场份额以及性能指标等多个维度进行量化分析。

Result: 中国开源模型在2025年夏季从数量和质量上超越美国模型，并在此后持续扩大差距。

Conclusion: 开源大语言模型生态的主导权已从美国向中国转移，这一趋势对全球AI研究、商业应用和政策制定具有深远影响。

Abstract: We present a comprehensive adoption snapshot of the leading open language models and who is building them, focusing on the ~1.5K mainline open models from the likes of Alibaba's Qwen, DeepSeek, Meta's Llama, that are the foundation of an ecosystem crucial to researchers, entrepreneurs, and policy advisors. We document a clear trend where Chinese models overtook their counterparts built in the U.S. in the summer of 2025 and subsequently widened the gap over their western counterparts. We study a mix of Hugging Face downloads and model derivatives, inference market share, performance metrics and more to make a comprehensive picture of the ecosystem.

</details>


### [487] [When VLMs 'Fix' Students: Identifying and Penalizing Over-Correction in the Evaluation of Multi-line Handwritten Math OCR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.22774)
*Jin Seong,Wencke Liermann,Minho Kim,Jong-hun Shin,Soojong Lim*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究多行手写数学公式的光学字符识别（OCR），指出现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）存在“过度修正”问题，并提出了基于LLM的语义评估指标PINK，实验表明PINK比传统BLEU指标更契合人类判断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准无法正确评估教育AI系统对手写数学的转录能力，多数研究仅关注单行表达式且依赖BLEU等词汇级指标，无法评估多行学生解答中的语义推理；同时发现VLM存在“过度修正”这一关键失效模式，即模型会“修复”学生错误而非忠实转录，掩盖了教育评估所需检测的错题。

Method: 提出PINK（Penalized INK-based score）语义评估指标，利用大语言模型进行基于评分标准的评分，并明确惩罚过度修正行为。在FERMAT数据集上对15个SOTA VLM进行综合评估。

Result: 与传统BLEU指标相比，排名出现显著反转：GPT-4o因过度修正受到严重惩罚，而Gemini 2.5 Flash成为最忠实的转录者。人类专家研究表明PINK与人类判断的一致性显著更高（55.0% vs BLEU的39.5%）。

Conclusion: PINK为教育场景下的手写数学OCR提供了更可靠的评估框架，强调了忠实转录而非“美化”错误的重要性。

Abstract: Accurate transcription of handwritten mathematics is crucial for educational AI systems, yet current benchmarks fail to evaluate this capability properly. Most prior studies focus on single-line expressions and rely on lexical metrics such as BLEU, which fail to assess the semantic reasoning across multi-line student solutions. In this paper, we present the first systematic study of multi-line handwritten math Optical Character Recognition (OCR), revealing a critical failure mode of Vision-Language Models (VLMs): over-correction. Instead of faithfully transcribing a student's work, these models often "fix" errors, thereby hiding the very mistakes an educational assessment aims to detect. To address this, we propose PINK (Penalized INK-based score), a semantic evaluation metric that leverages a Large Language Model (LLM) for rubric-based grading and explicitly penalizes over-correction. Our comprehensive evaluation of 15 state-of-the-art VLMs on the FERMAT dataset reveals substantial ranking reversals compared to BLEU: models like GPT-4o are heavily penalized for aggressive over-correction, whereas Gemini 2.5 Flash emerges as the most faithful transcriber. Furthermore, human expert studies show that PINK aligns significantly better with human judgment (55.0% preference over BLEU's 39.5%), providing a more reliable evaluation framework for handwritten math OCR in educational settings.

</details>


### [488] [Access Timing as Scaffolding: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to GenAI in Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15850)
*Janne Rotter,Pau Benazet i Montobbio,Davinia Hernández-Leo*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过强化学习智能体控制生成式AI的访问时机，在105名大学生中验证了策略性定时访问相比完全开放或完全限制能显著提升学习效果和元认知准确性，且无需显式提示或结构化支架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注如何从教学法角度搭建GenAI使用支架，但对何时允许学生使用GenAI这一问题缺乏基于教学理论的实证研究。作者希望将访问时机本身作为一种隐式支架，探索其是否是一种可操作、有理论依据且可扩展的教学策略。

Method: 采用混合方法对照实验（N=105），设计基于强化学习的智能体，依据元认知理论、认知负荷理论和生产性失败理论构建奖励函数，动态决定学生何时可以访问GenAI。实验比较三种条件：RL智能体控制的策略性访问、完全无限制访问、完全限制访问，评估学习效果和元认知参与度。

Result: RL条件下的策略性定时访问相比完全开放访问显著提高了客观后测成绩和元认知准确性，同时相比完全限制访问减少了任务错误和任务耗时，且无需显式元认知提示或结构化支架。但在自我报告的元认知意识上无组间差异。

Conclusion: GenAI访问时机是一种可操作、有理论依据且可扩展的教学策略，优于完全开放和完全限制两种极端方式，兼容现有GenAI工具且采用门槛低。这为教育者和人机学习系统设计中的访问时机调控开辟了新的研究方向。

Abstract: In recent years, generative AI (GenAI) in educational settings has become ubiquitous in university students' daily lives, despite its potential to induce over-reliance, metacognitive disengagement, and diminished learning when used unrestrictedly. While most prior research has focused on how to pedagogically scaffold its usage, the question of when to allow off-the-shelf GenAI remains understudied and lacks pedagogically grounded empirical investigation. We treat access timing itself as a form of implicit scaffolding and operationalize it through a reinforcement learning (RL) agent that decides when students should access GenAI, with a reward function grounded in metacognitive theory, cognitive load theory, and productive failure. In a mixed-methods controlled lab study with N=105 higher education students, we compared the agent's effect on learning gains and metacognitive engagement to unrestricted and fully restricted use. Results show that strategically timed GenAI access under the reinforcement learning condition improved objective post-test performance and metacognitive accuracy compared with unrestricted access, while reducing task errors and time on task relative to complete withholding, thus outperforming both approaches without the need for explicit metacognitive prompts or structured scaffolding. However, no between-condition differences emerged on self-reported metacognitive awareness. Overall, timing of GenAI access therefore is a tractable, theoretically grounded, and scalable pedagogical strategy that improves over completely unrestricted and withheld access, compatible with off-the-shelf tools and potentially low adoption barrier. This opens up a new research area that explores how access timing can be facilitated by educators and implemented in human-AI learning system design.

</details>


### [489] [Habermolt: Delegating Deliberation to AI Representatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24413)
*Joseph Low,Oscar Duys,Claude Formanek,Lewis Hammond,Michiel Bakker*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出"AI代理 deliberation"这一新范式，即AI系统代表人类进行 deliberative deliberation，并通过Habermolt平台实证研究其有效性，揭示了代表性、聚合与修订三个维度的设计挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的AI中介 deliberation（AI-mediated deliberation）虽然通过综合多人输入来扩大参与规模，但个体用户仍需投入大量时间。随着AI模型能力的提升，AI系统不仅可以中介 deliberation，还可以代表人类进行 deliberation。然而，这种"AI代理 deliberation"（AI-delegated deliberation）面临着尚未被充分理解和理论化的新型设计与对齐挑战。

Method: 作者构建并部署了Habermolt，一个公开的AI代理 deliberation平台。通过该平台进行实证研究，从三个维度（代表性、聚合、修订）评估AI代理 deliberation系统的有效性。

Result: 基于Habermolt平台的实证观察，揭示了AI代理 deliberation平台在未来设计中必须面对的关键决策问题，包括如何在代表性、聚合和修订三个维度上平衡效率与可信度。

Conclusion: AI代理 deliberation虽然有望实现前所未有的民主参与规模，但需要解决新的设计与对齐挑战。本文的发现为构建可扩展且可信赖的AI代表系统提供了研究议程基础。

Abstract: Deliberative democracy arguably leads to better collective decisions, but is fundamentally constrained by human attention and bandwidth. While recent AI-mediated deliberations scale participation by synthesizing inputs from many humans, they remain time-intensive for individual users. As AI models become increasingly capable, AI systems are being deployed not only to mediate deliberation between humans, but to represent humans in it: where AI agents deliberate on behalf of human users. We call this paradigm AI-delegated deliberation. While it promises unprecedented scale for democratic participation, it introduces qualitatively new design and alignment challenges that are poorly understood and under-theorized. To study these dynamics empirically, we deploy Habermolt, a public platform for AI-delegated deliberation. We evaluate its effectiveness along three dimensions that we use to organize any deliberative system: representation, aggregation, and revision. We use these observations to illuminate the design decisions future AI-delegated deliberation platforms must confront, contributing to the broader research agenda for scalable yet trustworthy AI representatives.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [490] [Collaborative Navigation and Exploration with $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26304)
*Evangelos Psomiadis,Dipankar Maity,Panagiotis Tsiotras*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种异构机器人协同导航框架，通过β-稀疏高斯过程实现任务感知的诱导点选择，使移动传感器机器人在带宽受限下联合优化传输地图点和导航动作，并预测未知环境区域。在模拟实验中，路径成本降低18%，传输信息减少76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构机器人在未知环境中协同导航面临感知、通信和计算资源限制的挑战，需要解决在带宽受限条件下如何高效传输环境信息以辅助领航机器人导航的问题。

Method: 提出β-稀疏高斯过程（β-Sparse Gaussian Processes）用于任务感知的诱导点选择；开发了平衡任务相关性与探索的动作选择策略；实现传感器机器人对传输地图点和导航动作的联合在线优化。

Result: 在火星和地球地图模拟中，相比无通信基线路径成本降低18%，相比原始数据传输基线传输信息减少76%。

Conclusion: 所提框架能有效在带宽受限条件下实现异构机器人协同导航，显著降低路径成本并大幅减少通信数据量。

Abstract: Collaborative navigation of heterogeneous robots in unknown environments poses significant challenges due to sensing, communication, and computational limitations. In this work, a lead robot navigates toward a target while a mobile sensor robot (e.g., a drone) assists by transmitting information about its locally observed environment under bandwidth constraints. We propose a framework that enables the sensor to jointly select its transmitted map points and navigation actions online, while also predicting unexplored regions of the environment. To this end, we present $β$-Sparse Gaussian Processes, a novel and robust variational sparse Gaussian Process model for task-aware inducing point selection. Furthermore, we develop an action-selection strategy that balances task relevance with exploration. Simulations on Mars and Earth maps show that the framework can reduce path cost by 18% relative to no communication and decrease transmitted information by 76% compared to raw-data transmission baselines.

</details>


### [491] [RCSP: Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning for Safe Dynamic Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26348)
*Zhengye Han,Quanyan Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出风险敏感猜想场景规划（RCSP）方法，通过预测短期障碍物未来轨迹来评估候选命令的安全性，解决移动机器人因未来路径被关闭而导致的近失承诺问题。在MuJoCo和ROS2/Gazebo实验中，RCSP能避免碰撞、提高安全性和路径质量，但在严格基准测试中逊于传统方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在当前安全速度下可能因未来障碍物路径关闭而陷入危险（预测性近失承诺问题），现有方法缺乏对短期未来交互的预测性风险评估。

Method: RCSP维护一个轻量级的局部运动猜想信念分布，对未来交互进行采样，惩罚高风险尾部，并通过局部安全检查执行规划。作为预测风险模块，可集成到现有导航栈（如Nav2）中。

Result: 在MuJoCo瓶颈任务中无碰撞到达目标，安全性和路径质量优于非自适应预测器；在ROS2/Gazebo中减少动态近失故障；在DynaBARN/Jackal转移测试中，DWA和TEB在严格基准成功率上更强，揭示了方法边界。

Conclusion: RCSP作为预测性风险模块，可有效补充现有导航栈在动态瓶颈场景下的不足，但严格基准测试表明其与传统方法存在性能边界。

Abstract: Mobile robots can fail before they collide: a velocity that is safe now may commit the robot to a passage that moving obstacles will soon close. We study this predictive near-miss commitment problem and propose Risk-Sensitive Conjectural Scenario Planning (RCSP), a planning layer that evaluates candidate commands against plausible short-horizon obstacle futures. RCSP maintains a lightweight belief over local motion conjectures, samples future interactions, penalizes high-risk tails, and executes through a local safety check. In controlled MuJoCo bottleneck tasks, the RCSP planner reaches the goal without collisions and yields higher secondary safety and path-quality point estimates than a non-adaptive predictor, with additional latency. In ROS2/Gazebo, adding the local safety layer to a standard Nav2 stack reduces dynamic near-miss failures. On official DynaBARN/Jackal transfer, tuned DWA and TEB remain stronger on strict benchmark success, revealing the boundary of the approach. These simulation results position RCSP as a predictive-risk module that complements existing navigation stacks in dynamic bottleneck regimes.

</details>


### [492] [Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26349)
*Gokul Narayanan,Yash Shahapurkar,Melih Erdogan,Brian Zhu,Eugen Solowjow*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向遥操作机器人数据收集的数据质量评估与反馈框架（DQAF），该框架在每次操作后基于语义任务进度和机器人遥测数据提供即时、结构化的质量评估与可操作的自然语言反馈，帮助操作员（尤其是新手）提升演示数据质量。实验表明，接收该框架即时反馈的操作员比未接收者更快地提高了演示质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业自动化正从刚性系统向灵活自适应系统转型，物理AI的发展催生了对大规模、高质量机器人演示数据的需求，遥操作成为关键数据采集手段。然而，新手操作员常产生任务成功但运动效率低、纠错频繁、靠近关节极限等次优演示，现有二元成功/失败反馈无法揭示数据质量缺陷，亟需一种能提供结构化、可解释质量反馈的机制。

Method: 提出DQAF框架，在遥操作结束后提取子任务进度、运动平滑度、停滞、运动学极限等多维质量信号，将其转换为结构化质量评估和可操作的自然语言反馈。框架通过诊断性验证研究（与人类评审员比较）和三项用户研究（跨两个操作任务，比较接收反馈与未接收反馈的新手操作员表现）进行评估。

Result: 诊断性验证中，系统在数据集筛选时生成的拒绝原因和改进建议与人类评审员具有可比性。三项用户研究显示，接收DQAF即时自动反馈的操作员比未接收者更快地提升演示质量，更早产生高质量演示数据。

Conclusion: DQAF框架通过提供超越二元成功/失败的细粒度、可操作反馈，有效加速了新手操作员的学习曲线，有助于提升遥操作数据收集的质量和效率，对构建大规模高质量机器人演示数据集具有实用价值。

Abstract: Industrial automation is at a pivotal moment, as Physical AI is driving a transition from rigid, hand-engineered automation systems toward more flexible and adaptive systems. This shift has created a growing demand for large-scale, real-world robot demonstration data, making teleoperation an increasingly important mechanism for data collection. However, high-quality teleoperated demonstrations remain difficult to obtain in practice, as novice operators often produce episodes that are task-successful but suboptimal for downstream use due to inefficient motion, repeated corrections, or operation near robot joint limits. We present a Data Quality Assessment and Feedback (DQAF) framework that closes the loop in teleoperation by providing immediate post-episode feedback grounded in semantic task progress and robot telemetry. The framework extracts quality relevant signals such as sub-task progress, motion smoothness, stalls, kinematic limits and converts them into structured quality assessments and actionable natural-language feedback. Unlike binary success or failure feedback, the proposed system explains why an episode is suboptimal and highlights specific behaviors to correct in the next trial. We evaluate the framework through a diagnostic validation study and a pilot user study. In the validation study, the system is compared with a human reviewer during dataset curation, producing rejection reasons and actionable feedback for improvement. In the pilot study with three novice operators across two manipulation tasks, the operator who received the systems immediate, automated post-episode feedback improved faster than those who did not, producing higher-quality demonstrations sooner.

</details>


### [493] [Multi-Robot Box Transport over Different Surfaces with Decentralized Role-based Proportional Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26430)
*Aditya Bhatt,Himavarshini Yarragangu,Urvish Shah,Venkata Sai Yaswanth Mohan Thota,Souma Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出R2P2（基于规则与比例控制原语的角色分配）方法，一种异步去中心化任务与运动规划方法，用于多机器人协作推动矩形盒子在不同倾斜度和摩擦系数的地面上运输，并在仿真和物理实验中验证了其优于标准虚拟领航-跟随方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人协同推运物体在建筑、仓储、灾后清理等场景有广泛应用，但不同倾斜度和摩擦特性的地面给协同运输带来了独特挑战，现有方法在通信、同步和单点故障方面存在不足。

Method: 提出R2P2方法：基于规则为机器人分配推、支撑、防止等角色，根据操作模式（旋转vs平移）选择规则控制或比例速度控制；每个机器人仅需观测自身和盒子的位置及朝向即可执行控制。

Result: 在NVIDIA IsaacSim仿真中使用六机器人团队进行验证，表明该方法在不同地面摩擦/倾斜和盒子质量场景下具有良好的泛化性，成功率优于标准虚拟领航-跟随方法；在四台TurtleBot上成功完成1.2kg盒子的物理实验验证。

Conclusion: R2P2作为一种去中心化方法，能够有效缓解通信、同步和共识需求，避免单点故障，适用于不同地形条件下的多机器人协同推运任务。

Abstract: Collaborative transport of objects via pushing by multiple robots has many applications, ranging from construction and warehouse environments to post disaster debris clean-up. Achieving collaborative transport over surfaces with different inclination and friction properties however poses unique challenges. To address these challenges, this paper presents an asynchronous decentralized task and motion planning approach for transporting rectangular boxes of varying mass over flat, uphill and downhill terrain. Such a decentralized approach alleviates communication, synchronization and consensus needs and mitigates single point of failure issues. Our approach, called R2P2 or Roles with Rules and Proportional-control Primitive, assigns roles (e.g., push, support and prevent) to robots based on rules cognizant of the mode of manipulation needed (box rotation vs translation); this is followed by either rule-based control or proportional control of robot velocity based on the roles. Each robot is assumed to observe the location and heading of self and the box in executing the role and controls. R2P2 is evaluated with a six-robot team deployed in a simulator built using NVIDIA IsaacSim -- demonstrating generalizability across different surface friction/inclination and box mass scenarios, and better success rate compared to a standard virtual-leader-follower method. R2P2 is also successfully validated with a physical experiment, where it is executed onboard four turtlebots tasked with moving a 1.2 kg box.

</details>


### [494] [Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26452)
*Dhruv S. Kushwaha,Zoleikha A. Biron*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Robust Koopman-CBF SAC框架，利用数据驱动的Koopman预测器构建CBF安全滤波器，并通过投影残差估计处理近似误差，在保证零约束违反的同时实现高效安全强化学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有控制屏障函数（CBF）在无模型强化学习中的应用受限于对精确动力学模型和手工设计屏障证书的需求，亟需一种数据驱动的、可学习的CBF构建方法。

Method: 1) 从数据中学习有限维Koopman预测器，在升维空间中构建仿射CBF约束；2) 通过二次规划安全层强制执行约束；3) 利用留出轨迹数据的投影残差边界收紧CBF条件以补偿近似误差；4) 评论家在安全动作上训练，演员向Koopman-CBF可行集正则化。

Result: 在CartPole稳定和跟踪任务上实现零约束违反，性能匹敌或超越无约束SAC；在Safety Gymnasium高维任务中违规减少，但暴露了一阶速度屏障和线性EDMD模型的局限性。

Conclusion: 鲁棒Koopman-CBF滤波器是无模型RL与可证明安全之间的有前景桥梁，但其有效性依赖于系统结构条件，未来需要高阶和多步Koopman-CBF扩展。

Abstract: Safe reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic systems requires policies that improve task performance while satisfying state and input constraints during both training and deployment. Control barrier functions (CBFs) provide a principled mechanism for enforcing forward invariance through minimally invasive safety filters, but their use in model-free RL is limited by the need for accurate dynamics and hand-designed barrier certificates. We propose Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor--critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor from data, constructs affine CBF constraints in the lifted space, and enforces them through a quadratic-program safety layer. To account for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation error, the CBF condition is tightened using a projected residual margin estimated from held-out rollout data. The critic is trained on the executed safe action, while the actor is regularized toward the Koopman-CBF feasible set, reducing dependence on the filter over training. Across safe-control benchmarks, the method achieves zero constraint violations on CartPole stabilization and tracking while matching or exceeding unconstrained SAC returns. On high-dimensional Safety Gymnasium locomotion tasks, the method reduces violations in some settings but also exposes important limitations of first-order velocity barriers and linear EDMD models, motivating high-order and multi-step Koopman-CBF extensions. These results suggest that robust Koopman-CBF filters are a promising bridge between model-free RL and certifiable safety, while clarifying the structural conditions under which such filters remain effective. All code is available at \href{https://github.com/DhruvKushwaha/Koopman-CBF-Soft-Actor-Critic}{Github Repository}.

</details>


### [495] [Heterogeneous AAV Logistics Task Allocation: A Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Overlapping Coalition Formation Game Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26471)
*Yuze Zhou,Jingliang Sun,Junzhi Li,Jianxin Zhong,Zihan Wang,Teng Long*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 针对异构AAV在动态城市物流中处理随机涌现的时间敏感任务分配问题，提出了一种强化学习增强的重叠联盟形成博弈方法。该方法结合Transformer软演员-评论家网络与重叠联盟形成博弈，实现动态任务分配，在32架AAV与80个任务的场景下，相较于启发式基线实现了39.76%的成本降低，并通过室内飞行实验验证了实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态城市物流中，时间敏感任务的随机涌现对异构AAV的物流任务分配提出了最优性挑战，现有方法难以有效应对时变任务集带来的动态分配问题。

Method: 建立动态任务分配模型，将全局最优性量化为耦合服务质量与资源消耗的广义物流成本；设计基于Transformer的软演员-评论家网络，利用多头自注意力机制编码变长物流状态并捕获任务间时空依赖；学习策略自适应指导联盟更新，替代重叠联盟形成博弈中的启发式规则。

Result: 所提联盟形成过程被证明构成精确势博弈，保证有限迭代内收敛至纳什稳定均衡；在32架AAV和80个任务场景下，相比启发式OCF基线实现39.76%的成本降低。

Conclusion: 提出的强化学习增强的重叠联盟形成博弈方法有效提升了动态物流任务分配的最优性，数值仿真与室内飞行实验共同验证了算法的有效性与实用性。

Abstract: In dynamic urban logistics, the stochastic emergence of time-sensitive tasks poses a significant optimality challenge for heterogeneous AAVs logistics task allocation. To address this problem, a reinforcement learning enhanced overlapping coalition formation game approach is proposed. A dynamic task allocation model is established, where global optimality is mathematically quantified by a generalized logistics cost coupling service quality and resource consumption. To deal with the time-varying task sets induced by stochastic order arrivals, a transformer-based soft actor-critic network is designed. By leveraging multi-head self-attention to encode variable-length logistics states and capture task-wise spatiotemporal dependencies, the learned policy adaptively guides coalition updates, replacing heuristic rules in the overlapping coalition formation game. On this basis, heterogeneous AAVs can form more efficient overlapping coalitions for dynamic logistics tasks. The resulting coalition formation process is proven to constitute an exact potential game, which guarantees convergence to a Nash-stable equilibrium within a finite number of iterations. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively improves the optimality of task allocation under the generalized logistics cost criterion. In a scenario with 32 AAVs and 80 tasks, our algorithm achieves a 39.76% cost reduction compared with the heuristic OCF baseline. Indoor flight experiments further validate its practicality.

</details>


### [496] [Efficient On-policy Visual-RL via Stochastic Decoupled Policy Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26478)
*Haoxiang You,Yilang Liu,Davis Zong,Qian Wang,Teeratham Vitchutripop,Qi Wang,Daniel Rakita,Ian Abraham*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出随机解耦策略梯度方法(SDPG)，一种轻量级视觉强化学习方法，在单张RTX 4080 GPU上数小时内即可端到端训练多样化的视觉运动控制策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉强化学习方法计算和内存开销大，需要大量批量渲染环境，训练时间长，难以在单GPU上高效运行。

Method: 通过轨迹rollout的随机扰动来估计策略梯度，大幅减少批量渲染环境的数量，降低计算和内存开销。

Result: 在视觉MuJoCo基准测试中，SDPG在训练时间、内存使用和奖励方面均持续优于基线方法。

Conclusion: SDPG是一种轻量高效的视觉RL方法，并提供了包含灵巧操作、挑战性 locomotion 的真实视觉机器人基准套件，在物理硬件上验证了仿真到真实的迁移效果。

Abstract: We present the stochastic decoupled policy gradient (SDPG), a lightweight visual reinforcement learning (RL) method that trains diverse visuomotor control policies end-to-end within a few hours on a single NVIDIA RTX 4080 GPU. SDPG estimates policy gradients via random perturbations of trajectory rollouts, requiring orders of magnitude fewer batch-rendered environments and substantially reducing compute and memory overhead. On visual MuJoCo benchmarks, SDPG consistently outperforms baseline methods in training time, memory usage, and rewards. Finally, to support future research, we introduce a suite of realistic visual robotics benchmarks spanning dexterous manipulation, challenging locomotion, and demonstrate effective sim-to-real transfer on physical hardware.

</details>


### [497] [Enabling Extensible Embodied Capabilities with Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26637)
*Xueyang Zhou,Zijia Wang,Qianjiang Li,Yibo Hu,Guiyao Tie,Li Wan,Yidan Liu,Pan Zhou,Lichao Sun,Yongchao Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出能力外部化方法，通过标准化协议ETP将异构能力解耦为独立工具，在推理时动态调用，实验显示该方法在具身任务中平均提升31%-36%性能，但执行类能力提升有限，且工具调用时机、选择和方式仍是关键挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能方法将感知、推理、规划和控制统一在单一参数化策略中，但这些能力本质上是层次化、异质的，难以在单一模型中可靠学习和模块化。

Method: 提出能力外部化方法，设计Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP)标准化协议用于具身工具的注册、发现、调用和执行；构建100+验证工具的工具库；搭建EmbodiedToolBench评估框架。

Result: 在仿真和真实平台实验中，能力外部化在EB-ALFRED上平均提升31%，EB-Navigation上提升36%；认知和感知类能力提升显著，执行类能力提升有限。

Conclusion: 能力外部化能有效提升具身智能性能，但知道何时、选择哪个以及如何调用工具仍是所有模型的持续挑战，具身工具能力是未来研究的关键方向。

Abstract: Most existing embodied intelligence methods formulate perception, reasoning, planning, and control within a unified parameterized policy. Yet these capabilities are inherently hierarchical and heterogeneous, making them difficult to reliably learn and modularize within a single model. We propose a capability externalization approach that decouples heterogeneous capabilities into independently optimized tools, dynamically invoked at inference time. To this end, we introduce Embodied Tool Protocol (ETP), a standardized protocol for embodied tool registration, discovery, invocation, and execution, and curate 100+ validated tools spanning perception, cognition, reasoning, and execution as the tool base. Building on this, we construct EmbodiedToolBench to evaluate both whether tool augmentation improves embodied performance and how well current models use tools across tool-necessity recognition, tool selection, tool execution, and tool-chain composition. Experiments across simulation and real-world platforms confirm that capability externalization consistently improves embodied performance (avg. gain 31% on EB-ALFRED and 36% on EB-Navigation), yet reveal a clear boundary: gains are substantial for cognition and perception but are limited for execution-type capabilities. Moreover, our analysis reveals that knowing when, which, and how to invoke tools remains a persistent challenge across all models, thereby highlighting embodied tool competence as a critical direction for future research.

</details>


### [498] [L-Learning : A Lyapunov-Based Approach Leveraging Lagrangian Mechanics for Efficient and Stable Robot Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26648)
*Quan Quan,Hao Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出L-Learning，一种将李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学相结合的数据驱动控制框架，通过从数据中显式学习系统能量函数，在保证闭环稳定性的同时优化轨迹跟踪性能，具有高控制精度、理论稳定性保障和高样本效率等优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统控制方法在动态不确定环境中性能退化严重，而数据驱动方法虽更具适应性，但样本复杂度高且缺乏严格的稳定性保证。

Method: 将李雅普诺夫稳定性理论与拉格朗日力学融合到数据驱动控制框架中，通过从数据中显式学习系统的能量函数来优化性能，同时内在地保证闭环稳定性。

Result: L-Learning具有优越的控制精度、理论稳定性保证和高样本效率。

Conclusion: L-Learning是一种有前景的实用机器人控制解决方案，有效弥合了传统控制与数据驱动方法之间的差距。

Abstract: This paper presents L-Learning, a novel data-driven control framework for robotics that integrates Lyapunov stability theory with Lagrangian mechanics to enhance trajectory tracking performance. While traditional control methods often suffer from performance degradation in dynamic and uncertain environments, data-driven approaches, while more adaptable, are frequently limited by high sample complexity and a lack of rigorous stability guarantees. L-Learning mitigates these challenges by explicitly learning the system's energy function from data, thereby optimizing performance while ensuring closed-loop stability intrinsically. Characterized by superior control accuracy, theoretical stability guarantees, and high sample efficiency, L-Learning represents a promising solution for practical robotic applications.

</details>


### [499] [On the Generalization Capabilities, Design Choices and Limitations of Keypoint Imitation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26649)
*Thomas Lips,Marco Moletta,Michael C. Welle,Danica Kragic,Francis wyffels*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了基于视觉基础模型的关键点模仿学习（KIL）在机器人操作中的泛化能力。通过2000多次真实世界实验，KIL在五项任务中达到75%的成功率，显著优于RGB基线（47%），与S2-diffusion（73%）相当。但KIL并未超越其他表征方法，且继承了基础模型的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RGB模仿学习需要大量演示才能泛化到未见物体或场景，因此需要研究中间表征来提升机器人操作的泛化能力。视觉基础模型可以一次性提取关键点，但如何将其最优地整合到模仿学习中以及何时优于其他表征尚不明确。

Method: 结合先前关键点模仿学习（KIL）的研究方法，探究多种设计选择以提供实践指南；通过2000多次真实世界 rollout 评估KIL对未见物体和场景变化的泛化能力。

Result: KIL在五项任务中整体成功率为75%，显著高于RGB基线（47%），与S2-diffusion（73%）相当。

Conclusion: KIL是一种数据高效的机器人学习方法，能有效泛化到未见物体和场景变化，但并未超越其他表征方法，且继承了用于关键点提取的基础模型的局限性。

Abstract: RGB-based imitation learning requires many demonstrations to generalize to unseen objects or scenes, motivating research into intermediate representations to improve generalization for robotic manipulation. Visual foundation models enable one-shot extraction of keypoints to provide such representation. However, it remains unclear how to integrate them into imitation learning optimally and when they outperform alternative representations. We combine approaches from previous works on keypoint imitation learning (KIL) and investigate several design choices to provide practical guidelines. Using over 2000 real-world rollouts, we also assess the generalization capabilities of KIL to unseen objects and scene variations. KIL achieves a 75% overall success rate across five tasks, significantly outperforming the RGB baseline (47%) and performing on par with S2-diffusion (73%). Finally, we explore the limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction and extend KIL to tasks with multiple object instances. Our results confirm KIL as a data-efficient approach for robot learning, though it does not outperform alternative representations and inherits limitations of the foundation models used for keypoint extraction. All rollout videos, demonstrations, and results are available at https://kil-manipulation.github.io/.

</details>


### [500] [SteelDS: A High-Resolution Video Dataset of E40 Steel Scrap for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26682)
*Melanie Neubauer,Christian Rauch,Gerald Koinig,Alexia Tischberger-Aldrian,Roland Pomberger,Elmar Rueckert*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该数据集提供了工业级破碎钢和铜废料在传送带上的高分辨率标注视频序列，包含24,297帧标注图像，支持机器学习模型在材料分类、目标检测和实例分割方面的开发与评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对工业磁选后仍需人工分拣铜杂质的问题，提供标准化基准数据集，推动自动化分拣算法在复杂钢废料流中识别铜杂质的发展。

Method: 在受控实验室环境下采集E40级破碎钢和铜废料在传送带上的视频，包含5个子集、24,297帧标注图像，提供像素级分割掩码和材料类别标注，涵盖不同间距和密度的物体排列以模拟真实工业分拣条件。

Result: 数据集包含396个钢目标和101个铜目标，按尺寸分类，共24,297帧标注图像，提供像素级分割掩码和材料类别标注。

Conclusion: 该数据集可作为评估自动化分拣算法（特别是识别钢废料流中铜杂质）的基准，支持材料分类、目标检测和实例分割等任务的模型开发。

Abstract: This dataset provides high-resolution, annotated video sequences of shredded E40-grade steel and copper scrap on a conveyor belt. Captured in a controlled laboratory environment, the data reflects the industrial post-magnetic sorting stage, where manual intervention is typically required to remove copper contaminants. The dataset comprises 24,297 labeled frames across five subsets, featuring 396 steel and 101 copper objects categorized by size. It supports the development of machine learning models for material classification, object detection, and instance segmentation. Variations in object spacing and density are included to simulate realistic industrial sorting conditions. Ground truth annotations include pixel-wise segmentation masks and material classes. This dataset serves as a benchmark for evaluating automated sorting algorithms aiming to identify copper impurities within complex, heterogeneous steel scrap streams.

</details>


### [501] [Look Further: Socially-Compliant Navigation System in Residential Buildings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26710)
*Akira Shiba,Marina Obata,Nathan Kau,Zoltan Beck,Rishi Shah,Michael Sudano,Sabrina Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种主动变道（PLC）导航模式，通过在8米以上距离提前响应行人，显著提升了人类对机器人运动的感知（安全性、流畅性、礼貌性），但在盲角场景中效果不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交导航方法通常关注短距离（数米内）的人机交互冲突消解，但忽略了增加反应距离对提升人类感知的潜力。本文旨在探索将反应距离扩展至8米以上是否能改善人对机器人运动的评价。

Method: 提出主动变道（Proactive Lane-Changing, PLC）运动模式，机器人在走廊中距迎面行人8米时从中心横向移动至侧边。设计了基于PLC的导航系统，并在正面直走廊和盲角交叉口两种场景下与减速、停止、反应式避碰等传统模式进行对比用户研究（n=42）。

Result: 正面直走廊场景中，PLC在安全性、流畅性和礼貌性三个维度上均显著优于传统运动模式；盲角交叉口场景中，各模式之间无显著差异，参与者偏好呈现多样化。

Conclusion: 远距离主动变道（8米以上）能有效改善人对机器人运动的感知，但该优势仅在可预见的直线走廊场景中成立；在盲角等不可见场景中，需要进一步研究适应不同用户偏好的运动策略。

Abstract: The distance at which a mobile robot reacts to a person strongly impacts various qualities of the human-robot interaction. In this paper, we focus on the navigation of a mobile delivery robot platform in a residential indoor hallway environment. Social navigation methods typically focus on avoiding uncomfortable human-robot interactions, such as when a robot encroaches on someone's personal space. Since personal space has been shown to be in the range of just a few meters, social navigation methods typically focus on deconflicting and resolving these short-range interactions. In this work, however, we demonstrate that by extending the reaction distance to over eight meters, far beyond the typical interaction distance, we can improve the human's perception of the robot's motion. We introduce the Proactive Lane-Changing (PLC) motion pattern and a navigation system that leverages it to react to people at an increased distance. This pattern consists of changing the robot's lateral position as it navigates down the hallway from the center to the side at an eight-meter distance from an oncoming person.
  We conducted a user study with 42 participants to assess their impressions of the delivery robot based on three service objectives: safety, smoothness, and politeness. In the straight hallway scenario (Frontal Approach), results showed significant improvement in each of these three objectives compared to typical motion patterns found in the literature: slowing down, stopping, and reactive collision avoidance in the proximity of a person. In contrast, in the intersection (Blind Corner) scenarios, none of the approaches performed significantly better than any other, with participants having a diverse range of preferences among robot motion patterns.

</details>


### [502] [Manipulating Tangible Virtual Object Dynamics to Promote Learning of Precision Force Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26782)
*Alberto Garzás-Villar,Alba Riera-Cardona,Alexis Derumigny,J. Micah Prendergast,Jane Murray Cramm,Laura Marchal-Crespo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究通过改变虚拟弹簧的力-伸长关系（线性、高斯、反对称高斯）来训练健康受试者的精确力控能力。反对称高斯组在训练中表现最佳，但长期保持无显著差异。受试者主要依赖学习到的目标伸长量而非目标力，表明该方法在体感神经康复中有潜力但仍需改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人触觉设备结合虚拟现实为训练精细力生成提供了新机会，这是中风后康复中重要但被忽视的环节。本研究旨在探索通过操纵虚拟物体的渲染动力学来训练精确力控制，同时激活体感系统。

Method: 50名健康受试者执行冰壶任务，通过拉伸虚拟弹簧产生目标释放力将冰壶推送至指定位置。训练中弹簧的力-伸长关系被建模为线性、高斯或反对称高斯函数。分析训练表现、个性特征影响及长期保持和迁移任务表现。

Result: 反对称高斯组在训练中始终优于线性组；高斯组仅在训练后期优于线性组。更高Free Spirit得分与高斯动力学下更差表现和更少探索相关，更高Transform-of-Challenge得分与更多探索相关。长期保持无显著差异。迁移任务中受试者依赖目标伸长量而非目标力。

Conclusion: 该方法在体感神经康复中有前景，但需减少对本体感觉线索的依赖，才能用于神经系统患者测试。

Abstract: Robotic haptic devices combined with virtual reality offer novel opportunities to train fine force generation, an essential yet overlooked component of post-stroke rehabilitation. This study proposes that manipulating the rendered dynamics of tangible virtual objects can be leveraged to train precise force control while engaging the somatosensory system. We conducted an experiment with fifty healthy participants who performed a curling-inspired task in which they had to stretch a virtual spring to generate a target release force to propel the stone to a predefined location on the ice sheet. During training, the spring's force-elongation relationship was modeled as either a linear or non-linear function, i.e., a Gaussian or antisymmetric Gaussian (AS-Gaussian) function with zero derivative at the release target force. Results indicate that the AS-Gaussian group consistently achieved higher force accuracy during training than the linear group, while the Gaussian group only outperformed the linear group toward the end of training. Analysis of personality traits revealed that higher Free Spirit scores were associated with poorer performance and reduced task exploration under Gaussian dynamics, whereas higher Transform-of-Challenge scores correlated with increased exploration. Despite these training effects, no significant differences in long-term retention were found across spring types or personality traits. Participants primarily relied on learned target elongation rather than target force, as evidenced by performance in a transfer task with a different stiffness but the same target force. While promising for somatosensory neurorehabilitation, these methods require refinement to reduce reliance on proprioceptive cues before testing with neurological patients.

</details>


### [503] [Can VLA Models Learn from Real-World Data Continually without Forgetting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26820)
*Jiarun Zhu,Yijun Hong,Xiaoquan Sun,Zetian Xu,Mingqi Yuan,Zhiyong Wang,Wenjun Zeng,Jiayu Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文首次在真实世界场景下研究VLA模型的持续学习问题，构建了包含四种连续操作任务的数据集，发现VLA模型存在严重的灾难性遗忘，并系统评估了经验回放策略的关键实施因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在真实场景部署时需要持续获取新技能并保留旧知识，但现有研究仅在受限模拟环境中进行，缺乏真实条件下的持续学习研究。

Method: 构建包含刚性物体抓取放置、接触式按压、可变形物体折叠四种连续操作任务的真实世界持续学习数据集，进行实验并系统评估经验回放方法。

Result: VLA模型在连续学习异构真实世界演示时遭受显著的灾难性遗忘；经验回放方法的关键实施因素被揭示。

Conclusion: 本研究提供了真实世界持续VLA学习的首个实证研究，为部署长寿命机器人策略提供了实践指导。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide a promising foundation for general-purpose robotics. However, their successful deployment in real-world scenarios requires the ability to continually acquire new skills while retaining previously learned behaviors. While pioneering research has studied the continual learning of VLA models in narrowly simulated environments, this challenge remains largely unexplored under realistic conditions. To address this limitation, we construct a real-world continual learning dataset comprising four sequential manipulation tasks, spanning rigid-object pick-and-place, contact-rich pressing, and deformable-object folding. Using this dataset, we conduct comprehensive experiments and find that VLA models suffer significant catastrophic forgetting when continually learning from heterogeneous real-world demonstrations. We then systematically evaluate experience replay and uncover key implementation factors that govern its success. In summary, this work provides the first empirical study of real-world continual VLA learning and offers practical guidance for deploying long-lived robot policies.

</details>


### [504] [Learning Compositional Symbolic Task Rules from Demonstrations with Inductive Logic Programming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26828)
*Oleh Borys,Karla Stepanova*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用归纳逻辑编程（ILP）将复杂任务分解为不同抽象层次的学习目标，从演示中推断符号规则，并复用已学规则来学习更高层次的任务结构。实验表明该方法在块组装场景下具有可解释性和强泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的演示学习方法通常只关注任务执行方式，忽略了可检查、可复用且人类可解释的高层任务结构表示。随着机器人自主性提高，需要一种能够捕捉任务结构并支持泛化的表示学习方法。

Method: 采用归纳逻辑编程（ILP），将复杂任务分解为不同本体抽象层次的简单学习目标，从演示和先验知识中推断符号规则，并在学习更高层任务结构时复用已学规则。

Result: 在合成块组装场景中，学习到的抽象表示具有可解释性，并能够强泛化到包含未见物体的更难的保留任务上。

Conclusion: 分解式ILP是实现任务级演示学习的可行方法，能够学习可解释、可复用的任务表示并支持强泛化。

Abstract: Learning from Demonstration~(LfD) should capture not only how a task is executed, but also its high-level task structure that explains the demonstrated behavior. As robots become more autonomous, such task representations must be inspectable, reusable, and human-interpretable. To address this, we study how to represent and learn robotic tasks with inductive logic programming~(ILP) by decomposing a complex task into a series of simpler learning objectives at different abstraction (ontological) levels. The system infers symbolic rules from demonstrations and prior (domain) knowledge, and reuses learned rules when learning higher-level task structure. We evaluate the approach in a synthetic block-assembly scenario and show that the learned abstractions are interpretable and support strong generalization to harder, held-out tasks with unseen objects. These results provide preliminary evidence that decomposed ILP is a feasible approach to task-level LfD.

</details>


### [505] [A Bioinspired Underwater Robot with a Latch-Mediated Soft Bistable Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26936)
*Chongze Bi,Wenjie Wu,Zonghao Zuo,Li Wen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种受生物启发的软体双稳态致动器，该致动器集成了闩锁机构，利用单个电机实现非对称能量输入与释放，结合鳍结构实现高效水下推进与机动。实验展示了稳定的周期性拍动、精确转向，最大推力0.528 N、冲量0.147 Ns、垂直位移30 mm，通过调节鳍角实现多种运动模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微型水下机器人受限于传统能源的低能量密度，而自然界生物（如螳螂虾、跳蚤）利用闩锁介导弹簧驱动（LaMSA）系统实现快速运动。本研究旨在通过仿生软体双稳态致动器复现这种快速非对称驱动机制，解决现有微型水下机器人结构复杂、能量效率低的问题。

Method: 设计了一种仿生软体双稳态致动器，集成了闩锁机构，使用单个电机实现非对称能量输入与释放；将致动器与鳍结构耦合，实现水下推进与机动；通过调节鳍角实现垂直上升、斜向前进和侧向平移等多种运动。
